heading: Abstract
content: The aim of this project is to offer quality smart restaurant services and to decrease the effort for providing these services in Pakistan. This project, the Smart Restaurant Service, involves development of two systems, the Restaurant Service Automation Sy stem and the Online Food Ordering System. One system will be used by restaurant customers to directly place their food order and send notification of that order to restaurant kitchen staff through a smartphone/tab device placed on each dining table of the restaurant While the other will be used to let the online customers to order food online from different restaurants. Both these systems will contain a common administrator interface which will be operated by the restaurant manager who will also be able to generate food order receipts at both Kitchen interface (only a receipt printer device) and Restaurant Manager’s interface.The whole system will have a user friendly GUI interface which can be operated even by users who are interacting with it for the first  time. The thought behind this project is to promote application development in Pakistan. Deployment of Smart Restaurant Service will involve development and installation of Smartphone application , the Restaurant Service Automation System for the restaurant and development of a web application, Online Food Ordering System.

heading: Introduction
content: There are several issues which we face in both providing and receiving restaurant services in Pakistan like when we go to a restaurant (and specially when we are with a group of people), we search through a list of food items on a menu card for what we want to order, at the same time the restaurant attendant will arrive at our table and ask us what we would like to order. The restaurant attendant will wait for us and this fact might force us to quickly give an order and we may end up selecting something we do not want. Mostly in Pakistan we order food home delivery from restaurants through a call. When we explain to the receiver what we would like to order it is possible that he/she might misunderstand a food item or it’s quantity for another. Another issue is that when we go to a restaurant sometimes there are already a lot of guests present. We have to wait a bit until the attendant arrives at our table and takes our order. And the attendant has to go to the kitchen every time he takes an order and gives the order receipt to the staff at kitchen. This whole process will consume a lot of time. The aim of our project, Smart Restaurant Service is to provide a solution for these above mentioned issues and take res taurant services in Pakistan to the next level of ease. These issues are a bit similar to each other but at the same time are also different. Therefore to tackle them our project, Smart Restaurant Service will involve the development of two separate systems. The first system, Restaurant Service Automation System will be used to deal with providing and receiving restaurant services within a restaurant. The second one is Online Food Ordering System which will be used to order food online by selecting desired restaurant and placing  an order from a selected restaurant’s menu and ordering food through home delivery. Both these systems will contain a common administrator interface which will be operated by the restaurant manager who will also be able to manage restaurant records, view change activity log, receive customer order notifications and generate food order receipts at both Kitchen interface (only a receipt printer device) and Restaurant Manager’s interface. Most of the functionalities we have mentioned ab ove for both systems are already present in existing systems like Foodpanda and McDonald’s touch interface ordering system etc. What is unique about our project is that it holds two different systems and each will encounter different challenges of the same  domain. Both systems will have a common administrator interface which will make the management of records a lot easier. The administrator interface will be connected to the kitchen interface to generate and print food order receipts directly in the kitche n. The Online Food Ordering System will  also have the feature to make table reservation and to book a food order in advance if a table is reserved. The Smart Restaurant Service will also be able to manage discounts according to the needs of every restaurant. Due to an always increasing demand of new and easy to use services, it is now even more important to become skilled at developing applications for new computer technologies. The thought behind this project is to promote application development in Pakis tan. Introducing new services through modern tools and technologies will certainly help in taking Pakistan one step closer in becoming a better developed country. Once the system is deployed across different restaurants, it will also motivate people to develop such more applications related to the domestic

heading: Problem Statement
content:  In a restaurant, when guests are going through the menu of food list, the restaurant attendant /server arrives at the guest’s table, the attendant/server waits for the guests to give an order, at the same time the guests will feel a bit under pressure (because of the attendant/server waiting for them) and may not end up selecting what they really w ant. Our goal here is to decrease the efforts required in providing restaurant services for restaurant staff and also to let the guests to select the desired menu with ease.  In Pakistan, another popular way of ordering food for home delivery is through cal l, we often receive brochures from different restaurants which include their menu and contact number. Whenever we like to order food from a restaurant we choose different items from the brochure and make a call to restaurant contact number. The receiver as ks us about what we would like to order? We explain to him/her about our order but sometimes the receiver might misunderstood a food item for another or may not be able catch the correct required quantity of food item. The prices of food items on the broch ures do not remain the same forever; this also often misleads the customer (the caller) about prices and total bill of food order. Smartphone applications like Foodpanda are solving this issue but are still not very popular among Pakistanis. Our goal here is to promote the use of Smartphone applications for ordering food online even more.  Sometimes when we go to a restaurant there are already a lot of customers present in the restaurant and we have to wait a lot until our order gets prepared. With our proje ct, the Smart Restaurant Service, we can solve this problem by placing an order online to start preparing our order right after we arrive at the restaurant.  No popular system exists which synchronizes both online food ordering system and restaurant service automation system with each other. O ur project, the Smart Restaurant Service, includes a Restaurant Manager Interface which is used to manage both above mentioned systems and is able to maintain synchronization between both systems with each other.

heading: Scope
content: This project, the Smart Restaurant Service, will contain the development of two separate systems, the Restaurant Service Automation System and the Online Food Ordering System. Both these systems will have a common administrator interface operated by the restaurant’s manager to view and manage the contents of both systems. In the Restaurant Service Automation System, users, guest/restaurant customer who will order food inside the restaurant, will be provided with a smart phone application, installed on a device placed on each dining table in the restaurant, to select desired menu. The complete menu of the restaurant will be displayed on the tab along with the price and an image of the food. The customer will select the desired food and/or drink which he/she wants to order. When the customer has selected all the desired food and/or drink items with quantity to order, the app will display the total bill. The guest can then select the option to “place ord er”. After an order has been placed, the notification of order details will be transferred to a restaurant manager’s interface and a receipt will be generated through receipt printing devices on both restaurant manager and restaurant kitchen end. The system will calculate order preparation time and display a message on the restaurant customer’s interface e.g. your order will be ready in almost 15 minutes. A countdown will begin on the guest -side interface, and the food will be served to the guest in or before the timer ends. After placing an order the restaurant customers will be able give feedback about restaurant interface through their interface. The system will also be able to manage discounts according to the needs of every restaurant. Right now, this S martphone application is planned to be developed for just android devices. In the Online Food Ordering System, user, who will order food online, can view a  the list of different restaurants with details like food menu, restaurant deals, give review etc, op tion for home delivery and option for booking table along with location of table in the restaurant. The tools and technology considered for the development of this project are:  Android IDE, Android Studio.

heading: Literature Review
content: “Big data is high -volume, high -velocity and high -variety information assets that demand cost - eﬀective, innovative forms of information processing for enhanced insight and decision making” [1] The world in the present times feeds on Data, it's because of this data that companies are being able to operate on such large scale. Given the increasing importance of big data, companies can leverage on these data to exploit new opportunities and gain an in -depth understanding of the hidden values. Companies in many industries are increasingly interested in their potentialities since they c an generate high revenues [3]. Big data can be obtained  from within and outside companies, in the form of structured and unstructured data, and it can generate diﬃculties for co mpanies in capturing, aggregating, analyzing and extracting value from them. Decision making based on trends and forecasting helps companies to make sure that a specific product exists there at the right place and the right time. There are many positive aspects of big data, but companies do hesitate as capital is required for processing of data and extracting meaningful findings from it. The key contribution of this paper would be to demonstrate and provide evidence of how big data can be helpful in decision making. In third world countries  like Pakistan and many others, the importance of data sciences is yet to be acknowledged by the small-scale businessmen. heading: Introduction
content: With the advancement of technology, personal devices have become very common and all personal and official data of a user is stored on these personal devices. These personal devices, like all hardware, are prone to failure. Most of us have faced situations where at the time of critical need, our hard disk crashes or our personal devices start to malfunction. If the data was not backed-up, then we have to start from scratch. Over recent years, big technology companies like Google, Microsoft and Dropbox have started to provide free public cloud storage services. We use these online storage systems to store our data so that we can access it anywhere, at any time, without having to worry about hardware failure or unavailability of our personal devices. Usually, the storage capacity provided by the cloud services, at free of cost, is not sufficient to store large amount of data of the end user. To store all or most of the important data on cloud storage, the end user makes multiple accounts on different cloud serv ices. Most common cloud storage services include “OneDrive” by Microsoft, “Google Drive” by Google, and “Dropbox” by Dropbox Inc. Each service provides a directory that serves as an interface between the personal device and the cloud storage. All data that  is placed in those directories are synced and updated to the cloud storage through the Internet. With large amount of user data distributed manually by the user in multiple directories, data management becomes difficult. A user might have multiple accounts and does not know how much space he is left with in each account, or on which account the specific file is stored. Therefore, handling and keeping track of data is a hectic problem. Additionally, for some reason, if a cloud service is down at the time of  need of a critical file and the file is not backed-up, we can face severe consequences. In this regard, we propose a system that manages multiple cloud storages by providing a single platform to users from where they can upload, retrieve and replicate da ta according to its criticality. In this project, we are developing a desktop application which will allow user to store maximum data by efficiently managing the cloud space. End user will be able to manage number of accounts like “One Drive, “Google Drive ”, “Drop Box” etc.  at a time , and through  our application interface, user will be able to do all the management, operation on files. It will be the task of our application to look for available spaces and upload it according to placement and memory management algorithms, and update the database that will be keeping track of all the files uploaded. If the user tries to upload same file again, database will inform the user that the file already exists. Based on the criticality of the data file, specified by t he user, our application will replicate the data file in multiple clouds, so that if one of the cloud services is down, the file is still accessible through another cloud service. The patient affected from neurological disorder simply gets frustrated from life and cannot d o anything productive. The sufferer of neurological disorder has the strength to live a normal life but the communication between brain and nervous system eradicates. Hence messages cannot be transmitted to other parts of the body to perform desired functi ons. To improve the condition of patients, an intelligent health care system is required which can help patients to rehabilitate through different procedures such as progressive m obilisation, training and occupational therapy. The proposed heath care syste m revolves around the occupational therapy using kinetic sensor for neurological disabled persons. The rehabilitation process will take place through the process of signal transmission along axons. The technique used to transmit signals is known as conduct ion where neuron interacts with its own terminal through axons. The proposed system would intelligently detect the signs and help in the occupational therapy of the patient using kinetic sensors. This project is being done with the collaboration of Pakista n Society for Rehabilitation of the Disabled (PSRD). This interactive purposed support system will be a major breakthrough for neurological disabled patients.

heading: Introduction
content: Quibid is an online auction system quite different then the regular auction system, where user provides the auction product with the minimum price tag to purchase for a specific time and the interested buyers can bid amount they are willing to pay for that produ ct and the highest bidder qualify to purchase the product. eBay is the perfect model of the regular auction system but our presented model “Quibid” is different our company itself present items up for bid in this business however the key difference is the logic behind bids. Our business model is based on “all -pay auction” every bidder must pay regardless of winning or losing the contest. We sell our bids to our registered customer, each time they participate in a contest by placing a bid one is deducted fro m their account and to win the contest they have to stay as the last bidder. To do so they have to place a bid whenever else one places a bid. That’s not all that separates us from the conventional auction system we also introduce the “penny auction” syste m. The initial price of the product is set to zero, whenever someone place a bid the price of the product rise by one penny and a bid cost you around half a dollar. so, the final price at which product is sold is extremely lower than the product actual price, on average user can save up to 60-70% on item. Quibid also provides a “buy now” feature to the customer if they want the product at its actual cost listed at auction, to maintain a good relationship with the customer, this feature work differently it subtracted the amount that user invest in the auction via biding from the actual price. So, user have a sense of security that they never have to pay more than the actual retail price Also, they have the security that if they invest too much on a product via bidding and they lose they still have a chance of purchase that product. “Buy now” feature work till two hours of the product sale and within this time you can purchase product for its retail price minus invested money. This feature is available if and only if a customer place at least a bit on that product.  This is the framework of our business model we aim to develop. Quibid is a web -based application which implements this frame work by performing the required functionalities such as: • Manage the customer’s data • Register new customers • Manage the product store • Manage the product sales procedure include time management and bids management • Manage payment processes2

heading: Architecture
content: Three-tier architecture follows the client -server pattern, in which there are three independent modules i.e. User Interface, Business Logic/Rules and Database. Selection of this particular architecture for the Quibid.pk is because of its scalability and extendibility factors as each module is independent so change in one does not affect the change in other tiers. Moreover, it assists with more reliability of the underlying services. MVC consists of three basic components model, view, and controller. Model usually contains the state (data and logic) of overall application. View is used to display the data and act as a presenter. Controller act as an interface between model and view, it stores all the logic on which model and view will work whenever an input is received. Our project model contains our database, view contains all the displaying interfaces and controller will contain all the controlling logic. This separation will make our work easy, flexible and more secure. MVC framework is easy to maintain, easy to test.

heading: Introduction
content: The aim of our project is to explore the field of business process management. In this field, we will be emphasizing on discovering the ways to evaluate the similarities among the process models that are present in the process repository. The business Process Management(BPM) is comprised of various methods and entire range of techniques that  supports analysis phase, enactment, the design and lastly management of operational business processes [1]. The BPM is a discipline in the form of a life cycle. It involves mixture of designing, modeling, execution, monitoring and lastly optimize stage fo r activity flows of the business considering supporting goals of enterprise and system spanning  [1]. In order to find the correspondence between process models, process similarity technique is introduced. Process similarity is the technique we apply on the  repositories to find out the processes that bear a resemblance to each other. To find the similarity among these process models similarity metrics were introduced that queries on the process metrics  [10]. Process model similarity query is a term used for such queries that we will apply over the process model repositories. There are three similarity metrics that are used to find the process similarity [10]. Structural Similarity metric is used for comparing labels of element including topology of process models [10]. The metric is defined by us based on the graph edit distance of business process graphs. Various operations could in fact be considered for evaluating this metric like Node deletion or insertion, Node substitution and Edge deletion or insertion  [10]. Graph Edit Distance is used to measures distance between graphs g1 and g2 by measuring distortion which is expected to change g1 into g2. The essential distortion operations of this can adapt to subjective names on both edges and nodes and in additio n with coordinated or undirected edges [13]. The second similarity metric, Behavioral Similarity metric takes the behavior of the business models as input  [10]. It compares labels of element including the unpremeditated relations that are captured in a mod el. The third and last similarity metric, Node Matching Similarity works on a principle and that is pair wise comparing of labels otherwise it can be attributes attached to the process model elements  [10]. The elements we compare include the value of the node that it contains and its attributes.

heading: Abstract
content: Overweight and obesity are significant public health problems worldwide with serious health consequences. With increasing urbanization and modernization there has been an increase in prevalence of obesity  that is attributed to reduced levels of physical activity.  Globally, around 23% of adults aged 18 and over were not active enough in 2015 (men 20% and women 27%). In high -income countries, 26% of men and 35% of women were insufficiently physically active, as compared to 12% of men and 24% of women in low-income countries. Insufficient physical activity is a key risk factor for non-communicable diseases (NCDs) such as cardiovascular diseases, cancer and diabetes. Globally, 1 in 4 adults is not active enough . More than 80% of the world's adolescent population is insufficiently physically active. To promote a healthy lifestyle, Gym should be an essential part of your daily life. In current busy life schedule, people are neglecting the most important asset of their life i.e. their own health. Doing gym on routine basis enforces you to eat clean and avoid fast food, smoking etc. You feel much more fit, become much more enthusiast about your daily activities and starts to live life more.  Our Gym Management System  incorporates as an intermediary between gym member, trainer and gym Management. Therefore, it becomes easier for everyone to interact with each other. Usually, the tools used by the clients are excel sheets or paper sheets , however it is not likely to share the data from multiple system s in multi user en vironment, changes of mistakes and duplicate work are there . Even when there is a slight change in the records, we  need to updat e each and every excel file. Our s mart Gym Management System eradicates most o f the restrictions of the existing system. Increasing efficiency and effectiveness, automation, accuracy, user - friendly interface, information availability, communication capacity, maintenance, cost reduction makes our system smarter than the existing system.

Our search engine will be more like a layman’s database where you whittle down millions of pages to just a handful that relates to what someone is looking for. With this, we can also disambiguate the meaning of words that are ambiguous, by utilizing other words on the page. With this, we can build a list of appropriate questions to whittle down in a conversational form until we just get the 5 -10 results that a search user wants to know. This will allow people to find any of the pages (or in general, files) available in the index. It take the user interaction of searching something on internet and make it much more conve rsational. When people search for something, the conversational search finds 10 relevant results and also find summary of these results on each question until their satisfaction. The innovation is a conversational refinement tool. For example, you ask CAT, it will return 10 results with 5 follow up questions like do you want biological information, ownership information, products, images, videos or something else. Word based searching throws 5 different things into a single bucket.

heading: Introduction
content: There is a need of every educational institute to have a website where necessary information about the institute can be specified. Besides website allows a business to grow more quickly as it helps in marketing. Because of refinements in technology manual maintenance of account records is depreciating. Our project will provide solution to these problems. We are developing a real time project for an educational institute named Jinnah Polytechnic Institute, Lahore. Project includes the development of an accou nts management application and an informative website of Jinnah Poly Technic Institute, Lahore. Our project is divided into two modules. • In the first module we will develop a website which is further sub divided into three sub modules, first sub module includes designing of basic web pages that comprise of related information about college  i.e. Admission Details, Fees Structures, Contact Details, Offered Diplomas, Faculty Information etc. Secondly, we will make a portal for Administrator where admin can u pload Internal Examination Marks and Fee status of students, and ultimately we will make a Student portal from where students can check their examination result and fee status by providing a valid registration number. • Our second module  is developing a Web  Application for managing accounts which is further sub divided into two sub modules. First module is Income and second is Expense. Income has following attributes: Monthly Tuition Fees of Students, Prospectus Fees, Promotion Fees Annually, Test Session Fe es, Returns in form of checks/cash and any other income that is not listed. Expense has following attributes: Utility Bills, Miscellaneous Expenses, Repair and Maintenance Expenses, Printing and Stationary Expenses, staff salaries and any other expense tha t is not listed. At the end of month a balance sheet will be prepared which will include every detail including income and expenses for that month. Accounts manager will also be able to view details of any category individually. If expenses of some month  will be more than the income, then the remaining expenses of that month will be added to next month’s balance sheet as an expense and if income will be more than expense then that amount will be added as cash in hand in the next month balance sheet. Accoun t records will be saved in a secure database and can be recovered anytime.

heading: Abstract
content: Pakistan is a beautiful country. Anyone can fall in love with the beautiful natural sites in northern areas of Pakistan. Due to this reason tourism is a growing industry in Pakistan as there are many heavenly places. In 2017 there were over 1,750,000[1] to urist visitors, which shows a huge rate of interest of tourists to visit beautiful places present in Pakistan. However, tourists arrange most of the trips by themselves. There is lack of platforms that can help tourists to find suitable tourism companies t hat can turn tourists experience more enjoyable. Some tourism companies are operating by using just Facebook. The aim of our project is to provide a platform for both tourists and tourism companies so that they can interact with each other in arranging trips. More specifically, the purpose of this shared and collaborative platform with synchronized web interfaces is to help tour guiding companies to offer packages and services to tourists. Moreover, the application will also provide people to easily interac t with guiding companies and make deals about their own tours or join with already available tours. We hope that with the usage of this application, tourism of our country will flourish further.

heading: Introduction
content: With the stability in law and order in Pakistan, we have witnessed an increase in tourism in Northern areas of Pakistan. Even foreigners from other countries are coming in good numbers to visit beautiful places present in Pakistan. Our country  is enriched with natural beauty. It includes places like Swat, Narran, Kagan and many more. Even Kashmir is said to be a part of Heaven on Earth which is also present in our country. Right now tourist from other countries and even the residents of our cou ntry faces the problem of finding a good guide for their tourism desires. Moreover, people nowadays face lack of trusts on guides for their bad behavior in past and they do not know beautiful places hidden on the sacred map of Pakistan. They only know and mostly visit that two or three places, again and again, every year. To overcome this complexity, people need an online forum that will work as a bridge between clients and companies. Our goal is to provide a platform for people to find new places present in our beautiful country and to provide a trusted platform for guides to promote tourism for both foreigners and the people of our country. The uniqueness of our project is that it will act as a bridge between clients (tourist) and companies which are willing to take people on trips to different places of Pakistan. In Pakistan right now companies are only working on social platforms like Facebook, Instagram etc. Our goal is to provide them with a platform which will be much easier for both the company and t he client to be easier access at a single platform. The companies will register and upgrade details of their trips with their cost. The client will get information about the trips by visiting our online platform. They will contact that company through our platform. By this, our platform will act as a middleman between client and companies. This will surely promote tourism by making it easier for tourists to easily access companies to guide them to the hidden places in Pakistan. On social media platforms, it is really difficult for people to find trips of their interest. To do so they have to visit different sites. This is a total wastage of time. Our goal is to minimize people effort by gathering companies on a single platform. This will surely save people e ffort. They only have to visit our online platform to get any information about tours of their interest. The client will contact the company through our platform and will hire a guide and will pay in return for their guiding services. By this, the company will generate profit and will pay us for our services for acting as a bridge and for promoting there company and tourism on our platform. Moreover the clients can generate their own events. The companies will contact the user and can bid on that event. The  user will respond to that bidding and will select the company of his/her own choice.

content: The goals and objectives of our project are listed below:-  Our goal is to provide a platform to companies providing them with an online application which will act as a bridge between clients and companies.  To build a time-saving web application for people so they do not have to waste searching for a trusted company.  To make it easier for tourists to develop and search for their particular trip.  To provide a good and user -friendly interface which will be easy to use as compared to the standard websites available on the internet.  To provide a good and user -friendly website with standard interface in comparison with other websites.

heading: Abstract
content: Travel Smart aims to allow smart management of road network and plan efficient traffic routes to avoid traffic jams. It will also provide maximum utilization of bus. Users can obtain bus services through our Smart Route app. They can check routes and pay charges of the selected bus through the app. The app will also act as a guidance system for the driver as it will alert the driver about traffic jams ahead and will advise an alternate route. Smart Route will be a huge advancement in the transportation technology. It will be a huge leap towards the automation as paying bus charges, selecting routes and avoiding traffic will be mere taps away.

heading: Introduction
content: Travel Smart app is divided into three modules each module with different functionality but are linked with each in some way. First module is for the bus drivers, every driver's data will be recorded in our database which will include their names and id given by  the companies and a GPS tracker device will be placed in every bus which will help us monitor their location. This device will keep us alert on the location of the bus. If in route of bus driver face traffic or any other road difficulties it will alert driver and the app will suggest driver a complete new route with destination remain same. Second module of the bus is for passengers. Passengers belonging to an institute who wish to avail their institute’s bus service have to pay their fees. A fee challan can be print from the website of our app. After he fee is payed the data will be directly updated in database. After paying fee passengers will have to install and launch the application, from there they will sign up for the service. The passengers will share their information which will include their home address. After all passengers who wish to avail the service have signed up for the service, the application will calculate how many passengers live in which areas of the city and based on that data the ap plication will make routes for the bus company . Routes marked out by the application will be based on maximum number of passengers not having to travel far to reach a bus stop, and efficiency in terms of traffic and speed.  After mapping out all different routes for the bus company, it will alert passengers about which bus stop they would need to reach and at what time to get on their respected bus. Since because of traffic and or other situations the bus can be late to arrive at a stop, so the passengers can use the application to check the current location of the bus. And in a situation when a user feels they are running late, they can use the application to figure out how much extra time they potentially have to reach the bus stop and still catch the bus.  Or if they should move towards the next bus stop instead.

heading: Objectives
content:  Passengers are able to sign up for their institute’s bus service and share their home address.  Based on home address of all passengers who have signed up, the application will map out the most effective and efficient route for the bus company.  Help the bus company to figure how many buses would be required to run on a route if there are a lot of passengers for a single bus to handle.  The application will help passengers track location of the bus, how long will it take for their bus to reach their stop, and if a user is running late, help them make a decision which stop they should move towards in order to catch the bus.

content: The problem with the existing invoice applications is that they don’t adopt according to varying customer needs. Customer doesn’t have proper control over the service so with varying needs customers have to go from one service to another. Different Businesses have different type of services that they offer and different patterns of generating invoices and sending them to clients. Invoice generated for one business can’t necessarily fit for another business of same owner. Even if the customization is done for different businesses. It becomes very hard to maintain this customization on large scale with hundreds of thousands customers with multiple businesses. In this project we have proposed a solution to the above highlighted problem. This application namely “Go Invoice” has functionality of generating online invoices to customers. The methodology of the application is that the user creates an account on the website, then he/she enters the businesses/services which he/she is providing. Similarly a customer who is looking for a service will contact the user, user will generate online invoice and send the client via email. This application generates graphs on the maximum profit basis, most sold product basis, annual sale basis, daily sale basis, monthly sale basis & most profitable customer. Page 4 of 80  14 May 2018

heading: Introduction
content: Introduction of Topic In the past, ASP (Application Service Provider) Model was being used in which if we have multiple groups of users having different requirements from the other groups but the requirements inside the group are approximately same. In that case we’d to make different versions of the software to meet every group’s requirement, which increases the software updating, monitoring and maintenance overhead, With Multitenancy, the application data source is one, but the experience of different groups is completely different from each other according to their own requirements. Each group has isolated experience which doesn’t interfere with other groups. The data from the data source is filtered based on the requirements of that specific group and only the relevant data is showed.

heading: Objectives
content: The multi-tenant application will provide following features:  It will classify to which tenant each line of output goes.  It cannot permit cached data (e.g. views) to outflow between tenants.  It will isolated insistent data for each tenant and its operators.  It needs to identify the customer (or tenant) that any specific web request is for.  It needs isolated background jobs for each tenant.  It will has to keep apart configuration for each tenant. Introduction of the Application (Go-Invoice) This project covers the missing aspects of multi-tenancy in existing invoice apps by implementing the 3rd approach and accommodating tenants with varying needs. The main goal of this project is to redesign an existing invoice application. The existing invoice application uses a single tenant architecture, in this project the application implemented, and has a multi-tenant architecture. This Go Invoice application has functionality of generating online invoices to customers. The methodology of the application is that the user creates an account on the website, then he/she enters the businesses/services which he/she is providing. Similarly a customer who is looking for a service will contact the user, user will generate online invoice and send the client via email. This application generates graphs on the maximum profit basis, most sold product basis, annual sale basis, daily sale basis, monthly sale basis & most profitable customer. The application will generate monthly reports & annual reports. The user can have more than one businesses & one business can have many products. Every business will have different clients, the user will send invoices to those clients via email. This all is being handled using multi-tenant architecture. heading: Abstract
content: This project is about a Multi -tenant Application is our primary goal and it is designed on top of Laravel Framework based on the back end, and Angular 5 Framework based on the front end. Multi-tenancy is an architecture in which we host a single copy of software and this instance then serves multiple tenants. Tenant is a group of users with similar requirements, for instance the end- user of a specific organization or business. Tenant have the privilege to make changes in same parts of application for inst ance, change the theme color, or some business rules but they have no privilege to modify the underlying application’s code [1]. This Multi-Tenant Application includes a consolidated administration to conserve a common code based application and run common instances of application for multiple tenants. This procedure confirms that the personal data for each tenant is protected from any others tenant. Multi-tenant web applications are becoming very popular in recent times to deliver controlled code to the users of the same domain. There are many different architectures of developing such applications ranging from single database to different databases for each tenant. This application will only work as an intermediate between user and his clients. This appl ication will not provide any online inventory services to the client. The user can view product list, graphs, reports and lists of various businesses, clients & invoices . It will work as a platform where both major stakeholders who include users and minor stake holders which include clients, can get benefit from each other. Page 65 of 80  14 May 2018

heading: Abstract
content: Human identification is very important for security purposes. There are many unimodal biometrics in use for human identification but they rely on single source of biometric information due to which they are not able to produce most efficient result and they have one major problem, they are not useful if we have different biometric information from database. To increase efficiency and reliability, we proposed a method and developed a system which is capable of identify human by multiple source of biometrics information and by multiple features of a single biometric. For more discriminant results we appl y different classifier with different biometrics dataset, list and accuracy of these classifier with dataset is listed in table. Our system work with three different biometrics which include Face, Iris and Palm. System has multiple option, you can select any biometric to identify with or you can select live run time face recognition option. On the other hand we proposed feature level fusion to produce better accuracy. One more benefit of fusion is that it allow us to train system with multiple source of inf ormation but at testing or runtime we can test with a single and multiple source of information. We fuse multiple biometric as well as multiple feature of single biometric, HOG(Histogram of Oriented Gradient) and LBP(Linear Binary Pattern) is the main features used in our system and method. Image processing, computer vision and deep learning are the major technique s used in our system. ATT  (Face) dataset and BIT (Palm and Iris) dataset are used for system training and testing, for live identification we used own data which contains data of 8-10 persons information.

heading: Introduction
content: There are many dreadful activities happening on daily basis and many people lose their lives in these activities. To stop these activities, we require digital systems that can identify peoples. Best way to identify a person is through his/her biometric because biometric of every individuals is distinctive and measureable. Well known biometrics used for human identification are fingers print, iris, DNA and face. Every individual has different pattern of these biometrics. There are already many biometric systems available in market but mostly these systems are unimodal, means they rely on single modality of biometric. These kind of systems have low efficiency because unimodal system often face lack of accuracy due to noisy data. For more efficiency we are proposing a system that have both properties. It can use multiple modalities of biometrics or it can use multiple features of a single modality of biometric depends on situation and availability of individual’s data. In both cases we required fusion to combine different vectors in a single vector. The method of fusion can occur at three different level i.e. feature level, matching score level and decision level. At feature level, feature extracted from different modalities and combined for processing/training. At matching score level , feature from two or more modalities work alone and end scores are compared to produce answers. And at decision level feature from different modalities work alone and result are combined using techniques such as majority voting or s um rule. Decision level and matching score level are very popular in literature  methodologies because these fusion techniques are simple and applied on obtained results. But feature level is more efficient than these two level because of its more discrimin ant power and it work with features rather than results. In our proposed methodology it is proved that fusion is better when single modality fail to provide better accuracy. So fusion at feature level is believed to provide more efficient results [2]. Feature level consider as more difficult from other because in feature level vector from two or more modalities are combined into a single one to produce results that’s why this fusion considered more discriminant. Gesture recognition [3] also become optimize by this feature level based methods by combining the different gestures. Our system also work with  feature level fusion because efficiency is always  priority of security systems and feature level fusion provide more efficiency then others. Scope of our system is not just bounded to one technique, but it can work as single unimodal to work with single biometric as well as it can work as multimodal with two techniques. First is it use two features of a biometric and second is two biometrics with single or multiple features. For instance, we use face as single biometric system will extract pattern of more than one feature such as Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) and Local binary pattern (LBP) and combine them to match from database or  we take face and palm  as our two biometrics, our system will extract pattern template of face and iris and combine them to match from database. Many other biometrics can be used in this like gait, fingerprints   etc. For training of our system ATT face datasets, BIT Iris datasets and BIT Palm datasets are used. For runtime identification we trained system with our own face datasets.

heading: Scope
content: We are making a system by fusing multiple feature of single biometric a nd multiple biometric. This wil l allow system to work as unimo dal and multimodal. In our project scope three biometrics are c onsidered, two of them is Face and Iris, and third one is Palm which is considered as week biometric. HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradient) and LBP (Linear Binary Pattern) are the feature descriptor used for every biometrics. These biometrics are trained wi th two classifiers NN (Neural Network) and SVM (Support Vector Machine). For multimodal, feature level fusion technique is proposed, both feature descriptor are fused for single biometric multi feature requirement and same feature of two and three biometric are fused for multi biometric fusion requirement.

heading: Introduction
content: Our project is a Multiplayer online card game which we named Getaway. The game is played all around the world especially in Pakistan and India and is one of the most played games which uses a sta ndard deck of cards, since now, people have been playing this game with real cards physical ly by planning a meet, they physically had to be together to play the game, so we have decided to provide a digital mobile version of the game to the players to play with their family and friends anyti me anywhere without having to arrange a meeting to play. We believe that this digital version of the gam e will provide the more entertainment to the players as people are more prone to use smartphones. This game will  also save time and effort of having to go somewhere and play just by sitting and using their  smartphone from wherever they are. Internet availability is not an issue since everyone owns an internet con nection in their homes or have mobile data when outside. The main topic of our development is the implementation of an online multiplayer  architecture and structure, how the client side app will communicate with each other through the server and to synchronize and allow communication among the connected client apps. Our game is a turn based [6] multiplayer game meaning that out of all the connected players in a match one player can take a turn at a time which is conveyed to the server and then the server updates the rest of the connected clients, conse quently the other players in the match will be able to see the action taken by the user who to ok the turn, and then the flow of the game will continue allowing the next player in the match to take the turn according to the rules of the game. We are using Unity 3D engine for our client side app (The interface of t he game) although most of the aspects of the game are in 2D. All the card models and logic will be implemented in unity engine with the programming language C# to code. Built in android plugin is available to support android smart phones (the platform of our game). Photon Networking is used to implement the online multiplayer aspect of our game. 48 cards (Jacks dealt out of the game) are distributed among 4 players in the match. These card are random and distributed by the master client after shuffling. 12 card are given to ea ch client and on the count of 4 players in game the match starts. Master client always takes the first  turn and then the game flow starts in clockwise direction. Each card here is drag-able within the hand to users to arrange their cards as they want and they can double click or double touch to throw a card.

heading: Objectives
content: Our android app is for everyone; children, adults and old people since the game is played among all these age groups so we need: 1. A good and simple interaction design for all the targeted audience. Children and adul ts are usually experts when it comes to operating smartphones and can easily understand and u se the app. A design for old people is the main crux, since a design that is acceptable by  old people will automatically be acceptable by the other age groups but without having to compromise some advanced functionalitie s for expert users (like shortcuts etc.). So we have to design to simple and interactive interface for the app. 2. Our main goal is to provide the most precise version of the game since there exis ts some variants which have slightly different rule sets. 3. A server lobby where all the available servers hosting the game should be displayed. 4. A player lobby inside the server where all 4 connected players show up. 5. Provide entertainment through secondary functionalities like in-game chat both text and voice since the main purpose of our project is life like entertainment. 6. Develop the app before the deadline without any errors or bugs through testing. These are the main objectives of our projects and we look forward to fulfilling these according to the best of our knowledge.

heading: Problem Statement
content:  Since the presence of different versions of the game there exists different rule sets fo r different versions. People play the same game with slightly different rules which m ight be due to limited knowledge of the original rules or the rules were deliberately  modified and then spread and played by people whoever liked the rules according to their needs. This is the critical problem for our app, in Pakistan alone 3 to 4 different rule sets exist  and no wonder how many in other countries.  We hope to provide the most authentic rule set in our game which shall be followed by all the people.  Since we are using a third party cloud networking service for our game, there can be times when the services are offline with us not knowing.

content: Usually games have both online multiplayer and offline single player against AI bot s (computer), the main focus of our project is to provide multiplayer so if we have time we would try to create single player as well because sometimes a user ’s friends might be busy and they may not like to play against strangers so they can play single player mode against AI bots. heading: Abstract
content: Using the client server architecture we are allowing the users to play online wit h their friends through a server. The game provides a digital platform for this card game. 4 players are requi red to start a match, they can be strangers from the internet or their own friends that the user adde d through their unique alias or email. The client (user end) interface displays the game layout and cards where the users plays their moves which then get updated to the server, the server updates the move to all the connec ted clients so they can see what their opponent did. This is a turn base multiplayer game meaning onl y one user is allowed to take turn at a time and then others are allowed to take turns accordin g to the rules and flow of the game. The user are offered casual and competitive modes, where they can play casual ly without any worries or compete for higher ranks against other players of their skill lev el. This way players can increase their rank and show-off to their close ones of their skill level.

content: Since internet is not always available to the user, a mode should exist to allow them to play offline against AI bots as opponents. heading: Introduction
content: Pakistan is a famous tourist and vacation spot for local as well as foreign tourists. People from all over the world come to visit Pakistan and see its pleasing beauty and astounding cultural heritage. In the past few years the tourism industry was greatly affected by terrorism, but due to military’s operations against terrorists in northern areas and improvement in the infrastructure the security situation is con siderably improved. Now once again Pakistan’s tourism industry is growing rapidly. Pakistan Tourism Development Corporation (PTDC) data showed that foreign tourists have increased three times since 2013 to 1.75 million in 2016, while local tourists have jumped to 38.3 million. Domestic travel spending is expected to increase 5.3 percent in 2017 to Rs1.24 trillion and jump 5.6 percent per year to Rs2.13 trillion in 2027 [1]. The tourism industry contributed 7% to total GDP of the country in 2017 [2]. The attractions for tourists in Pakistan ranges from the historical areas of ancient Indus Valley civilization to the peaks of northern areas. Pakistan is fortunate to have some of the highest peaks in the world. The weather conditions and breath-taking sights of hills in northern areas make them a heaven for tourists. Due to advancements in technology every area of our lives has been affected so is the tourism industry. We are blessed to be born in the era of information technology, now almost everyone has access to a smartphone and internet. Information Technology has empowered people to stay in touch with others all around the world and made our lives easier than they were ever before. The traditional ways of planning our trips by doing everything ourselves from  booking tickets to selecting the place to stay and places to visit. People now a day like their trips to be planned from the comfort of their home. A lot of local, small and large tour planners are there for this purpose. These tour planners plan the comp lete trip for you, if someone wish to go on a trip they simply have to register themselves with the tour planner of their choice and they are ready to go without any hassle of planning the trip themselves. Developed countries are using information technolo gy start-ups like AirBnB and TripAdvisor to make travelling safe, easier and fun for all people in the world [3]. Whereas in our country there is a huge space for development in this industry. The problem is that there is no unique platform Page 13 of 114  December 27, 2018 for tourists to find a suitable trip, they have to search a lot to find a tour planner or tour package of their liking also tour planners doesn’t have a similar platform to post the details of tours, packages and offers provided by them, they have to post the details of tours on different social media platforms and forums. Moreover, in Pakistan you have the option to either travel with a group or plan the complete trip yourself. We aren’t aware of the good places to stay and places to visit during the trip. The purpose of this application (TriPlan) is to provide a unique platform to all the tourists and tour planners. The platform will allow the tourists to see the details of tours posted and notified by different tour planners so they can select the trip of their choice e asily without hectic searching. Moreover, this application will allow tour planners to  create trips according to their own choices and post it with the  details of the t rip, packages and discounts provided by them. Besides tour planner’s individuals can als o post details of a tour so anyone can join their tour  by booking it . Due to all the information at a single platform about all the trips arranged by different tour planners it will be easy for everyone to choose the best tour/trip according to their budget, taste and availability. Tourists will also be able to check the reviews/ratings given to different tour planners by other tourists after completing trips with them  and decide which tour planner or trip will be suitable for them. heading: Abstract
content: The aim of the proposed project is to develop a marker based augmented reality android application named “AREd” (Augmented Reality Education). The traditional way of teachin g doesn’t seem to engage the students fully into studying. Students need visuals to get them motivated to study. This application’s basic purpose is to make the learning experience more interesting, lasting and interactive. Motivation behind AREd app is that students can get fuller understanding of a concept relating to what they are studying if they get to view 3D model of that abstract idea. For example, if a student is studying biology and wants to see the structure of human organs like brain, and for better understanding, the student can use AREd application to view the 3D model of brain and interact with it. AREd application will be used to generate 3D models of human anatomy for anatomy students. The 3D models can be seen by scanning the desired target  image through a smartphone’s camera. Once the target image (digital or printed fro m website) gets scanned, the application will generate interactive 3D model (a model which you can rotate and scaled around on screen.).The interactive 3D models will provide better understanding of concepts related to human anatomy. This application will make the learning through augmented reality quite engaging. Sometimes what the student has understood can be incorrect, so proper visualization of their study material will clear away any misconceptions. It would be very helpful in educational sector for students to interact with 3D models and make learning interesting like never before. It would be beneficial for teachers to teach in an innovative way as well. Table of Contents Evaluation ................................ ................................ ......... Error! heading: Abstract
content: COMSATS Programs and Courses Outcomes System (CPACOS) is being developed in order to compete with other educational institutes in developed countries to do this  there are some parameters defined by their institutes that our educational institutes have to fulfil  first. Their institutes have built their educational principles upon Bloom’s taxonomy  and is one o f the frequently used procedure for distinguishing and organizing levels of expertise  in a particular domain. There are currently many assessment models serving as single online platform both for students and faculty which allows them to perform their corresponding roles causing problems like not knowing how the learner performed in a specific content rather following a traditional system. CPACOS got enough potential to match up with them even it is better as platforms like  that are not into working mode, by providing Outcome Based Learning and Course Based Learning where the Faculty will be able to define their objectives and how they will demonstrate significant and important lea rning that learners will learn  to initiate a new assessment criteria break ing the traditional one. CPACOS is one such web application that is built on the principles and standards of Bloom’s Taxonomy.

heading: Introduction
content: In this chapter we will discuss about our projects its goals and objectives, the problems in the existing system and how we have encountered them.

heading: Introduction
content: CPACOS will use the  concept of Bloom’s Taxonomy which will tell the level of knowledge to achieve the required results.  Differentiating and establishing quantifiable student results in this manner will help us to choose the desirable evaluation methods such as assignments, quizzes or by conducting vivas for a particular course. There are information-oriented areas, ability-oriented areas, and affecting areas. Remembering, Understanding, Applying, Analyzing, Evaluating, and Creating are the application used for the concept of Bloom’s Taxonomy. So, it is about time that the educational world will see a platform that is going to address all assessment and learning issues. This one will be going to be revolutionize the universities assessment system. CPACOS has also used the idea of OBL (Outcome Based Learning) [4] as well as CBL (Course Based Learning) that will be a check to define how good or bad a student is in a given topic and course. These measurable student outcomes will eventually allow  us to easily differentiate the students with higher level of expertise  in a certain areas  and those who have lower level of expertise lacking in certain areas . By applying the idea of Bloom's Taxonomy  much described branch OBE, CPACOS will provide a much convenient and flexible way to dictate the degree to which the students are comprehending and using concepts in order to demonstrate particular skills. This will also show their interest ratio towards particular content of the course. In addition to that this will also help in planning and designing the assessments techniques.  This will also help to assess the instructors by mapping the objectives which they have decided to achieve through the course. By giving the complete report about the assessments and the objectives met to deliver an outcome. However, when it will deploy it will have a more generalized look. Although, that CPACOS is built for COMSATS, still if other educational institutes will feel the need to use this. It can be customized as well for them.

heading: Objectives
content: This will provide a platform where it will show Students interest ratio towards particular course. In addition to that this will also help in planning and designing the assessments techniques.  Evaluating the course content deliverables as well as Students expertise.  Improve the overall assessment system in Pakistan.  We want to address the issues in the current assessment system which isn’t providing any healthy competition need to make well-skilled individuals.  Manage the Assessment criteria of evaluation.  Relationship between Course Learning Outcomes and Program Learning Outcomes.  Provide Assessment Plan for the Course and identify key aspects of learning.  Deliver direct Assessment.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Although many online systems are currently giving a platform where Faculty are given the ease to perform their tasks online like Add Attendance, Add Marks etc. Giving each student a specific login so that he/she can view his/her progress. Only allowing the faculty to upload marks of the whole assessment making it unclear about how the student performed in the specific content of the course or whether the objectives of the course are met or not.  But we thought that there is a need of a system where Faculty can add assessment marks on the basis of specific contents of the course being taught by the instructor and delivering an outcome which is suitable enough to contribute to their skills as Pakistan is a developing country and the current education system isn’t competitive enough to cope u p with the developed countries so  we want to develop  a system where faculty and student both will know their progress not only in a specific course but also in the co ntents of that specific course.

heading: Scope
content: IT sector is progressing so rapidly and we have the capability to automate such systems and contribute in the educational sector. We are completely optimistic about the scope of this one as it has introduced a simpler and more efficient way for coping with the troubles and give us a new direction in educational world. It will help faculty for the better understanding of concerns, traits and trends to make better decision making regarding course content. Eventually, universities will realize the significance of such platforms sooner or later they will feel the need to adopt it in order to s urvive in this competitive age.  We believe educational institutes will use CPACOS to implement the concept of direct evaluation.

content: Time has been changed and now people are tended to shop online rather than to go out to the stores and look for their desired items in different stores wasting too much time. Another reason why people are moving towards online shopping is that they are looking for exciting deals in which they get their desired products with discounted price. Although people still go out for shopping, but the trend is now changing.  Customers here in Pakistan also looks for deals and unfortunately, they hardly get good deals because of several reasons. Shopit aims at providing shopping products from American websites for Pakistani customers. Shopit provides exciting deals directly from American online shops to Pakistani customers. All the deals  from different online shops are first fetched and stored at Shopit database. Then all those deals are regularly  posted on Shopit website where Pakistani customers can see them. Customers here in Pakistan can post orders and Shopit system will generate bill in dollars w.r.t to order including shipping price. The orders are then forwarded to American online shopping store. The American website that we  have used initially are Deals2Buy.com, NewEgg Marketplace, NewEgg.com. Shipment is very important process in whole system and Shopit guarantees fast, steady and reliable shipping service for orders delivery.  The system also allows customers to communicate real time with Shopit representative for their queries. For the owners  of system , it allows to carefully analyze and generate different type of reports and graphs i.e. sales, revenue, order graphs and reports  for analysis purpose. heading: Introduction
content: Cloud based IT Resource Provisioning is a web-based application which provides a virtual machine to the users (FYP Students) with installed windows or Linux operating system. The user can use virtual machine for testing of these projects for those higher hardware is required. These virtual machine s also provide the user installed software in the operating system according to his requirements. Every time when a new user requests for the virtual machine, he gets the newly installed operating system in the virtual machine to avoid the viruses which may affect the user’s system or affect the performance of the virtual machine. In these machines, the user can choose the RAM and Hard -drive according to his requirements so he can perform his task in these machines which he was unable to perform on his own. Although there are many cloud-based applications, used successfully and are being utilized in many applications as a fleet. Most of them use the Software as a service (SaaS) or Platform as a service (PaaS) but our application will work on Infrastructure a s a Service (IaaS). The application will provide the web page where user can choose the software which he wants in the virtual machine and specification of the machine and also select the operating system. Web page interacts with the hypervisor through controller then hypervisor provides virtual machine to the user according to his requirements. Live Migration between the servers is also used in this application when one server is over loaded. It provides more than one virtual machine at a time. Application will also have billing and monitoring module, Bill is decided on specification of the virtual machine and time interval in which the user uses our services. The billing module has been created in such a way that when the user tries to delete the VM that he has created. The bill is calculated according to the date at which the VM was created and the date at which the user deletes the VM.

heading: Abstract
content: Drive N Deliver is an on-demand delivery network application designed to enable people to send/receive packages from one place to another. It also enables people to earn money while commuting on their destination. Furthermore, people who are transporters by profession or courier/freight delivery companies can use the application to further increase their customers.

heading: Introduction
content: Drive N Deliver is a delivery network application designed to meet the needs of modern fast paced and comfort able lifestyle. The application allows anyone to send a package which can be small as an envelope and as large as furniture, from one location to another without having the need to move from the comfort of one’s home or where ever he may be at.  Transporters can view the package and offer to transport it to the desired destination. The sender/receiver must register with the application before being able to create a package for delivery, the transporter must also register with the application but for safety purposes they must provide scan of their driving license and registration information of their vehicle along with their other personal information. After the sender has gone through all the steps of creating a package in the application he can then view the estimate cost of the delivery. The package can then be viewed by all the transporter. The transporters will offer to transport the package, this offer will be sent to the sender who can then view the transporters profile, as there can be multiple offers the sender can choose one amongst them. Upon selection of the transporter by the sender, the transporter will arrive at the pickup point to get the package and will deliver the package at the set destination. The sender can also track their package while it  is in transit. If the sender wishes to cancel the package he must do it before the transporter arrives to pick up the package.

heading: Objectives
content:  Allows people to make money while going on their daily commute as they may take up the role of the transporters.  This will help people save time and fuel. Instead of going to their nearest courier service outlet or for finding a transporter for large items such as furniture.  People who are transporters by profession can find work using this application  People will be able to send packages from anywhere without having the need to go to their nearest courier service shop.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Nowadays people are becoming busier day by day, people cannot afford to waste time in small chores hence our application aims to provide on demand delivery service to people anywhere they may be. Also the cost of commuting is rising these days hence we aim to provide an opportunity to general populace to help them r educe their commuting expenses.

heading: Scope
content: The scope of this application is to provide a service where people who, want to send a package, can easily find people who are willing to pick up their package from desired location and deliver it to their respective destination. On the other side people who are commuting are provided an opportunity to cover their travel expenses.

heading: Functional Requirements
content:  Creating package for delivery. The sender can use this feature to make a new package for delivery by taking its photo, selecting the type of transport and transporter and specifying pick up point and destination.  Tracking Delivery Process. Google map API will allow the sender to tracks his package in real time.  Viewing Packages for transporting. This feature will allow the users of the transporter application  to view  the packages that are available for delivery.  The application offers 3 ways of viewing the packages, all packages, nearby packages & enroute.  Transporter bid for packages. The transporter can bid to transport any given package.  Transporter profile viewership for Senders (ratings).

heading: Abstract
content: Everyday life of a busy person gets  more hectic with the amount of work they are occupied with. There is not time to perform some tasks out of a daily routine; a daily commute could be made much better if it helped somebody and earned the driver some money. Our app is set out to provide the general populace the best of both worlds. On demand, fast & efficient delivery without any hassle, as well as monetizing a daily commute at personal ease.

heading: Conclusion
content: Working with actual robot for perceptual semantics and to establish resemblance between perception and knowledge is very expensive and time consuming. To deal with such kind of problem, a virtual robot is able to understand and identify the objects through  semantic memory. Perceptual semantic ability in robotics is a first step to symbol grounding problem. Perception is an identification of an object. Semantic is a usability of particular object. Mapping of perception and semantics is a cognitive behavior of an agent. For this project, we worked on two operating systems; Ubuntu and Windows. On Ubuntu, we dealt with perceptual memory.  MORSE simulator is used for virtual robot. ROS is acting as a middlew are between MORSE and YOLO  to access the sensors of robo t and to apply detection algorithm.  At the backend of YOLO , COCO model’s dataset is used for object detection which is serving as a perceptual memory. On Windows, a Neo4j database is used as a semantic memory which communicates with thrift server running over localhost. Thrift server receives object detection perceptual string from thrift client runnin g on Ubuntu embedded with YOLO  code. After receiving string, thrift will pass string to neo4j through python code and neo4j query. Query will return list of semantics and send these semantics through thrift server on Ubuntu. Thrift client will receive this string. By integrating the work of Windows and Ubuntu, we built cognitive architecture for virtual robot by using perceptual semantics as a foundation and achieved our project requirements.

heading: Introduction
content: The idea is to make an entertainment application that gets a user image and compares the image with hundreds of celebrity pictures and provide the most resembling (celebrity) image on the bases of facial features and resemblance percentage. After matching and comparison, the application would apply a live face -map of celebrity image on the user’s face, giving an impression of celebrity.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Face recognition and augmented reality filters are new and interesting applications of modern world, MyCelebMatch is a project that combines the two major interests in a single application. Where the user can upload his/her image on both Android and Web browser to find his closest resembling face match in the celebrities around the world. Along wit h finding a match this application would also be able to augmentedly apply the facial features of the celebrity on user's face.

heading: Related Work
content: The live face mapping techniques are currently being used by various applications on net but they only use the Vector based (2D animated) images to be mapped on user face, hence it is not much useful but can be made far more interesting, by using real and Raster based celebrity images. Snapchat: It is a 14.3 billion Dollar enterprise [1], that also started with a similar project, based on augmented facial filters. The filters consist of vector graphics that ar e separately designed for specific purposes. The Figure: 1  shows some screenshots of the application that allows live animated face filters. Figure 1: (Augmented face mapping in Snapchat) [2] Masquerade: (MSQRD) is   a   mobile   application   that allows users to change their human appearance during video -chats in real time. The application is based on the 3D face tracking technology, works on both iOS and Android. MSQRD creates animated masks and places them over human faces. Each mask exactl y fits the user’s facial features and repeats his or her movements. The full application name is “Masquerade – animated masks for selfie -videos.”[3] The application uses some specific filters that are vector in nature and can be overlaid on the face of user. The figure 2 shows some screenshots of the Masquerade application that allows live face mapping to users with preinstalled face filters. Figure 2: MSQRD (Masquerade) App - Live Filters for Selfies & Videos [4]
