heading: Abstract
content: ‘Career Counselling System’ is platform for providing information and knowledge to guide students for choosing a particular field for Studies. It is basically a web application system And an Android App that Consists of Taking Quiz for Evaluation. There are two participants, administrator and the students. Administrator shall use this system to conduct quizzes and tests. Students on the other hand shal l test their skills and knowledge here by taking a Quiz. Career counselling in short is an information and knowledge providing platform for students having 12 years of Education to help them select a Career for further studies. Table of Contents

heading: Introduction
content: Career Guidance Platform Consists of a Laravel Web Application  and an Android application, where students can see various career opportunities for graduation After having 12 years of Education.Students Can Visit Website Where they  shall Signup and/or login into the System. Initially They Fills an interest form. Next the system allows user to give a t est which is a series of Quizzes of different academic Subjects. After test completion a score is calculated for test. Based on those results the system manipulates and calculates the best career or degree program for that  user/ Student.The system also includes an Ebook Library. Here user may click to read career guidance ebooks in their browser. With Increasing the use of smartphone each a day , user can have Access to the Quizzes Via an Android application. He/ she Shall R egister/Signin to take Quiz.After taking Quiz the Result will be Shown . And Then Student May want to access Ebook Library for gaining more Knowledge about Technical Skills,   System allows robustness and enhances experience by handling a huge number of visitors with efficiency. The admin can login to the Website and Update Quiz  and Ebooks Available.  Changes made in Database will Depict in the the android app too because both the laravel app and the android app share the database . However android app do not  have an admin panel So these changes (Add/Delete Quiz/Ebook) can not be made through Android app.

heading: Objectives
content: The objective of this project is to provide up to date information and knowledge to students who are seeking a specific career path and are interested in seeking new knowledge and information. Our web application shall provide information about Preparing for several universities and colleges Entrance test by preparing Students through Quizzes .Career guidance (counselling) system also pro vides Several Ebooks for Technical Knowledge. System conducts Quiz checking an individual’s Academic Knowledge, and general knowledge.On the basis of it, it shall generate a Result / Report that will guide the students in their related fields.

heading: Problem Statement
content: The problem lies in that specific phase of student’s life where they are unsure as to what path they must choose to ensure their success in the future. This problem specifically occurs after they have completed their F.SC and/ Equivalent program. Our Caree r Counselling System provides a solution to this specific problem. It creates a wide and open platform for students to check their knowledge and Interest upon Which a Report /Suggestion is Generated. Students gain insight to their capabilities and put on t he right track where they are benefited in the future.

heading: Scope
content: Career Counselling Systems are common now - a-days. As the increasing level of competition in all the fields and less job opportunities people are often worried about their future. Hence they need proper guidance where to go and where to put their skill set to the test. Our scope of project is to provide information and knowledge related to academic level and to ensure proper academic achievements and qualification.  Our web application is a proper platform for con ducting tests and generating r esults that define the Knowledge of students.With the rapid growth of technology people find it more convenient to use an android application other than visiting a website Therefore  One can Also have acce ss Through a simple Android App available to take the Quiz.

heading: Literature Review
content: There is a lot of work done by foreign colleges and universities for career guidance including some Pakistani univ ersities like GCU and some others by organizing a career guidance program where students can go for a professional career and guidance for higher studies. But there's no such program available online for students having 12 years of education in Pakistan.

heading: Introduction
content: Today is the Time of Technology. Internet has changed the World into a Global Village and from that point forward a BOOM of technology shifted the World and Humans into a new Path. This Path has many new Scientific Theories, Inventions, Innovations and Gadgets. All these things were made in accordance to Humans requirements to help make their daily life easy. But with many Companies releasing all these new Gadgets every day, there comes a problem in selecting the gadget you require for your needs. Since these multiple gadgets have a single purpose, it is quite difficult and frustrating to select a single gadget for your needs among many and most of the times People ends up selecting either expensive or wrong or not so compatible gadget for their needs. Our Project is an Online Tool/Website that will ease up the selection process of any Gadget for consumer. The consumer or user will simply specify the primary attributes that they require in the gadget and it will automatica lly compare the gadgets and then select the One that suits the consumer’s needs the most. This Online Website will save User from reading and comparing technical specifications or having to search online about the product. Since there are thousands of gadgets now available at this time, we will start with only one gadget. For that, we choose the most widely used gadget called “Smart Phones”. Since we are developing a tool to ease up selection process for consumer, we have to design a very user friendly interface that can provide great user experience so that user don’t have to scratch their way through website. We want to keep it as simple and friendly as possible. User will be presented with primary attributes of the smart phone or user can change selection attribute from listed attributes. They will prioritize the attributes they want or prefer more by modifying the given graph accordingly, it will dynamically compare the smart phones as user prioritize the attributes and in the end it will select a smart p hone that contains the required attributes or functions thus easing up the selection process.

heading: Objectives
content: The outcome of the Project is an online website that will compare and select a gadget on behalf of the user’s preferred attributes or functions. It will ease up the selection process for user and user can decide whether to buy that gadget or not.  User will be able to surf through different cell-phones.  User will not have to read lots of technical specifications.  User can easily find a gadget suited for their requirements.  User will have access to millions of gadgets (cell-phones) at a single place.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Mostly people buy products by just considering the Brand Name such as Samsung or Sony and there are some who thinks that if it is costly it must be good such as Apple. Just because the gadget is famous doesn’t mean that it is good or is made for you. Sometimes you can get a much better gadget by spending less money on the right thing if you know what are you buying or you are looking for or you do a little research. But all of this stuff requires brainstorming or spending some time online doing research and lot of people don’t want to do that. Problem with current comparison website on internet is that they compare technical specs of gadgets and to fully utilize these websites capability user needs to have a lot of technical information on the product they want to buy and spend a quite amount of time reading them. The motivation for this website are following:  Consumers don’t know what they are buying.  Consumers had to brainstorm what to buy.  Consumers don’t know whether they are buying the right product.  The gadget they bought was worth the prices or not. So this website will do all of that for them save them from this hectic process and help them in finding/selecting the best possible product for them.

heading: Scope
content: This Project is an Online Gadget Selector that will help consumer select and decide a gadget on consumer’s behalf according to information provided to meet their requirements or needs. System is being design to avoid buying mistakes and make selecting process easier for people who wants to buy a gadget but don’t know what to buy or have technical information regarding their desired smartphone. This Project will be completed and tested before January 2018.

heading: Abstract
content: The aim of this project is to provide a quality rehabilitation and improve the lives of physically disabled people. This project provides the users an application t hrough which they can communicate with their Doctors/ Family and can easily control their surroundings by just blinking and controlling their attention and meditation level s. We use Neuro Sky MindWave EEG (Electroencephalogram) headset to monitor the patien ts’ attention and meditation levels as well as their blink strength. This information allows the user to select between different options, one for Home Automation, second for communication and few more to ease his/her daily life. The patient will be able t o select these options through his/her intentional eye blinks. Communication will allow the user to type in words through an On -Screen Keyboard and then use text -to-speech method to convey their message effectively. Home Automation will allow the user to c ontrol the Lights, Fan and different House appliances of his/her room. Motivating a physically handicapped person back to health can be a very difficult job due to premorbid personality, handicap and the difficulty faced by the patients to communicate with their doctors and family. This Project improves the basic ability  of th e patient  to increase his/her  motivation to have a successful rehabilitation. Successful Rehabilitation must focus on practical ways of coping with daily life. Physical impairment can increase inferiority feelings and the need for dependency which can create a major setback in the patient’s life, taking a major psychology toll on the patient and increases the risk of stress and tension related disease . With the help of this project the patient can feel independent and as he/she can communicate and control the surroundings he will be plenty motivated to get back to his/her life.

For example paralysis, spinal cord injury, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) and brain stroke. Under such circumstances, it is impossible for a disabled person to communicate. A BCI-based application enables the user to communicate and control the appliances. The Brain activity of the individual is detected using EEG sensors, these signals can be used by BCI application as an input to communicate and control the appliances. In 2015 the national assembly passed a bill that stated that every public park and building must have a ramp in addition to stairs to make it assessable for the physically disabled.

heading: Abstract
content: The aim of this project is to develop an automated programming assignment assessment system that can check Java Programming assignments. We have developed an assignment submission portal, on which Instructor and students registered themselves. An instructor creates a class and Students joins that class. Further, Instructor uploa ds an assignment which is solved by each student and submit it before the deadline. The assignment is then assessed by the Instructor. The assessment criteria in based on syntax checking, coding standards, plagiarism checker, execution time and testing by running it on different test cases. An instructor can also evaluate the assignment manually. After a successful evaluation, a report is generated. Furthermore, a separate question repository for each Instructor is also developed where a question along with their answer is stored for future use and it is updated each time teacher uploads a new question.

heading: Introduction
content: With the emergence of technology, rapid progress taking place in every field including computer sciences. For the ease of mankind, this computerized innovation has brought a significant change in many areas including education. For saving time and effort, manual checking procedures and documentation have to replace by automation tools and systems. In the educational system, these tools and system serve in many ways like online documentation, filling forms, mathematical problems, and examine ass ignments etc (Ala -Mutka, 2005) [1] . Computer field like programming mostly contains coding assignments that must be evaluat ed on different criteria, which require a lot of time and effort. A practicable solution is the automation of the assessment system which includes assignment checking, plagiarism checking, code analysis, coding mistake analysis etc. [2].  In this project, our main purpose is to develop an online assessment system which helps students and teachers equally in educational life. In this project, we have developed a web application in which teacher creates a class and students join that class. For assignment te acher upload the assignment with its possible solution(s) and assignment deadline must be mentioned by the teacher before submitting the question. A student then tries to solve the assignment and uploaded their solution. After the deadline has been ended. The teacher has an authority to check the assignment by just clicking one button and all the assignment of whole class has been checked. Checking has been made on several bases,  First part is code analyzer that analyzes the code for the coding standards.  The Second part is the Syntactic Analyzer that checks the syntax mistakes.  The Third part is the Plagiarism checker  that checks all the plagiarism between assignments.  The Forth part is  the Compile and Run  that runs the assignment on different user defined test cases and give grades according to it.  The Fifth part is Execution Time Checking, it checks the total execution time of the assignments and gives grades according to the results.  Sixth and the last is Additional Marking Criteria’s, criteria like Number of for Loop, Number of Methods, Number of Objects etc.

heading: Objectives
content: Followings are the Objective of our proposed project:  The main objective of this project is to develop an automated assessment system.  To saves a lot of teacher or instructor time, and there are fewer chances of mistake.  Through this Student learn good programming practices.  Different standard style guidelines are also guided to the student.  Style guidelines to check function length or naming conventions are part of this.  Syntax mistake are also analyzed and marks are given according to their importance.  Plagiarism is also being checked between assignments of students.  Report is generated with all the grades and mistake mentioned on it. We achieve all these objectives by designing these five main modules.

heading: Abstract
content: With the speedy invention in the computerized technology there was a need of having all such innovations to be gathered at a single place. For this purpose, a new technology was introduced named as Internet of Things (IoT). This emerging technology (IoT), can be someone having a small gadget implanted in the body, a farm animal with a biochip in it, or a car with implanted sensors to aware the driver when tire pressure is below the level, or any other object that may be assigned by an IP address and a power  is provided to transfer information over a network. (IoT) can play a vital role in the health. Health is one of the most important factors for every person and in order to maintain the good health exercise is the key. Therefore, every person requires doing specific amount of exercise  on daily basis which may vary  on the basis of age and health conditions of individuals. This exercise also includes daily life activities. Only if we can get the amount of the exercise from or daily activities we can assure that we have achieved our daily goal. With the help of IoT we can monitor our daily activities by implanting wearable’s and sensors where needed. We are developing an activity based smart health management system using (IoT) which will use the data from wearable’s and extract the amount of exercise from it. Then using it this data will be transmitted to android apps which is connecting the user and doctor. Doctor can prescribe him medicines after checking his performance. We also have an additional service of hiring a physician who can check his diets plans and all other routine body changes. The user will also get notification on his smart phone of his goals and his daily achievements either they are fulfilled or not. Whereas the doctor and physician are also  notified about their patient’s progress.  Every new order by the doctor  and nutritionist will also be notified. With the help of this system one can ensure that his daily activities are fulfilling the amount of exercise required by his/her body. Our user will feel secure about his health and fitness. heading: Introduction
content: Good health is the real jewel of the world which can lead us to every luxury of life; it’s the real possession of a man. The famous Dalai Lama explained the importance of health as he was asked about the most surprising thing of the humanity his reply was “A man sacrifices his health to make money and then he spends all this to recuperate his health. Man is always worried about his future instead he forgets the joy of present, and at the end he does live nor in present neither in future. And he lives thinking that he is never going of die but all in vain he dies having really never lived.” That all concluded was that first wealth is always health. A healthy life can be obtained by exercise which reduces the risk factors of many chronic diseases like heart failure, diabetes, stress and obesity. Exercise would also reduce economic burden of one’s family by reducing risks of lifestyl e disorders. People have a misconception that exercise is done by only going to fitness centres but that is wrong. Our body performs exercise by our daily routine too. As the modern era is affecting our lives too much, so in order to track those actions an d routines we are developing an application that would be calculating the amount of exercise done by user’s body. Our major focus on exercise was due to its benefits not in terms of that it gains or pumps up your muscles but it also improves one’s mental h ealth. Following are the benefits that exercise can give are: o These days the routines are getting tough and tough day by day so the people are mostly facing from stress and they cannot focus on their health so for such people exercise is the key to get relief from their stress. It increases norepinephrine a chemical that moderates the brain against stress.  o Exercise releases endorphins which create happiness and euphoria.  o More and more exercise increases cells in hippocampus which is responsible for memory and learning.  Page 10 of 86 o Brain releases dopamine in return to any form of pleasure like sex, drug addiction. Exercise can help us to recover quickly and can distract drug addicts.  o No need of sleeping pills now even for the people suffering with insomnia, a moderate workout can do it for you.  o The more intense you do a physical activity the more you burn your calories and can easily control your weight. Consistency is the key.  Regular exercise helps you to fight against health conditions and diseases. And you ca n be an inspiration for many others. Some facts and figures provided by the World Health Organization about different age factors are: People aging 5–17 needs to do exercise for at least an hour with full intensity physical activity daily. Such activities or exercises should be taken in a free oxygen environment. High intensity exercises should be given a higher priority, in addition to all those that increases muscle and bone strength at least thrice a week [1]. People aging between 18 and 64 should do a m inimum of a 2.30 hours of medium power free oxygen exercise in a complete week or have to perform 1.15 hours of a high vigour exercise in a week or should be doing both activities simultaneously for much better results. Such exercises that are done for lun gs and hearts should be done in sets of 10 minutes. For gaining plus points/advantages, adults should increase their normal level exercise to 5 hours a week, or don a forceful exercise for 2.30 hours a week. Muscle should be strengthened by involving special exercises daily [2]. People aging greater than 65 should do at least 2.30 hours’ low intensity exercise in a week, or at least 1.15 hours of a vigour exercise or if stamina is in a good condition then must do both of them. Oxygen free activities must be performed in sets [3]. Considering these factors, we felt that we people are not up to the mark. IOT connects real physical devices or objects to the internet. Devices can be accessed anywhere in the world when they are digitally connected with an internet server. The basic idea of IOT is to collect data and transferring it to the server from the devices having IP addresses. This technology of accessing the real objects helps them to interact with the external environment.  IOT is the evolutional force whi ch allows any company to obtain Page 11 of 86 high performance with the help of analytical analysis and security with improved results. Growth and data association has made things and connections important by creating business and industrial opportunity to the world. That’s why we are aimed that our user should complete its exercise and for this we are using (IoT) as it became mature by the junction of electromagnetic wave technologies, (MEMS), micro servers and cyberspace networks. So we are developing an activity based smart health management system using (IoT) which is to monitor the exercise routine of the patient. It consists of such ware outs which would be examining the patient on the basis of its regimen (a course of medical treatment prescribed by his m edical practitioner). It has three  major modules, First module is based on (IoT) which consists patient module that will record the person’s routine who with the help of the sensors attached on our wearable gadget . These sensors will be departed at his body parts,  or some of the utensils he would be using daily and at the end module will calculate some values from the body. Then will transfer those values to our android app. We will create an algorithm which will be computing those values and then converting them into some points. These point are now the target that is achieved by the individual. These routines would be transferred to  the respective doctor(optional) and physician. They can communicate to their patients and as well as guide him in their medicines or diet plans. Second module is the doctor’s module. Now the patient is always connected to his doctor who is maintaining a complete check on him. Doctor can also monitor his daily routine and can directly make contact to his patient. The doctor will be prescribing medicines or edibles to the patient. He would also be responsible of verifying and approving the diets suggested by the physician . Our android application is simply creating a window between a health oriented personnel and a doctor. Our app is crea ting users interest through a type of  co channel communication encouraging to fulfil the target prescribed by his medical practitioner. Initially we are concerning about the daily routine of our user and specially the exercise he did while its body did during his hectic routine. Now if he is not moving enough to complete his target our app will be providing his serious alerts on the notification. Same on the other hand if he is moving sufficiently our app will generate such interesting alerts on the notification bar that he will keep keen interest to complete the target assigned by his doctor. Page 12 of 86 Third module is the physician’s module. Now this is the main person who is always connected to the patient. We can say a physician is compulsory for the person willing to use our application. Physician will be viewing patient’s daily goals achieved and his  total calories burnt for the day and how many steps he took. The most interesting thing we got is that physician can also view either patient has hired a doctor or n ot. If yes, then every diet prescribed by him will be forwarded to the doctor for approval. If no, the diet recommended will be sent directly to the patient and he/she will be notified about the change in plan. Physician is also responsible of updating the goals of his respective patients and no approval is required for this update/process. Now all we are talking about the target is that it will be settled into as 100 points on the patient module and the sensors or the ware outs having an eye on his body m ovement will help us to extract some values from them as to calculate either the mark is achieved or not. The user can also enter his daily edibles which would help the doctor to understand his current condition. Another facility provided by us will be a c heck up on medication. User has to check on the medicine checkbox and if he fails to do this our app will provide a notification to the user. This information is also transferred to the doctor who will also help the doctor in reviewing his recovery status.  At the end of the day user will be enjoying a happy and a healthy life.

For this purpose, we will be bringing the idea of “RIDE” to reality. Ride is an application that tracks a bus and gathers the distance to each station along its route. Ride involves the installation of an electronic device in a vehicle, with an installed driver side Android App on any SMART phone to enable th e user to track the vehicle's location. There are two applications one for server and the other for the client. Buses carry GPS devices· to track their positions. By this positions to server are periodically updated. Client application displays map showing  the position of bus. It shows where buses are on a map and provide users the updated information at different time interval. The users can get flexibility of planning travel using the app, to decide on which bus to take or when to catch the bus. The waiti ng time of the user can be reduced. Simple mode of communication is the key feature of the Bus Tracking system. This application can be easily extended for central tracking system to keep track of all the public vehicles. The different queries and efficien t route management can be easily done through central server system. Hopefully with our GPS observance system which will be supported with an application we will be able to provide the city with a better, smarter way of travel. Our GPS observance system will hold these key features: 1. Driver and client side applications. 2. GPS based real time location tracking. 3. Searching of buses on their route number. 4. Calculating shortest distance from client’s location to the nearest bus stop.

heading: Literature Review
content: Bus transportation service is every way, but without a good bus management system, bus service may not fully utilize. In our country, majority bus service providers are not performing real time bus tracking. They only provide scheduled timetable which is not accurate in real time. However, there is a University in Malaysia successfully implemented real time bus tracking system. In oversea countries, there are many university implemented real time tracking system for shuttle bus service. Thus, studies are p erformed on the bus tracking system implemented by Asia Pacific University (APU) in Malaysia, Northern Illinois University (NIU) located in USA and Rice University in Texas, USA. heading: Abstract
content: The task of developing intelligent machines that can understand visual scenes and then relay back their understanding in natural language has been a challenge for the fields of Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing. Recently, thanks to advancements in computer hardware, data - gathering techniques and most importantly, Artificial Intelligence, quiet a lot has been achieved in this domain in a short span of time. Through this project, we present the fundamentals of two such models that accomplish the task of image captioning using Neural Networks. We elaborate on their respected methodologies, argue on the quality of the captions they produce and suggest improvements for even better -quality captions. We then prove that these models can be used in countless applications with immediate and practical benefits. Our contribution lies in performing an in -depth analysis of machine generated captions using automatic evaluation metrics and our proposed ‘consensus -based’ Human Evaluation plan, rather than designing and staging complex algorithms for the Image Captioning task. We show that t he automatic metrics give better scores when the captions are being compared against more than one reference sentence. Moreover, our study suggests that the evaluation of Image Captioning systems may be fully automated. We propose strategies for collecting human judgments cheaply and on a large scale, which allows even better analysis of the captions produced by machines. We also suggest improvements in the models discussed and then implement both the models accordingly.

heading: Architecture
content: A CNN architecture is formed by assemblage of distinct layers that transform the input aggregate into an output aggregate through a differentiable function. A CNN consists of an input and an output layer, and assorted hidden layers. The hidden layers of a CNN contain convolutional layers, pooling layers, affiliated (connected) layers and standardization layers.

Berg · Li Fei-Fei - ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge. [4] Pham, Huy Nguyen Anh - The Impact of Overfitting and Overgeneralization on the Classification Accuracy in Data Mining

heading: Related Work
content: Automatic Image Captioning was first tackled using classification models which only assigned a label to an image. This approach, although very efficient, is not able to label every novel image presented to it. This is because the outputs are fixed and already defined. For an image captioning model to be perfect, the number of captions that it produces need to be, basically, unlimited. In section 3.1 we discuss how the image captioning task has evolved over time and the models that have been used. In section 3.2 methods to evaluate machine generated captions are discussed. In section 3.3 types of datasets used for image captioning tasks are presented.

heading: References
content: [1] Farhadi et al., 2010 Every Picture Tells a Story: Generating Sentences from Images

heading: Introduction
content: For the purpose of obtaining single sentence captions, the model that we have selected is based on the works of Karpathy et al [1 ]. The model is a deep neural network that learns an alignment between text and the visual image it describes. Since two modalities are involved, this is a multimodal architecture, meaning it can caption a query image, as well as retrieve images against a query sentence. This model produces state of the art captions that outperform other approaches.

heading: Architecture
content: Karpathy applies the encoder-decoder architecture on this model.  The alignment between the two modalities (image regions and the textual description  against it) is done by using a structured objective. For the modalities to be aligned, they need to associate, or mapped in a common space. The model by Karpathy at el. links the two modalities through a common  space called multimodal embedding space and a structured objective. The model as achieved the of the art results in image retrieval through this multimodal embedding. Basically, a multimodal Recurrent Neural Network architecture takes an input image and generates its description in text. The experiments show that the generated sentences meaningfully beat retrieval based baseline models present up to date. The model produces sensible qualitative predictions. We then train the model on the inferred correspondences and evaluate its performance on a new dataset of region -level annotations.

heading: Implementation
content: Implementation phase is divided into three parts: 1. Installing dependencies for the model. 2. Creating a web application. 3. Packaging the model, its dependencies and our web application as an image.

heading: Introduction
content: Rather than generating one sentence that captions the image, Johnson et al [1] propose a model which generates multiple sentences describing an image. Although the architecture that is used is almost identical to our base line model and has almost the same encoding -decoding techniques, it cannot be labelled as an image captioning task. Some images and their generated descriptions are shown in section 5.3 which will better explain this point. For extracting the image regions, a CNN model, having a novel dense localisation layer, is used. Then, a RNN language models used which takes the identified labels and generates sentences based on them. The training is done on the Visual Genome dataset, which is a huge dataset and contains multiple descriptions against each image. This allows the model to be more ‘imaginative’ and have more ‘vocabulary’ although the descriptions vary in size, it is wrong to think that it can produce novel descriptions.

heading: Architecture
content: The first phase is extracting image regions from the input and outputting a vector representation to be passed on to the localisation layer, which is the second phase. Each of the regions are identified and labelled. labels with multiple sentences. An interpolation technique is applied that allows the propagate gradients backward through the coordinates of predicted regions. Lastly, a language model using RNN is applied to retrieve similar descriptions from the dataset.

heading: Testing
content: The evaluation of machine generated caption is a great challenge (discussed in Section 1). Traditionally, this task is performed by experts who carefully analyse the structure, saliency, accuracy and correctness of the generated caption against the image. But hiring experts is expensive and can take a lot of time. On the other hand, the automatic metrics are very handy and can evaluate thousands of captions in a minute, but are not known for their consistency. The approach we implement uses both human judgment scores and the metric scores to find the correlation between them. Since the captions from the multi-descriptions generator are redundant and large in number, evaluating them is not advisable through the techniques mentioned. They are only for evaluati ng one caption per image. So, the evaluation section focuses only on the base -model proposed by Karpathy. In the first phase of our evaluation, we present a “Consensus -based” human evaluation system (section 6.1.1) through which we gather robust human judg ement scores against the captions that that are being evaluated. In the second phase, we evaluate the same captions mathematically, using automatic metrics.

heading: Implementation
content: All the automatic metrics use similar methodology to compute their respected scores i.e. a set of candidate sentences (which are being evaluated) compared against a set of ground -truths, or the reference sentences. For analysis purposes, we divide this experiment into two parts. The first part evaluates the machine generated captions (candida te) against GT(a). The second evaluates generated captions against the second set of ground –truths GT(b). Figure illustrates example of GT(a) and GT(b) for an image. Since we are actually talking about caption quality, rather than sentence quality, the me trics have to be carefully selected. Some of the metrics used to evaluate machine generated captions are not even designed for the purpose. Since human judgments are expensive and time -consuming to collect, we now examine how well they can be approximated by Meteor and Cider. The caption generated by baseline model (Karpathy et al.) and test model (MS-Caption) is compared with our 5 Ground truth reference captions.  we cannot assume that the generated caption is identical to one of the reference captions. We therefore examine to what extent Meteor and Cider scores agree with human judgments when the candidate pool contains machine generated captions. The captions generated by baseline model (Karpathy et al.) and test model (MS -CaptionBot) is compared with our Ground truth reference GT(a) and then with GT(B). When calculating Meteor, if more than one reference sentence is available, the candidate sentence is  scored against each reference independently, and the pair with the highest score is selected. Cider simply compares the candidate sentence to all the reference captions and gives the score accordingly.

heading: Conclusion
content: Through this project, we discussed the task of automatic image captioning, especially in the light of Neural Networks. Showing our understanding of this hugel y complex but interesting field was a large part of our project, and how these networks finally converge to the main concept of our project: Artificial Cognition. We then elaborated on the different models and techniques that are presently available for this task. The different datasets available and the evaluating techniques used are also presented to give a clear understanding of the experiments that we conducted. We have also presented the drawbacks associated with each method and technique After a complete analysis, we identified the best approach and selected two models based on that architecture. Next, we discussed the two selected models and give a qualitative and quantitative analysis on both of them. Our analysis shows that, although the two models are state-of-the-art and efficient in their working, the quality of the captions they produce fall short when corelated with human scores. The same problem is identified in the automatic metrics that are used for mathematically evaluating the captions quality. A need is indicated for improvements. The captions from the first model, which generates one caption per image, are optimized by experimentally finding out the best Beam Size and them implementing the model with that particular beam size. The captions from the second model are found to be redundant, in terms that it produces hundreds and hundreds of captions per image. The captions are found to be very much descriptive and accurate, but all of them are short and identical to the captions in the datas et. Keeping in mind its limitations and forthcomings, we try to filter out the top captions for an image and thus creating our own Densely Annotated Dataset. This dataset contains only those captions that describe the image accurately and comprehensively. We point out the advantages of such a dataset and its use in evaluation purposes. Lastly, we implemented the improved model on web. Users can use the webpage to get their images captioned at real time. As compared to the previous approaches of image classification where images are annotated with a single word or a short phrase, the task of automatic image captioning is found to be more productive and useful in obtaining human -like explanations of the visual scenes around us. More research and development in this field is required and will surely lead to better Artificial Cognition systems and prove to open new possibilities for visually impaired and blind people. For the time being, even though there are many techniques that have come to light for this task , experiments show that they still fall quite short when compared with human results. This means that improvements are still required in both the captioning models and the techniques to evaluate the captions.

heading: Future Work
content: Real-time video captioning: This was the initial motivation behind choosing this project because getting captions at real time on a smart -phone opens up countless possibilities. Alas, hardware limitation and a doubt in feasibility made us discard the idea at that time. Now, that we h ave a clearer understanding of the whole thing, the next thing to do is implementing video captioning as a useful smart -phone application. For example, combining video captioning with the GPS module in a mobile-phone, an application can be developed for visually impaired people as a navigation tool.

heading: Abstract
content: “Stitched out” is a tailor’s management system and delivery marketplace.  It’s a project that will prove helpful for both the customer as well as the tailor. heading: Abstract
content: In the world today, with billions of users online on websites and mobile applications, evolves a technique from using ‘cookies’ to something much more efficient, robust and intrusive: ‘device fingerprinting’ or ‘device profiling’:  uniquely identifying users over the digital mass. The project is related to studying and deploying various device fingerp rinting techniques used by third parties, including but not limited to: banks, advertising agencies, online stores, social networks, data providers and online publishers. We would be developing a web and an android application to identify unique users and forming their digital fingerprint in a database regardless of the traditional ‘cookies’ method. The day of using cookies as a means of tracking users or identifying them are long gone now, it was a starting era for tracking users. Cookies can be easily man ipulated and circumvented, we are headed to complex, more detailed and efficient techniques in means of tracking. As we are aware, deleting cookies can be done in mere clicks and that destroys all of its purpose, leaving no choice for the concerned parties, but to step up their game and head to device profiling techniques. [1] Our project will incorporate the techniques used by third parties to track users on the web and mobile applications by forming their digital fingerprints and preventing them for abusi ng the system as required: blocking multiple registrations, tracking and preventing fraud etc.

heading: Introduction
content: Online tracking is an essential aspect, as more and more companies emerge, so do the consumers and there arises the need of tracking the individual users and to collect their data, in order  to make leads, mine the data and predict their movement. After all, data is everything that manoeuvre the businesses. Our project has 2 aspects of development; a web and an android application based on the proof of concepts of profiling techniques. Our we b project will collect relevant information from client -side using: JavaScript, Flash, Canvas and HTTP Headers. Using these components over the web interface, once a user visits our website we will fetch the relevant attributes including but not limited to : browser -version, OS version, client time -zone, client location, device resolution, fonts installed, plugins installed, navigator object. We will combine these attributes to an extent to which they are calculated to be unique. The fingerprints on web are  measured according their entropy bits. A fingerprint consisting of 3 -bits of entropy would uniquely identify us among 2^3 =8 people. A 12 -bits entropy would identify uniqueness from 4,096 people and so on, the more the attributes used as identifiers, the more entropy we get, hence improving the fingerprint [2]. This technique of web fingerprinting will help us identifying unique users where cookies are turned off or users browsing in incognito mode. By storing the fingerprints, we can identify a user’s dev ice and mark them as ‘good’ or ‘bad’ and identify any future activity that emerges from the same device. On mobile devices, web fingerprinting can be used, but there are certain limitations. Like a few fonts installed, not support for: html 5, flash and pl ugins in the browser and so on. These issues decrease the entropy bits which are collected and hence reduce the effectiveness of the fingerprinting technique. But, one rarely uses browser on mobile and the purpose of mobile devices is to have mobile applic ations installed. That’s where the power of Android API calls come in, the complex operations they perform by yet simple API calls will enable us to harvest the data required from the device. We will collect the attributes of the user’s device using android application which will include but not limited to: Unique Device Identifier (IMEI, MEID, ESN), Android ID, MAC ID, WLAN ID, Serial Number, GSF ID, Advertising ID and SIM Subscriber ID [3]. Together, they form very efficient entropy bits and a robust iden tifier (hashed). As these values are mostly hardware embedded and improbable to change by the user, we can generate a unique fingerprint and tie it to user’s device for future analytics or tracking device behaviour. In android project we will be deploying this technique to retrieve user’s device fingerprint and storing it on back-end storage (it can be a web based server or a local storage). Our project will be incorporating the techniques discussed above for web and android applications, to a level generating unique fingerprints.

heading: Objectives
content: • Develop a website that can uniquely identify users and generate their fingerprints • Develop an android application having the functionality to detect known devices based on fingerprinting techniques • Educate the people about new technologies being used in the field of tracking and tagging users • Understanding the limitations and evasiveness of using ‘cookies’ as a form of identification • To help users detect and block fraud by using this technique in their applications • Improve fingerprinting techniques as technology advances • Offer an open source project • Help businesses prevent fraud and maximize profits

heading: Problem Statement
content: There are a lot of techniques being used today to circumvent fraud. A lot of them are based on data collection like: Proxy identification, Data Analytics, Rule Based Engines, KYC Verification etc. But a clever fraudster can easily  work around these techniq ues, like using identity theft to appear legit and whitelisted IP Address and location. Fraudster can spoof these details with trial and error and can get a lot of information about how the fraud prevention method works. There needs to exit a black -box fraud prevention measure that works in invisible layer, without letting user know anything about it. This way a user or a fraudster will never even know if there exists any fraud prevention mechanism and won’t interfere with it. The fraud detection will work in background silently and do its job in the backend. This type of fraud detection can be achieved by device fingerprinting technique. By using digital fingerprinting method, we can tag users by calculating their digital hashed fingerprint and storing it i n a database. This way we can know about all our users, new or returning, and identify them whenever they visit.  A fraudster commits fraud by creating multiple accounts using the same device with stolen information obtained from black-market or deep web. We can use fingerprinting method to tag individual machines and flag them if we detect fraud, making that device unusable on our site by displaying generic error message.

heading: Scope
content: Our main motivation is to spread the knowledge and educate pe ople about the much needed, yet intrusive techniques of fingerprinting, used by tech -giants all over the world including: Facebook, Google, Microsoft, Yahoo etc. Our generation is still living in the dark ages and have no idea of how much development has been made in the web and mobile applications to track the user’s movement without their consent, after all the companies thrive on user’s data. Most users still think that we are still under the reign of cookie tracking and they can hide by simply deleting it, which is not true at all! We need to educate people about what’s going on behind the scenes and how their data is being collected, tagged and tracked over the internet. Using Tor browser or incognito is not enough. It’s just a safety illusion that the users fall prey to. By doing this project we would be able to successfully show how the modern device profiling techniques are being used and developed. We have to spread the concern that these techniques are very useful in identifying fraudsters, spammers , hackers, bots all over the world, but if abused by the wrong parties like black hat advertising agencies and networks whose sole purpose is to sell user information illegally, it can be very lethal! Just like your biometric fingerprint is unique, so is y our digital fingerprint. What if it’s sold over the internet and the third parties can track you without you even knowing? We are developing this project so that the web and mobile application developers can use and embed the aforementioned device fingerprinting techniques in their applications and websites to carry out their tasks with ease.

heading: Literature Review
content: There are plethora of companies offering fraud prevention systems for e -commerce and banking sectors. All of the them use different techniques and tools in order to identify the fraud and duplicate users. They use different mechanisms including: Data Leads , Proxy Detection, KYC Verification, Machine learning, Blacklist Database, Geolocation IP, Automated Workflow etc. Our focus is on ‘device fingerprinting’ technique to identify the fraud. Many companies are actively working in this domain and it’s been evolving very actively, improving with time. Some popular companies offering fraud prevention solutions based on device fingerprinting technique are showcased below.

heading: Testing
content: All individual modules were extensively tested for website and android application. For website, different tests were carried out. At first, JavaScripts were tested on different platforms: Windows 7, Windows 8 and Windows10 , using following browsers: Google Chrome, Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox and Opera. Their output was analysed and evaluated before integrating it further into different components and using them as dependencies for other JavaScripts. Furthermore, user r egistration and login system were  tested out separately, to ensure that they work perfectly on standalone conditions  before integrating any code or module related to fingerprinting techniques. This was done both for website and android. Android’s code was also tested on different API levels , to know about minimum device and OS requirements/compatibility level that we could work with, and  ensure the support for maximum number of devices.  Several integral codes/functions were tested out on different Android operating systems, using Android Emulator in Android Studio.

heading: Conclusion
content: We faced several problems during the development of our Website. First of all, we had to research device attributes to be collected, which took quite some time and then had to code JavaScript for it. Later, it was realised that some of the attributes were not compatible and supported by all browsers. We had to redefine our strategy and rethink the device attributes which could be utilized. Moreover, we faced issues of ‘collision’ and inefficiency in Hashing algorithm(s). The hashing algorithm we used earlier was not so effective and sometimes produced different hashes on page refresh for same device(s). There were also chances of hash collision for different words. We tested out several Hashing methods which are being used world -wide for non-cryptographic purposes, and came to a conclusion that ‘Murmur’ hash was the most appropriate choice. Data tampering was anothe r concern which we faced . Since Jav aScript is at front-end and can be manipulated by client side, we needed a way to secure its integrity. We learned that this could be done in a number of ways, including: Obfuscation techniques and JavaScript minification . These techniques manipulate the JavaScript and to some extent encrypts it , so that it is hard to understand and modify the code or abuse it. In Android application, we found out that  there are some functions which are not supported by older devices running older Android OS. We had to search alternate techniques to perform our objective on older devices as well. Devices running minimum on Android 4.4 or later are supported.

heading: Abstract
content: As a developing country, one of the many dilemmas that engulf Pakistan is the exponential increase in water pollution that is rapidly becoming one of the biggest environmental threats to our health. Like many other environmental hazards, water pollution is also a result of our own negligence, but the majority of its detrimental effects are easily preventable by nation-wide application of a handful of practices to ensure safe and clean drinking water for our people. Contamination of water bodies (e.g. lakes, canals, rivers and seas) by large amounts of harmful chemical, physical, radioactive or pathogenic microbial substances results in chemical, physical or biological changes in the quality of water that have adverse effects on any living thing that drinks, uses or lives in it. The recent wave of industrialization in Pakistan, its ever-growing population and the lately popular commercial approach towards agriculture are the major inciting factors that have greatly contributed towards water pollution in recent years. Polluted water bodies are hazardous to humans, as well as to the aquatic life and ecosystem. The team of this project aims to provide a solution to detect impurities in water before it is utilized by common man for everyday use to ensure a healthy living environment. A tangible solution for preventing usage of contaminated water (notably in household application) lies in conducting real-time tests on water before it is distributed for use.

heading: Introduction
content: The main goal of the project is to provide a potential solution to prevent the use of contaminated water. Amid the many environmental crisis, water contamination is one those that directly and significantly causes a negative impact on the quality of life. A wide multitude of causes contribute to water contamination; it is a multi-factorial phenomenon. The industrial waste that is drained in rivers and streams is one of the major causes of water pollution. With increase in industrialization in recent years, not much attention has been paid to the environmental sustainability of industries and factories. As a result, majority of factories and industrial plants lack proper waste disposal systems. Tones of chemically and physically polluted water, laden with harmful acids, alkalis and heavy metals, are dumped by industries into local water bodies daily. Untreated domestic waste that finds its way into water-bodies is also a major source of water pollution. The population explosion in Pakistan has produced countless unplanned slums all over the country. These places have no proper sewage disposal systems. So, all the domestic waste and garbage is often deposited in the local lakes, canals and rivers. Agricultural products that run-off untreated in the nearby bodies of water further intensify the detrimental situation of water pollution. Agriculture in Pakistan is rapidly becoming commercial-oriented. The widespread use of DDTs is poisonous for aquatic life as well as for humans. Nitrates and other fertilizers cause unrestrained growth of unwanted plants in water thereby disturbing the balance of nature in the aquatic ecosystem. The situation aggravates upon the consumption of this toxic waste via water. There is a dire need to set up proper measures that will keep the toxicity of the water in check through real-time testing. Impurity of a liquid can be monitored based on its acidity and alkalinity. This group of students is of the opinion that developing a system that will measure the purity of water based on its pH levels will be very valuable in ensuring that only healthy and good quality water reaches our households and workplaces, thereby significantly reducing the rate of transmission of water- borne diseases. Therefore, we shall strive to develop such a system whereby pH of water is being continually measured and warning is sent out electronically if the pH deviates from the preset standard range.

heading: Objectives
content: By fulfilling our prime objective of developing the “Aqua Impurity Scanner”, we aim to provide a real-time water testing system that is both economically and practically implementable at household as well as large scale levels. A major role in achieving this objective will be played by the development of the network system that will link the pH sensors in water storage tanks and reservoirs with end-users and water regulation authorities, respectively, thereby warning them of significant changes in pH levels of water promptly. This shall help ensure timely action and thereby prevent consumption of unhealthy water by the users. Problem statement The goal of this team is to create a healthy environment for people by helping the water authorities become more efficient in their response to water contamination occurrences. Projects related to Aqua Impurity Scanner have been worked on before by other teams as well but the end results do not fit everyone’s budget. Our product prototype promises an economical solution with satisfying results. Assumptions and Constraints

heading: Introduction
content: MQTT protocol is a Machine to Machine (M2M) protocol widely used in Internet of things. This is a message-based protocol and as it is immensely light-weight, due to which it is embraced by IoT ecosystem. MQTT protocol is accepted by almost all IoT platforms to exchange data from smart objects. There are several implementations for different IoT boards like Arduino, Raspberry and so on. MQTT Message pattern The publish-subscriber paradigm decouples a client that issues a message (“publisher”) to other clients that receive the message (“subscribers”). Since, MQTT is an asynchronous protocol there is no blocking of the client while waiting for the message. Using this protocol, there's also no need for the publisher and client to be connected at the same time. MQTT Publisher-subscriber pattern (MQTT Broker, MQTT Client) MQTT uses publisher-subscriber pattern. The main crucial component in MQTT is the MQTT broker which is responsible for dispatching messages to the MQTT clients which it receives from the publishers. As the message is being sent, topic is used by the MQTT broker to filter the MQTT clients that are to receive the message. The topic is a string and can be combined to create topic levels. A topic which is a virtual channel links a publisher to its subscribers. This topic is managed by the MQTT broker. Through this topic, the publisher is decoupled from the subscribers and the MQTT clients do not have to know each other to exchange data. This makes this protocol highly scalable without a direct dependency from the message producer (“publisher”) and the message consumer (“subscriber”). heading: Introduction
content: The main goal of this project is to develop new methodologies which will result in industrial level efficiency through Research and implementation of self-driving vehicle simulation. These software systems are Lane Detection, Traffic Signs Classification, and the Simulation. Self- driving vehicles are comprised of Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning systems. These systems alongside dedicated sensors are continuously working with the hardware to drive the vehicle. Artificial intelligence is intelligence showcased by machines to carry out various task assigned to them. This project would emphasize on efficient machine learning model which will enable the system to understand without being hard-coded to have the ability of image classification through which it will be able to identify the certain situation that it has been presented with and follows the protocols in accordance to that situation. A model in machine learning is a learning algorithm which is provided with trained data of its domain. The term machine learning model refers to the model artifact that is created by the training process of an algorithm. We will utilize computer vision techniques which will provide us with the high level of understanding of the images or videos. The main concern of Computer Vision is to extract the valuable information from image or video automatically and then analyse and understand it. The main focus will be computer vision, its ability to identify objects, scenes and activities in unconstrained environments.  First and foremost, Objects are detected by using image processing techniques. Objects include traffic signs, road lanes, vehicles. Then for identification of objects, this requisite training data is provided to efficient or best possible neural network for image classification. During image classification, we’ve also worked on traffic sign detection and classification and choosing a network architecture to enhance performance. The advanced techniques for lane detection with curved roads, adverse weather, and varied lighting are done to ensure the proper and continuous road lanes detection of the Self Driving vehicles. Vehicles are tracked using the image processing and image classification techniques along with positioning of the vehicle. This tracking is necessary to gain road sense as it is an important feature so that vehicles are aware of their surroundings to avoid collisions with objects like other vehicles. Pedestrians are also an important constraint of the road sense when it comes to awareness of surroundings of the vehicle.

heading: Abstract
content: Pick me is an Android Application based on Ride Sharing concept in COMSATS Institute Lahore Campus. By using this application, students can share their vehicles with other non-vehicle students of institute. The one who has a vehicle can give ride to other students, faculty and staff at the fair division. The students, faculty or staffs who miss their institute bus or class timing not matched with institute bus timing can also be facilitated with this application which is low in cost and time saving for the COMSATS Institute Lahore Campus students. Table of Content

heading: Introduction
content: This application basically provides a platform for ride sharing. The application has two types of users.  One  is  the  Person  who  has  vehicle  (vehicle  owner)  and  the  other  who  needs  ride (passenger). This android application is designed to communicate between the vehicle owner and rider. If the vehicle owner and the rider travels to same destination regularly at the same time and have  common  route.  They  can  communicate  with  each  other  and  share  ride  using  this application. For example, vehicle owner daily travels to his university by covering the distance of 25km daily by car and travels alone. By using this application, riders can search the vehicle owner in its map nearby. The vehicle owner can active his status to show his status online on the map. The current location of vehicle owner is its source. Riders can search for the ride using their current location. Before booking the ride, rider can see vehicle owner profile by clicking the active vehicle owner on the map. The rider also communicates with vehicle owner using chat feature and confirm the availability of seats.  They can  also contact  each  other  for weekly or  monthly ride  sharing purposes. The scope of this application is only for the students of COMSATS Institute Lahore Campus  so  the  students  can  share  ride  with  other  students,  faculty or staff members.  This application will help the students in case of his buss misses or buss is not available at the route where student lives. Same is for faculty or staff members. So it’s very helpful for COMSATS community. For the security purposes the administrator can check other student/faculty/staff identity card to verify that they both are of same institute. Students can share ride both on and off of institute timings. They can also make different packages for ride sharing with each other. They can also specify whether they want to share ride daily or monthly. They can also exchange their contact numbers after finding the perfect vehicle owner for ride sharing purposes so they contact each other easily and comfortably.

heading: Objectives
content: The main objective of this application is to establish trust between rider and driver and secure the ride.  Our  goal  is  to  provide  facility  to  the  students  and  faculty  members  to  make  them comfortable by developing trust and help in serving each other by sharing transport vehicle in COMSATS Lahore Campus.

heading: Problem Statement
content: The purpose behind this android application is that students and other faculty members are finding difficulties in searching the transport convenience and are uncomfortable in asking for a lift from unknown persons due to trust issues. For that purpose, this application is developed to facilitate  the  people  in  finding  the  transport  facility  because  of  unavailability  of  transport medium by creating communication among the people who go through common destination on the regular basis at the same time. This application also provides opportunity to female students and faculty members who are not comfortable with male drivers to resolves their comfort issues and travel with female drivers.

Wheel Tracker sends you alerts about driver’s activities, your vehicle condition and reminds whenever it needs service.

heading: Introduction
content: This project is funded by a Onzite Digital, a Norwegian company. The company is making a series of recruitment software’s for different business branches in Scandinavia. This project is a part of that software product series. The aim of this project is to build Vikarpool Hotel Application. It is a cloud based system that would help companies to hire people with relevant skills in hotel industry in the specified region at any time. The administration panel will control the working and information of its users. Our company have their  own  administration panel so we don’t have to work on that. We just have to build a system that have two modules in it i.e Leader/Recruiter and Applicant. The hiring companies can register themselves in this application after buying this application and premium services using PayPal method. Company will give their Hotel Branch Number for registration because there can be different branches of one hotel. The cloud based web system would have digital CVs of the job seekers available 24/7. If some person or worker is on leave or can’t come, hiring company can post a job here describing the specialities and skills they need for this job to be done. Company can also specify the region where they want the work to be done so that only people who belongs to that region contacts. Relevant clients contact them or they contact those applicants that are of their interest. The hiring companies could find the right applicants based on skills, location, interests, education and experience easily. The applicants can register themselves by giving all the information about them. They can upload their     CV, specialities, interests other documents and their availability etc. They can search for jobs here describing the category they want to work in or have speciality in. If they find a suitable job according to their loca tion, interest, skills  and needs, they can apply for that job by sending Job request. They can also communicate directly with that company and recruiter. Company can hire them easily without any inconvenience.

heading: Abstract
content: Octavo Book is a mobile application that will have the capability of identifying Englis h text from an image input and translating it into Urdu lan guage in an editable format.  This application specifically facilitates the audience who face difficulty in understanding/translating English text written in text books or any other hard form, as users can not readily write the long texts on some online translating engines for translation . This feature  will help people who do not have better understanding of English to communicate with the world. Our Second application Discover Font will have the ca pability to facilitate the users to identify the type of font (up to the nearest possible similar font)  of any text from an image . This feature will basically help the designers and artists who face difficulty in the identification of font styles for different purposes.

heading: Introduction
content: The prevalence of mobile devices has given rise to a lot of images pro cessing applications that benefit our lives. Applications are getting smarter and smarter to serve humans even better than ever. In this project, we try to build an application that will translate words, sentences, paragraphs and even pages of book in eith er image or text format from English to Urdu with greater precision of accuracy. The most common way of translation on mobile device is either typing the words into a dictionary or using a search engine to find the result, which make them inconvenient for the user. Therefore, we come up with the solution in the form of mobile application that besides this will also identify the font in an image correctly using the latest techniques. The following are the characteristic features of the application:  The user can either take a picture directly using the camera of the phone or can select image from the gallery. The input file can be in text format as well. heading: Objectives
content: To develop an android app lication that will facilitate and enable the users to identity fonts and translate text from English to Urdu, whether selected individual words, a sentence or a paragraph in an image. In Pakistan the educational system is more dependent on institutes of Urdu Medium language and religious madrasas, due to which  students f ace difficulty while learning English contents and literature,  at higher levels of education so our application help those students by providing English to Urdu .If Designer want to identify f ont while editing in text picture our app will identify the font and solve his/her problem. heading: Problem Statement
content: In Pakistan dominance of English language is prominent and is causing linguistic elite over most people who did their studies in Urdu. The  method of  instruction in the state schools is Urdu medium while the ambition is to get good command over English language. This method of teaching is creating problems in effective education system and causing barrier to progress of th e whole State. Students learning in English face major problems in slow progress in reading, writing and difficulty in understanding the content . In most of the cases the family back ground discourages the student from effectively communicating in English language. This is not only causing problems in getting good education but also one of the major issues that our youth is jobless because the limited seats available are occupied by the giants who have references and have good communication skills in English language because they have studied in costly private institutes. We are losing most of the creativity of Pakistan’s youth due to this barrier. Currently, government is planning strategies to widen access to the English language through upgrading state sc hools to English medium but still the content is uneven, and the quality of education is still not enough to cope with the problem and learners are not able to make basic progress in English language. At Present, it is necessary to gain skills in English language to any kind of job in the civil service. The use of mobile phones is increasing dramatically, that is why we suggest domesticating English language through our application. The second problem that we are trying to solve through our applicat ion is faced by the profession of designing. The use of font is very crucial in designing but when designer come across a font best suiting his/her design, he/she needs to see some expert to get it recognised but it is not the case most of the time. Mostly people wonder how to get it done and post on different websites seeking a solution. Here we took a stance to solve this issue by get the font recognized through the small device almost everyone keeps along with them. We purpose a reliable and efficient way of recognizing font style through the font recognition functionality in our application.

heading: Abstract
content: The Internet of Things (IoT) technology has revolutionized the retail industry by providing innovative solutions for improving customer experience and increasing operational efficiency. One such solution is the IoT based automated shopping cart, which combines IoT devices and sensors to automate the shopping process. This paper reviews the literature on IoT based automated shopping carts, with a focus on their benefits, challenges, and future possibilities. The benefits of IoT based automated shopping carts include increased efficiency, reduced checkout times, and enhanced customer experience. On the other hand, challenges include high implementation costs, privacy concerns, and technical difficulties. Case studies of successful implementation in retail stores demonstrate the potential for IoT based automated shopping carts to transform the retail industry. In conclusion, this literature review highlights the promising future of IoT based automated shopping carts in the retai l industry. With the integration of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, these shopping carts have the potential to revolutionize the way customers shop and retailers operate. vi Table of contents

heading: Introduction
content: 1.1 Brief System Overview. The IoT-based Autonomous Shoppin g Cart is a smart shopping system that utilizes the Internet of Things (IoT) to provide customers with a convenient and efficient shopping experience. The system consists of various components that work together to achieve its purpose. [1] The shopping cart itself is equipped with sensors, and other technologies that allow it to interact with its environment and the shopper. For example, t he shopping cart uses RFID scanner to detect the items being added or removed, and sensors to track the cart's location and movement. [2] The data collected by the shopping cart is then transmitted to a central system, which could be located in the store or in a cloud-based environment. The shopper can interact with the shopping cart through a mobile app or a touch scree n interface on the cart itself. This allows them to view their shopping list, add or remove items, and check out using a secure payment method. [3] The autonomous shopping cart also has the ability to navigate the store autonomously, using a combination of sensors to avoid obstacles and navigate to the correct aisle. This eliminates the need for the shopper to push the cart and reduces the time and effort required to complete the shopping trip. [4] In summary, the IoT -based Autonomous Shopping Cart provid es a seamless and efficient shopping experience by leveraging IoT technology to automate various aspects of the shopping process. The system uses sensors, algorithms to interact with the shopper and the store environment, providing a unique and innovative shopping experience. Figure 1-1:Abstract Design of Cart [1].
