heading: Abstract
content: The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that there are 285 million visually -impaired people worldwide. Among these individuals, there are 39 million who are totally blind [1]. Around 1.6 Million people in Pakistan are visually impaired  [2]. There are no proper means to let them interact with the latest technology that may be useful in performing their daily life activit ies. Different organizations like PAKISTAN ASSOCIATION OF THE VSUALLY IMPAIRED (NATIONAL) and AZIZ JEHAN BEGUM TRUST FOR THE VSUALLY IMPAIRED are working for the most deprived community of our country. Visually impaired people are mostly dependent on someone else in performing their day to day tasks. The proposed project aims to make them independent to its maximum. Instead of being a usual application to guide the user about traversing a path, this application will help the user to experience the real-time happenings and true colours of the world.  The project that we are initially working on is to develop an android based smart phone application for the visually impaired community. While using the application, the user will capture images through voice commands or gesture controls. The application will analyse and translate the images taken from a device to speech and describe what the person/s in the captured image is/are doing, how old they are, and what emotions they're expressing. The application w ill be controlled through voice as well as tap localization/ gesture-based commands. The user has to do nothing except giving voice commands/ gesture-based commands and use the smartphone for his/her needs. The application will also be able to read the content available on the screen with the help of tapping on the icon. From phone accessibility to scene description this application is a complete package for the visually impaired users. The proposed solution may not be able to give them their vision back to them but at least it can help them to experience what they are not capable to do.

heading: Introduction
content: Visually impaired people face a lot of difficulties in experiencing the true colours of this world. Accessing a smartphone has become the need of time and they are not able to use it with ease. Hence, we are developing an application that will make mobile phone accessibility feasible for them. Our application will not only help them in using the smartphones but will describe the scenes captured through a camera with the help of voice directives. The developed project is an android application for the visually impaired community. This is not a simple path guiding device that will guide the user to turn left or right  when an obstacle is in the way but will help the user to be a part of the real world and experience what every other normal person can. This development will help them see this beautiful world with the help of an android application. Phone accessibility, scene description, facial recognition the whole ball of wax will be available for the users. Whether the user needs to access the phone or needs an explanation of the sight, the whole thing can be attained with the help of this android application. Using t his application, the users will access the smartphone with simplicity. While using the application, the users will capture images which will be analysed and translated to speech. The description of what a person(s) (in scene) is/are doing, how old they are , and what sentiments they're articulating, all will be conveyed to the user through voice. The application will be controlled through voice commands. The user has to do nothing except give voice commands and use the smartphone for his/her needs. Many of the android phones have the features of voice directives but most of them redirect everything to the internet making it a liability for the user. Samsung phones used to have an application that was used to control the device through voice commands but was  discontinued after their phone S5  [3]. The functionalities provided by these applications were limited i.e. they were only used to open a folder or reject and answer a call or set an alarm. The voice command feature in our app lication will allow the user to control the smartphone for all the needs from opening the folders to capturing images and describing them.

heading: Objectives
content: To support the community that is not able to see the real world. To support the visually impaired people to let them participate in everyday life activities. Provide the users with a complete package to access a smartphone and enjoy the colors of real worl d without being the victims of inferiority complex. The major objective is to provide the visually impaired community with a platform where they do not consider them a class lagging behind and can easily compete and participate in everyday tasks without any obstacles. - Help the visually impaired person to easily access a smartphone. - Easily type and send messages. - Dial and Receive calls with ease. - Facial and Character Recognition. - Text to Speech Conversion For feedback. - Control the smartphone through Gestures/ Tap Localization - Control the smartphone through Voice commands.

heading: Abstract
content: In Pakistan, approximately 4.3 percent of the population is suffering from blindness and the percentage increases for the senior citizens. On international level, many products and gadgets are being developed to provide assistance to visually disabled persons. But such products are either expensive and out of budget or most of th em are heavy to carry. The actual motive behind the proposed project is to overcome the mentioned hurdles for the poor blind people in our country. Our project is targeted to benefit the community and will facilitate the visually disabled persons so that t hey can easily understand their environment and live their life independently. This will also be beneficial for the visually impaired people (partially blind). We are using raspberry pi for the needed processing along with a camera and a headphone. Camera will capture the scene, image will be processed and the system using headphones will narrate it to the blind person so that he/she can easily perceive and interpret his/her surroundings without someone’s help. In addition to that, user can also register the other persons by enrolling their pictures, so that next time the device can recognize the enrolled person and speak the name of recognized person. This project will provide aid to under -privileged visually disabled persons in Pakistan by providing them a deep solution so that their blindness does not become a cause of fear for them and their poverty does not stop them to explore and enjoy the nature.

heading: Introduction
content: We have developed such a cost-effective and handy device, which will enable the blind pe ople to interact with the environment just like the normal people. The device comprises of a raspberry pi, camera, headset and the button. When the user press es the button, image is being captured by camera and send to the Microsoft Cognitive Services (API) for processing. The API processes the image, identify its contents (objects, people, their emotions, gender and estimated age). The API  returns labels, some description  and also the words or text ( in case of text reading) . API’s result then process and converts into a complete description which comprises of description of image contents, persons’ gender with their emotions  (if found) . Finally, that  description is transformed into a voice recording and then play through head phones for the blind person. The system also performs the functionality of person’s enrolment and recognition. User (visually disabled person) can enrol or register his/her friends, relatives or family members  in the system just by pressing button and capturing their picture and speak ing up their names.  System enrol people by making the templates of their facial features and saving the person’s name audio clip. The system performs facial recognition by comparing the templates of enrolled person’s with the target one. If the person get  matched with any registered person, then the system will play the audio clip of that person’s name , otherwise it will play a default voice that ensure that the target person is not enrol in our system. So, our product will describe the scene to the blin d person, read out the text documents, sign boards, enrol or register the people and recognize the identity of people found in a n image using face recognition.

content: Initially we were working with Windows IOT operating system for our raspberry pi. Windows IOT provides the windows 10 based operating system for raspberry pi. After exploring we find that we can work on Raspbian operating system for raspberry pi that provides us the complete interface for working on it. After knowing the complete functional environment of Raspbian we switched from windows IOT to Raspbian Stretch operating system. By  making some general configurations we were able to test the code on raspberry pi and after all this we got the commendable results because Raspbian stretch is quite efficient and responsive as compare to windows 10. For project requirement we have to give  an audio input but unfortunately raspberry pi only provides the audio out we didn’t find any favorable way to give a voice input. We tried to use the sound card after inquiring this issue of subject and using sound card, raspberry pi enable us to give an audio input. We decided to use Sphinx a speech -to-text engine for voice input, it generates the text of your speech. Sample rate requirement for Sphinx is 16000 so we must have to make sure that the sample rate of audio input and decoder must be same. But decoder was decoding the sound at sample rate of 8000, we faced many problems while speech recognition process whenever we try to give the sound to Sphinx for recognition we get the mismatched results. For Sphinx the bit rate must be of 16 and channels mus t be 1. But in our case raspberry was not providing all these things, raspberry pi has pre-configured framework for sound named as Alsa. After going through the research of Alsa framework we find that if we edit the pre - configured files of Alsa for handing  sound then we can record the sound that will fulfil the requirements of Sphinx. Se set the sample rate of 16000 in the files of Alsa and recorded the sound at 16 bit rate and 1 channels after this Sphinx was able to recognize the speech. For recording sound at 16 bit and channels at 1 we used the package named SOX.

heading: Introduction
content: Cancer is one of the most serious problems in the health field. This is a disease that invades or spreads to different components of the body. Cancer cells have totally different sizes and few are larger than normal. Cancer c ells do not stop growing and keep doubling. They are abnormally shaped and the main part of the cell (the nucleus) has an abnormal development. Therefore early detection of cancer is very important to restore the health of the patient. There are many fatal types of cancer for example lungs cancer, colon cancer, breast cancer, leukemia etc. Breast cancer increases the growth of the cells to abnormal. It is the second most common reason for death in women. [1]Approximately 41,070 people died from breast cancer in 2017. Besides just affecting the body of the women, it also infects her mind. Early detection is a way for early treatment, good health, and better survival rates. Pathology involves the diagnosis of disease by examining surgi cally removed organs, tissues (biopsy samples). Surgical pathology involves microscopic tissue analysis where the tissue samples diagnose under a microscope. For cancer designation, pathologists manually examine biopsies to form diagnostic assessments. In labs, pathologists manually deal with cells and tissues structure under a microscope which is time -consuming. Pathologist puts a lot of effort on histology slides to detect cancer. By applying image processing techniques to microscopic images their efforts  can be reduced. Our objective is to design a system that upgrades the manual assessment of cancer cells to automatic assessment through the technique of image processing By this system, we can eliminate the cause of late cancer detection and also improve the accuracy of methods that are used by the pathologist in labs.

heading: Background
content: Breast cancer is one of the most persistent breast cancers in ladies and the second major reason for women death. In 2017, around 252,710 new diagnoses of breast cancer were expected in women, and of the 40,610 women were predicted to die from the disease. [2]There's a good possibility of recovery if it's analyzed in its initial stages. We are creating an automated digital image analyzer system which can greatly assist pathologists. In comparison with a manual evaluation, which is cumbersome and time -consuming process, computerized approach to detect cancer provides a fast and accurate image analysis so that the pathologists can be relieved from tedious and repeated routine efforts. The manual image analysis has to face challenges in dealing with the complicated nature of histopathology and microscopy images, which may lead to the large inter-observer change of disease.

heading: Objectives
content: Our objective is to  design a system that upgrades the manual assessment of cancer cells to automatic assessment. By this system, we can eliminate the cause of late cancer detection.

heading: Problem Statement
content: The analysis of the histopathological image is done manually by the p athologist and other expertise to diagnose samples of cells in labs. The pathologist examines the tissue parts, change of cells in tissue, irregularities of cell shapes to detect cancer. This is very time-consuming because of the current manual system. To overcome this problem there should be a computer-assisted image analyzer.

heading: Scope
content: We are living in a coun try where the death rate is increasing significantly due to cancer with the passage of time. However, the disease can be cured with medicines if it is detected on time. Pathologists are overburdened due to manually detecting a symptom of cancer from histol ogy images. There is a lack of applications and systems to assists pathologists in accurately detecting cancer. Diagnosis at an early stage of the diseases is time -consuming due to various manual performing tasks in labs.

heading: Literature Review
content: Histopathology images play an important role in diagnosing a disease. They can provide depth knowledge for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) that allows examination of digital images with a high process rate. Digital pathology which includes image analysis that helps pathologists in labs and patients to diagnose their disease at an early stage. This has attracted many attentions in each analysis and clinical applications. As compared with a manual assessment that is time-consuming, automatic detection methods offer faster results. The CAD will scale back the workload of pathologists and supply the correct results of diseases. This helps in treatments w hich will help the patients. The complicated nature of pathology and histopathology images are the challenge for manual analysis that is time taking for pathologists. An advantage of an automatic system is that it can provide accurate calculations related to the features of cells. Results that will diagnose from the system will help in clinical follow-up and so permits comparative study and potential prognosis and personalized medication. Nucleus detection that is considered as a basic part of automated image analysis in computer-aided diagnosis system. It provides quantitative analyses to gather morphological changes, like shape, texture, size, and other different options. However, it's tough to diagnose correct nucleus detection. First, pathology, particu larly histopathology, and research images typically exhibit background with several noises, blurred areas, introduced throughout image accession, and the difference between the foreground and also the background. Second, there exist important variations on nucleus size, shape, finally, nuclei clustered into groups that might overlap with each other. Several efforts are created to realize automatic nucleus detection and segmentation, getting to grab those challenges.

heading: Abstract
content: Breast Cancer systems are application software which is made for pathologist’s use. This system is used for detection of a nucleus. If a disease is present then our system will highlight the area of a nucleus in an image. We will try to reduce the complexities that existing manual systems have so that our system can be used easily and we will provide a user -friendly interface which can be easily used by pathologists in labs. The main focus  of our system will be to detect the change of nucleus which can be helpful for pathologists in making the decision and it will be helpful for them to separate the nucleus from other cells. Our system will have the key specification of being an interactive, user -friendly interface for pathologists with fewer complexities and easy to use. Our system will generate results about the image which will be helpful to determine how much benefit our system is to use. The aim behind this project is to develop a system that assists pathologists in diagnosing Diseases. This system is basically designed for the detection of the nucleus in breast cancer. The desktop application interacts directly with the pathologists.

heading: Future Work
content: We are working on detecting disease of breast cancer by using texture and color feature. If we are able to achieve the target before the designated time then we will try to separate individual cell boundaries, using different morphology features. We will also try to extend our system that can detect disease on the basis of different features like shape based are perimeter, convex area, eccentricity, and area.

heading: Abstract
content: In the world today there is a lot of research work performed in every field of study. The issue of finding research papers for researchers still remains  difficult. It has been so for a very long time and a researcher's life is all about consuming time prop erly. This issue can be addressed by creating a software system that is integrated with the biggest of the  researcher paper repositories and helps research worker by going through th is repository by itself. The researchers look for the research papers by checking out the references of research papers which is a difficult and time consuming job. However this an integral part of research activity and it is known as systematic literat ure review. We intend to aid such a tool that facilitates the researcher in s earching and identifying  relevant studies automatically. This tool will make the job much easier for them as it would automatically go through the reference section, thus automating the effort of researcher and providing ease for them to sort o ut which research papers to read. The system serves a great deal in helping them in their research work. Table of Contents

heading: Introduction
content: Referencer is research papers' references search tool. Each research paper contains references. These references are basically names of research papers given by the researcher to indicate the whereabouts of the information he used to gather the information in his paper. The references of a research paper might point towards sources which are not directly related to it, but the domain of both is more or less the same. Research work involves reading, going through the context and reading between the lines. Moreover the researcher has to analyze the information he is gaining from his research. This part of research work is to be done by him and a software might not be abl e to help him in this part. But, after reading a research paper, the researcher has to check its references for more material to help him accomplish his goal  in order to find work related to his field of interest and this is systematic literature review [1]. Checking the reference section and then opening another  research paper related to previous one gets a little difficult and inconvenient for the researcher. It involves opening new research papers and the main problem occurs when they have to find rela ted research papers on the online repositories. Mostly the research paper and its content is not what they are looking for and they end up wasting their time. This problem needs to be solved so that the researchers can perform efficiently and without any hassle.

heading: Problem Statement
content: The researcher has to waste a lot of time on the repositories in order to find work which is completely or remotely related to his domain of research. Thus, the research work gets more complicated and difficult. Moreover, there is no platform that provides searching repositor y and downloading the results of the search . This means that each time researcher needs to search a different repository, the researcher would have to open the interface of th at repository and then search it. Even after doing so, he might not be certain about finding scholarly documents he intends to find.

heading: Scope
content: A lot of researchers nowadays are facing the same issue identified in the introduction section. This project is intended to make things easier for all the researchers and those who want to writ e their own research papers. This project will search any keyword entered by the user in the Google Scholar repository , download research papers from it  and then process them using a processing library provided by Apache known as PDFBox [3].  Thus, through processing the software will extract the reference section of the research papers by using simple String manipulation techniques i.e. processing the String formatted paper [4]. This project will ask the user to put a limit up to which he wants to download research papers. Universities and different research organizations have been trying to find a way to speed up their research work, make it easier and hassle free. Thus, they are looking for a way to speed up any part of their research work so that the wh ole process can be shortened . The proposed software system provides a solution as researchers waste a great chunk of their time in just finding the research papers which are related to their area of research. This tool will provide a platform to all the people associated with research work if made according to proper market standards. It would also help the researchers have to save a big chunk of their time so that they can properly theorize their wo rk to provide a qualitied research work. Thus, the Referenc er basically provides an automation of the process of Systematic Literature Review by using simple methods and libraries [9].

heading: Abstract
content: From almost a decade, it has been the basic requirement of every reader to have strong vocabulary, make comprehension strong and understand the context of text easily. The purpose of our project, Reading Assistant for Transcript with Enhanced Searching (RATES), is to enhance learning aptitudes, knowledge, understanding and literal level of user while reading  a document. It will be realized in a desktop and mobile application. Using this app, a user may capture a text or pictorial image of document. For pictorial image, relevant thumbnail of image on internet with labels, will be provided. On the other hand, textual image passes through optical character recognition (OCR). User selects a content (word, technical terms, sentences, paragraphs) and application will provide vocabulary contents (dictionary, synonyms, antonyms etc.), text-to-speech, short summary, translation, web search results and keyword based searching features based on selection of text contents. App submits the request of user after each selection of content to external application program interface (API). Based on response from API, user gets t he required result within the application. It is believed that RATES will assist people in getting relevant and specific information in smart, systematic and efficient way.

heading: Introduction
content: While reading when people encounter a problem then they can open RATES application, which has two modules, desktop and android. Working of each module is same along with some constraints. However, each module is described below with screen shots of working criteria. When user open the application it asks user to take image from gallery or any other storage area or user can take ima ge via camera. When selects image from storage or take image via camera, application shows a window to adjust the width and height of the image. User can select the knobs and adjust the size of the image and press OK. When user press Apply Optical Character Recognition (OCR) button, RATES scans the image through Tessaract OCR Application Programming Interface ( API) which allows the recognition of printed characters. It also allows photo scanning of the text character -by-character, analysis of the scanned -in image, and then translation of the character image into editable format. Therefore user gets an editable text format of the textual image. When user selects text  then all the RATES operation like Find Dictionary, Translate  text, Search on Internet, Text to Speech, Get Summary, and other  operations like copy, cut, select and even delete operation  become active for  the selected text . When use press on ‘find dictionary’ option the application requests Oxford dictionary API and gets short definition, word history, usage example, word class, synonyms, antonyms and pronunciation for the select word. When user taps on ‘translate text’ then the application display list of multiple languages and user has to select one target language. When  user selects one target language, RATES requests Google translator API and gets translated text of selected language for the selected text. When user selects ‘search on internet’ option for the specific text or image, app provides more specific options for searching such as ‘search related content’ and ‘search via keyword’. When user selects ‘search related contents’, i t provides online results based on selected contents . While when ‘search via keyword ’ is clicked, a list of keywords appear and user selects a keyword and gets google search result based on the select keyword for the selected content. When user selects ‘text to speech’ option for the selected text, RATES starts to read out the selected text. While when user select ‘get  summary’ for the select ed paragraph or paragraphs, the application display menu for summary length (standard, medium and extended). User selects summary length. The application analyses paragraph. It extracts the main idea and provide summary  of respective length. When user select an image, RATES display two options ‘search on internet’ and ‘label image contents’. Search on internet works like ‘search related contents’ which is described above. When user selects ‘label image contents’, RATES sends request to Google Vision API  and gets labelled image, which detects individual objects and faces in image and also provides description of all set of objects. heading: Abstract
content: In the digital world of computers, several software applications have been developed to ensure spellings of various words. English language is found to have gone far  ahead in development for spell checking applications whilst other languages specifically naming Urdu, lack behind to cherish such technologies. Our project “The Urdu Spell Checker” handles detecting incorrect spellings of a word and providing a list of op tions containing correct spellings with other possible words of similar text formation alongside; latter is chosen on priority basis [Tahira and Sarmad 2007]. The application carries correct spellings of words residing inside a predefined lexicon or corpus . It is to ensure whether entered word is correct or not. In case the input matches corpus, word is considered correct. Furthermore, the application provides an interface to enter words which are to be checked. Although not worldwide, but Urdu spell checker application is a big necessity for people of Pakistan reason being Urdu to be the national language of the country. Now developed, the application can help Urdu writers, poets, journalists and other workers in similar fields save their time checking spellings manually and rely on this application software to correct the spellings for them. Table of Contents

heading: Introduction
content: Issue of programmed spell checking is not new in the ranges of Information Retrieval and Language processing. The exploration began as early as 1960s. A wide range of procedures for discovery and amendment of spelling errors are proposed since past 40 years. Some o f these procedures exploit general spelling mistake patterns while others utilize the phonetics of incorrectly spelled word to discover likely correct words. Lately, statistic based procedures, which are not exclusively based on error trends but through tr aining, adjust to error patterns, have gained greater prevalence. Many of these techniques are being utilized with text editors and other context handling and are demonstrating great execution. All things considering the issue of spell checking is as yet thought to be open for additionally research and upgrades. There are two reasons behind considering this issue still unsolved; one has to do with the execution of existing methods and other with their scope. For the first reason in Natural Language Proces s it is advanced over the year. The text that is computed is sufficient and errorless. But as far as we are concerned about the human implies spellchecker it is so much reliable. Automated spellcheckers have few choices which the replace the word with. But with human implemented spellchecker we have a plenty of choice and we choose the word accordingly which is actually 100% correct. This level of accuracy has not been achieved. The second reason for considering the spell checker application is that the ar ea of this language is not so vast. As we consider English or Latin languages much work have been done in it. Every language spellchecker has a boundary in checking other language. In English spellchecker you want to check the spelling of French you will f ail on the first step because it is outside the boundary of the system. Therefore, even English which is very vast language is limited in its scope. From the above discussion it is concluded that for making a new spell checker software one has to clearly i dentify the language specific issues and deeply investigate general spelling error trends of the language, only then a reasonably effective spell checking approach can be proposed. Urdu is also a language which is written differently  from English. It has its own patterns and technique of writing. Therefore, existing techniques will not be applicable on this language without modification. This document presents the details of a study performed on Urdu language to identify the problem areas of Urdu spell che cking and to test the effectiveness of existing spell checking techniques on Urdu. So we have given a  hybrid approach for Urdu spelling error correction which uses a combination of more than one existing techniques. These techniques are modified to cater U rdu specific problems and make the software or technique reliable.

heading: Objectives

heading: Introduction
content: In Pakistan there are many flaws in educational system, one of the major issue is that there is no such a system for educational institutes which ensures the time scheduling issue and teachers availability in absence of any teacher or in case of shortage of any subject based teacher in any institute under HEC. However there are some universities based systems in western countries which tackles some similar problems but there is no such a centralized system in Pakistan. So we are proposing ADHOC Centralized Teachers Availability And Monitoring System Using Ontology For HEC. This is the system which ensures the lecture delivery in institutes to minimize the missing lectures ratio to improve our educational system and to best utilize the availability of internal and external teachers in their free timings so we may be able to avoid rescheduling of missing lectures, which may cause disturbance of routine and wastage of time. Every teacher of universities will register in this HEC centralized system by secure and accurate mechanism. Also that teacher will be the permanent or visiting faculty member of any university under HEC regulations. The purpose is to use HEC owned resources when required to any other university within the distance concerns. Any permanent faculty member when wants to avail a leave, he/she will apply through this system. After authorization from university, similar subject- based teacher will be searched by the system. System will check their availability, their presence in specified distance and forward request. Then system will ask their accessibility under visiting faculty rules and regulations with sharing lecture contents that needs to be delivered. However lecture material will be provided after accepting the lecture request from the system. There are three steps involved in our project where we apply different data techniques; we are using no SQL technique so all data related to system will be arranged semantically by using editor protégé tool  to make Ontology. The structurally arranged d ata would be in form of RDF/OWL format. Retrieval of data is done on basis of Semantics. Ontology describes the domain in terms of properties and classes which include description of different objects. SPARQL is an RDF query language that is used to generate queries to perform different operations and functions on the semantically arranged data , the data would be accessed and retrieved  by using SPARQL instead of SQL because our data is stored semantically. Our system will be web and android based. SPARQLlib is a PHP library to communicate with RDF files. EASYRDF will provide a way of interaction with RDF files using SPARQL.

heading: Introduction
content: The application we have produced, Albatross, is an android application that brings people even closer together by providing them a cheap and reliable source to find the people they care about. Albatross helps friends and family members look for their loved ones know by knowing their location in hour of need. Since typical tracking applications require GPS and internet connection simultaneously (referred to literature review) to track the mobile phones, our application will track them using GPS or connected cell towers location only, via SMS. The acknowledgement (hand-shake) between users will make them track each other, at any time, via the SMS service. Our application will be available on Android app store only. Major Albatross provides following functionalities:  Hand Shake.  GPS based tracking.  Cellular network based tracking.  Camera takes picture in case of 3 wrong unlocking attempts.  Wipe entire target’s mobile phones data.  Lock target’s mobile phone with target known custom password.  Ring and vibrate target mobile phone.  Location on SIM change.  Location on battery power less than set threshold.  Save tracked location history From above few, handshake, GPS based tracking and cellular based tracking work as follows: The users will download Albatross from the play store of their respective mobile phones. The user will then sign in to Albatross to become a member. Once a user has become a member, the members will then form hand-shakes with each other via SMS. Member 1 will send encrypted SMS (containing his / her IMEI number) to Member 2 for handshake access. A notification will be generated as the SMS reaches the Member 2 mobile phone. Member 2 will tap the notification to accept or decline the request. Member 1 can mean-while himself / herself, also, delete the sent handshake request. Member 2 will acknowledge (accept) member 1’s request. As member 2 accepts the request, Albatross will send an encrypted SMS to member 1 containing Member 2’s IMEI number. Albatross will save IMEI numbers of member 2 in member 1’s mobile phone and of member 1 in member 2’s mobile phone. This will be one time only and will allow the members, who have shaken hands, to access each other’s GPS

heading: Architecture
content: The following figure shows an abstract level architecture of Albatross, based on peer -to-peer architectural style. Here the peer -to-peer architecture is composed of components/peers and connectors. The members in a ha nd-shake represent components while the data streams, passing network messages between components work as connectors. Every component is connected with a connector that connects the component with every other component in the family. For example, there are four members A, B, C, and D. A, B, and C are members of the same family i.e. A is connected to B, B is connected to C and C is connected to A. While a member of a family can also be a member in another family i.e. C is connected to D with a hand-shake. The main purpose of implementing peer -to-peer architectural style was to avoid data centralization. Further purposes of using this architectural style are:  Every peer acts as a server to entertain another peer that will be acting as client.  Every peer actin g as a server will help us maintain database of the application for the member, his / her hand-shakes, and family members in that member’s mobile phone.  Peer-to-peer architectural style supports a two way communication between the components.  If a mobile phone gets lost and finder of the phone factory resets the mobile phone to delete the application, peer -to-peer architecture will help us keep the data (like mobile’s IMEI number) in the mobile phones of other members of a family.

heading: Abstract
content: Albatross is an android application which provides an efficient and less costly mean of tracking a mobile phone or loved ones yet providing the application owners monetary value against the services. Albatross uniquely identifies its different members using their IMEI numbers and all the communication between members takes place via SMS. Users signup to Albatross to become Albatross members. They then form handshake by one member acknowledging the other member’s request. This helps the member to share their location only to their concerned ones. Albatross saves members’ contacts to their phone memory. Apart from this Albatross provides many exciting features like wipe; lock; ring; take photo on 3 unsuccessful phone unlocking attempts; tracking history; edit profile; and delete a member from White List.

heading: Abstract
content: Employees are the most valuable asset o f an organisation. T he application is then approved or disapproved. Moreover employees don't know about the status of their application while being processed. To provide ease to employee and remove paper work we are going to introduce online leave management system.  Here come s the Business Process Management that is for the improvement of this process . The whole process will be workflow based in which tasks and information is passed from one participant to another for some action.  In our system , employee have to login into sys tem & select apply for leave option. Fill the required form and send it for approval. This application would be receive by approval authority. Which may approve your leave or send it to another authority for further approval. So whole process will be workflow based, at the end decision that was made by approval authority on application would be sent to employee. In a result employees will stay tuned about the status of their application and the all the work is online which is time saving.

Workflow ensure that right work is done by the right person at right time, so we will use workflow technique to solve our problem. We are going to build an online system for comsats employee, so they can apply for leave online & avoid from traditional system. heading: Introduction
content: There was a time when people are unaware of science and technology but people knew that they cannot do all the research alone they have to rely on the work done by the other people. So, whenever someone do any research they used to write it down as a document on the paper so the other people can learn from it for their own research. But there was a problem that if a person is doing research he has to get information by reading the research work of many authors and it was difficult to find them. So, libraries w ere built that contain different books and research papers of different author from different countries. It made people easier to learn things to do research and gain information but still it was not enough because one cannot find all the work of people in the world in one library. Then mankind evolves, era of science and technology started and internet introduced. It made the life of the people much easier because it connected the whole world. Now people can get any information, book, data, research work of any author from all over the world at any time. The existing solutions provide so much help to people because you have search engines that can give you all the files, document and research papers again st the keywords. But most of the time those results are not relevant to what you are looking for. As now internet itself a gigantic library that contain almost everything but the problem is to really find something that you are actually looking for. It is just like you walk into the library and you have to find a one file from billions of files. A person now has access to all the files but he does not know all the names of books, authors file and research works. So, he has to search by a keyword to get all the research work that is relevant to that keyword. But the search engines do not provide all the documents and that makes a person equal to the person of the ancient times who did not have access to all the books, files and research works for his research. If a person wants to get all the relevant data, the only option he has, is to search by a key word, find the files that are most relevant to his topic, check the references given in those files and search them too to get actual data he wants. Or user has to upload a pdf file and search engine will search its references and show the relevant results searched from the references.  All that things are very time consuming, and that makes almost impossible for most of the people to adopt this method and hence they have to rely on less data given by the search engines. The project is to made this Page 8 of 36 method automated, so people can get quality data from all over the internet without wasting so much time.

heading: Abstract
content: The Online Systems help us in purchasing of products and services. Nowadays people are leaning towards online shopping because it saves time, but existing systems of buying products have numerous drawbacks. For online exploration, trust is the main issue and our challenge is to build such a system which recommends the customers the desired/ideal product with inadequate resources and consequently building customer’s trust on our system/product. Now the trouble with existing online system is Bootstrapping problem, that is, if a new Company emerges in the market then the existing system cannot generate rating for it; same goes for new product. This issue causes an uncertain situation for the customer to, whether go for the existing product with less specs or the new product of a new company with much higher specs in same price. There is a need for a system which can remove this problem of bootstrapping at granularity level. If granularity level is high, the level of details of the product will be deeper and it will help in making a system in which customer’s trust can be restore. This system shall strengthen the decision-making power of customer.

heading: Abstract
content: “Fun with Stickman” is a stickman game engine application. This application is developed using the .Net Framework. This application will provide a platform for creating stickman games. Players will be able to create and play a wide variety of stickman games. Players can create games using the built-in features present in the application. This application consists of a toolbox with a wide variety of features and built-in animations and arcades for creating games. Players can create and customize their stickman character for the game using the features and options available in the toolbox. Players can create games using the built-in animations and drag and drop features present in the toolbox. . Players will simply select an animation and drag and drop features from the toolbox into the animations to create games. As compared to conventional game engines, this application is easy to use, people of any background can use it to create games without involving any sort of coding or programming.

heading: Introduction
content: “Fun with stickman” is a stickman game engine. The major mot ive behind doing this project was building a unique product that is different from ordinary gaming applications. “Fun with stickman” will change the way how gaming is done, unlike ordinary conventi onal games this application is unique in its own way .The major interests behind doing this project was my interests in animation and gaming. This application is a perfect blend of high quality animations and provides a unique gaming experience. By introducing this application in the market players will be able to create as many games as they want with ease and will be a constant source of entertainment for them. “Fun with stickman” is a windows form application that will basically revolve around the stickman character. A stickman character is generally used to represent a human figure. This application is a game engine for the stickman. Stickman is  the main character in this game. This application will allow players to create game for the stickman. This goal will be achieved through the help of built in features and animations in the application ’s toolbox. Players will  be able to create their own games according to their imagination and level of perception. After cr eating and designing their games players will be able to play their created games easily. This application allows players to build their games through a step by step process. First, the players will select a basic stickman using the options available in the toolbox. After selecting the stickman players will be able to customize the stickman. This goal will be achieved through built-in features in the toolbox. This toolbox will provide players with a wide variety of options to customize their stickman. After designing the main character for their game players will  be able to create games for the stickman with the help o f built-in animations. Players will simply select an animation and will start building their game with the hel p of drag and drop features in the toolbox . Players will select any feature from the toolbox and drag it onto the animation. Players would be able to create their games according to their level of perception, imagination and how they want their game to be. After creating their game, players will be able to play their created game.

content: Following are the goals and objectives to be achieved during this project. i. heading: Problem Statement
content: In the present time there are numerous game engine applications available like Unity, GameMaker and GODOT etc. One thing all of these applications have in common is that they involve some type of coding to create games and all of these applications have very complex features and functioning which can’t be understood without proper knowledge and practice. As game engines are becoming very popular there is a need to have applications that make game development convenient and simple. So that people interested in game development can easily experience the pheno mena of game designing and development. Computer Science has evolved a lot in the past few decades, but not everyone is familiar with coding or programming. So, the purpose of this project was to build a game engine with such features and functionality tha t allows people from diverse background s with having no  proper knowledge of coding or programming to easily create and play games.This idea has been brought to life using the .Net Framework and windows form application, having built in tools, animations and arcades that will allow players from any background to easily develop games.

heading: Scope
content: With the passage of time game engines have become ex tremely popular in the gaming industry. Developing games from scratch is not a trend anymore and majority of the game developers use game engines to create and develop all sorts of video games. Pakistan’s IT industry is growing very fast with game developm ent being the fastest growing area.  With the rapid  development in the gaming and animation industry in Pakistan developing animated gaming applications like “Fun with Stickman” can prove to be very helpful and can actually create an impact.  As developers I think we need to work to promote and help our industry grow as much as possible. So creating a game engine that can be accessed and used by any sort of user to develop games will prove to be extremely helpful for the growing gaming industry in Pakistan.

heading: Literature Review
content: There are thousands of stickman games available online. Some of the most popular stickman games are Stickman Impossible Run, Stickman Games: Summer, Stickman Ski Racer, Gun Fu: Stickman, Stickman Basketball, Stickman Soccer, Stickman Tennis, One Finger Death Punch, Stickman Battlefields and League of Stickman etc. “Fun with Stickman” will not be a simple game like these gaming applications, but it will  be a game engine. A game engine is a software that allows developers to build 2D and 3D games. There are many famous open sour ce game engines available like U nity, game maker studio, Panda3D, CRYENGINE, Blender game engine, GODOT, AppGame Kit and Marmalade SDK etc (ElHady, 2017) . Majority of the game engines available are used to develop games using programming languages like python, C++ and C#. The Game Maker Studio is a game engine that allows players to build video g ames using a drag and drop format and uses a scripting language known as Game Maker Language that is used to write scripts and events in the game. The GML is used to enhance the control and functions in the game (YoYoGames, 2018). This system will also have a toolset consisting of features that will be used by simple drag and drop method. The main difference of our system from the Game Maker Studio is that it will not involve any type of coding to enhance the controls and featur es in the game. The application will have already built -in animations and controls to be used in making the games. The players will not have to use any coding to build the game. The application will provide ease of use to the players. Similarly the GODOT game engine also provides drag and drop function to build the visual parts of the game but that is not simple enough to use and involves a lot of complex procedures. GODOT has its own scripting language known as GDScript that is closely related to pyth on in syntax so people with strong background knowledge of python can use this game engine easily. GODOT also uses open source C++ modules to improve the controls in the game  (GodotEngine, 2017). Our system unlike GODOT will be simple and easy to use, players of any background will be able to build games without having to use any additional scripting or adding any modules. The system will be user friendly and will be easy to use. Players will not have to write any type of coding to create games. Unity is one of the most popular game engine these days. It is easy to use but it also has features that require you to use C# and Java script. Using unity also requires a lot of experience as building arcades and scenes for the game can become difficult for the players (Unity, 2017). In “Fun with Stickman” there will be a variety of ready to use animations and arcades, players will not have to create any new animation, they will simply select an animation and will start creating games by dragging and dropping features from the toolbox. All these game engines are used to create games for multiple platforms such as android, iOS etc. But “Fun with Stickman” will only create games to be run on windows platform. “Fun with Stickman” is also character specific, this application will only create stickman games any other type of games cannot be created.

heading: Abstract
content: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a task to identify Named Entities (NEs) in a text. NER is a very important step for Natural Language Processing (NLP) which is a subdomain of Information Extraction (IE). The focus of this project is NER for Urdu Language which is a low resource language in terms of availability of benchmark corpus and related research. Significant amount of NER research has been done for English and other western languages, but NER for Urdu Language is a very challenging task. It becomes difficult to recognize NEs due to presence of words from other langu ages, no capitalization of Named Entities, ambiguous names that can also be used as common nouns or have multiple associated meanings with them. The goal of this project is to create a Dictionary and an NER for Urdu Language.

heading: Introduction
content: Named entity recognition is an NLP task that can detect entities in text and then classiﬁes them into their respective entity types such as persons, organizations, locations, events, etc. It is a field that has seen a considerable amount of work done in re cent years. Most of the credit goes to the Message Understanding Conferences (MUC-6) which is the sixth MUC Conference. NER grew to be more accurate in MUC-6 and MUC-7 by using statistical machine learning models trained with human -annotated data over rule -based model.

heading: Problem Statement
content: As there is a lot of information present in today’s world, there’s always a need for a system which can help us in gathering relevant information from all the data that we interact with. NER is just another tool which can help us in extracting information which can later be used for different purposes. This project aims to develop a NER System for Urdu Language which works on the same or more efficient principles of NER Systems developed for other major languages like English so that people can use this tool to extract information for the text available in Urdu.

content: Following tool and technologies have been used for this project:

heading: Future Work
content: Following are the major goals for the future of this project: • Further refinement of the Dictionary Lookup Technique • Expanding the Dictionary • Expanding the features of the System Our major focus would be trying to make the DLT more efficient. For this, we can use different approaches of Supervised Machine Learning like Hidden Markov Model or Rule Based Approach. These approaches can be implemented using the Dictionary as a training set or using these approaches along DLT to improve efficiency of the System. Also, refinement can be made in the Dictionary Generation Process in order to make it less time consuming and more efficient. Expanding the Dictionary can improve the results of our System as it would be able to detect even more Named Entities found in text. This can be achieved by adding more NE for all NE classes into it. Currently our system works for NE class Person, Location and Organization. In the future, we want the system to detect entities like Time, Currency, Measurement Units, et c so it can serve as the most versatile NER System for Urdu Language.

heading: Introduction
content: With the advancement of web and mobile technologies, various innovative solutions are proposed in the market which are made to improve e -commerce experiences of both the buyer and the brands/vendors. The rise of e-commerce in Pakistan has resulted the interest and investments of various venture capitals and companies including some major players such as Rocket Internet [1]. Various marketplace models and solutions are introduced recently which tend to solve the problems of consumers and businesses e.g. Daraz [2] and Kaymu [3]. From shipments to payment securities, product comparisons to discount offers etc. The ability of an e-marketplace to fulfill the needs of both consumer and businesses determines the success of the marketplaces. Since the needs, require ments and expectations of buyers and sellers from the marketplace keep on changing with the passage of time, the existing system does not remain adaptive so there is always a need to improve that system or even sometimes there is a demand to introduce a new system. The basic model of the existing marketplace remains the same; such as listing, buying and selling of products etc. There are some strengths that make these marketplaces successful.  However, there remains some loopholes in current solutions due to which th ese marketplaces cannot fulfill the needs of customers and/or sellers. One of the major weakness in the existing marketplace is the digital product marketing which is quite an expensive and time-consuming task. Brands and businesses often hire a team of digital marketing professionals which makes it a little more expensive. If not, freelance digital marketers run advertisement campaigns for the brands which requires their constant attention and monitoring. Another weakness in the existing model is that they are commission oriented. Brands must pay an enormous amount of commission on a sale of an expensive item. Our proposed system is not commission oriented rather it encourages the seller to grow their businesses. The problem of digital advertisements can be solved with an automated online marketplace solution where brands and businesses can continue their sales as well as digital marketing campaigns on various rich-user social platforms such as Facebook, twitter, Instagram etc. This marketplace will contai n all the modules that are involved in sales, analytics and ad campaigns. The analytics section will allow the seller to critically analyze the customer’s behaviors, sale’s growth and ad performance, so that the seller can recommend trending products to its customers and grow their business. The ad campaigns section will allow the seller to advertise its products on the rich -user platforms like Facebook, Twitter and Instagram, so that the seller can acquire more potential customers. It will be a lot time saving and cost effective for businesses to manage these three task s from single platform. On the other hand, the machine learning and predictive techniques are used to identifier the patterns of sale and purchase of products based on customers and market trend behaviors.

heading: Objectives
content: 1. To develop an All-in-One solution for the brands allowing them to list and market their products on the same platform. 2. Allowing brands to do more online business without paying commission on sales. 3. To develop business analytics for individual brands allowing them to monitor their sales.

heading: Problem Statement
content: The e-commerce sector has grown to a great potential in Pakistan. More and more people are attracted towards e-commerce rather than traditional markets. With this increasing growth of customers, brands find it difficult to find the correct audiences for their products. The need of an automated marketplace arises here where brands can create their storefronts, list their products and market them to the right audience.

heading: Scope

In the recent decades, a lot of work is done on e-commerce and many platforms are available for sellers but on  this platform which we are going to create is very effective for emerging brands. 1. Commission free sale of products. Brands will pay for only the features they use. 2. More focus towards brand empowerment. 3. Complete analytics of product sale on mobile applic ation and website so that brands can analyze the growth, profits and impressions etc. 4. Automated marketing solutions for brands so that they can run their marketing campaigns on rich-user platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and Twitter. 5. Brands consider th eir brand identity as a prime factor when entering a marketplace. This includes their fonts, logo, designs, layouts etc.

heading: Abstract
content: The developed web application not just run as a business but help s other businesses run through it’s different modules like marketing automation, audience selection and analytics. Sellers can easily setup their products on their storefronts and set the pricing and discount offers. They can keep record of orders and sales for each product. Once the product is listed, the system allows the seller to run marketing campaign to engage more customers to the listed product. The campaign runs on rich -user platforms Facebook and Instagram which are proven to be best converting platforms for ecommerce. The analytics and insights section help the seller to know to targeted audience which will be most likely to buy the product. The customers, on the other hand , will get a wide pool of brands and their products to choose from according to their need, budget and preferences. Our machine learning engines help the customer find the best product taking into consideration his own actions, the actions of the other users having same interests and the products.

heading: Introduction
content: Our aim to make delivery system more and more efficient reliable easy to deliver and low cost for our customers. There are many problems which people face in delivery process, like they have to pay extra charges for extra weighted and also for urgent delivery. We are solving these issues through our idea of direction base delivery system. We are providing urgent  delivery system city to city and within city too. We deliver things through registered persons with our system. For example, a person is travelling from one city to another and a person wants to deliver something to that city where the registered person is going, he will take his material and deliver it to the specific point. Our system will also charge less than the other delivery system. This project is basically a direction based delivery service. There will be number of registered persons especially tr avellers which are travel on daily basis with our system. The registered persons have to be clearance for security issues and their data will be testified through our system. His / Her criminal record will also be checked. After their registration with our system they will be allowed to deliver through our system. The one who wants to deliver something will post his request to our website with required detail. Now one of our registered person will response to the request to that requested (sender) person. A fter contacting each other delivery person will deliver the product to the require destination. After the package arrives at the destination the sender will be notified about it through our services. The receiver should have valid code and CNIC to get the package from our delivery person. We also providing facility that if someone wants to get something from other city and location he / she can post request of that thing and our register person who is coming from this direction and get this thing for this p erson. Sender will have to pay the charges to the System. The payment will be divided into the ration of 70:30 for delivery person: system. Motivation and Scope This project is basically designed to improve the delivery system by decreasing time consumption and shipment cost. Our system will provide the live tracking (Streaming live geo location) method for both sender and receiver. There is a lack of such service in all courier company currently operating in our country. Time saving: Our system will be time saving .As most of the deliveries will be delivered within hours or in less time. The customer will be able to select his desired route and the delivery person will then deliver the package to its required destination. Our system will be a very quick system as compared to the other delivery services because the delivery will be done by the person who will be already going to the place where the sender wants to deliver his package.

heading: Conclusion
content: This project presents an idea of a new and innovative way of delivery system. Our project will consist of registered personnel who will be registered with our project. Using these people, our customers would be able to deliver their respective products/items through these employees. Our project is mobile based which would show the customer the complete route that the employee would be taking to deliver the package. It would also show the estimated time of delivery as well as the name and cell number of the employee delivering the package. Gantt chart:

heading: Abstract
content: The project aims towards the development of cognitive robots which possess certain level of Artificial Intelligence.  Scientists have been putting their efforts to build robots that can perform different tasks and solve daily life problems efficiently; but still they lack human intelligence and cogni tion. This project includes cognitive frameworks for designing and implementation of simultaneous localization and navigation approach, and utilize computer vision as a primary technique for the development of robot. Here cognitive system is referred as a system which has a tendency to acquire knowledge about environment and perform rational actions according to the collected information. Cognitive framework will provide artificial general intelligence (AGI) developers to program and implement cognitive constructs in robotics (for example ASIMO and iCub ). It will regulate mental activities of the robot in order to ensure the smooth execution and synchronization of cognitive cycles. Robot will localize itself in the environment and navigate towards its destination by recognizing and avoiding obstacles throughout the path. Indoor navigation and Obstacle Avoidance in Domestic Robots

heading: Objectives
content: The aim of this project is directed towards the development of domestic service robot whose basic functionalities are navigation, localization and obstacle avoidance. And to achieve that very purpose the robot requires to interact with the environment, that is where computer vision comes in as a driving force.  More specifically the final objective of th e project is to develop an application that can operate a robot which performs the task to localize itself in that particular environment , detect the obstacles and reach to its destination by avoiding the Indoor navigation and Obstacle Avoidance in Domestic Robots obstacles in its path. The project develops a syste m for a robot that performs following functionalities:  Implementation of localization and navigation techniques  Implementation of image processing technique for visualization and recognition of surroundings and its own position using Kinect sensor.  Recognizing obstacles, landmarks and objects.

heading: Problem Statement
content: To build a cognitive robot that can simultaneously perform localization and navigation through an indoor environment by avoiding obstacles.

heading: Literature Review
content: A lot of progress has been done in Artificial Intelligence. There have been numerous research and findings with a great pace but still there is a huge gap between expectations and achievements (Samsonovich, 2012). In spite of all the advancement in the field of robotics, still a question rises that will there be an era of rob ots with humanoid brain? Currently there is a need of cognitive architecture that is close to the computational model of brain besides focusing on a particular behavior or on domain specific problems. Most of the researchers have developed cognitive architectures that generally includes perception with components like better movements, sensing features, communication, surveillance etc. There are some enhancements needed in those architectural designs with more human like qualities such as emotions and blending in the society, so that the landmark of domestic usability of robots can be accomplished.

heading: Abstract
content: Indoor navigation and obstacle avoidance in domestic robots project is an initiative towards an era of highly advanced robotics. It is a stepping stone in introducing cognitive robots in the mainstream industry where robots can work as a very efficient human assistant and reduce a lot of human efforts and expenses. There is a need of endowing human intelligence in the robots so that robots can get the ability of decision maki ng. That is mainly the reason why this project is built using cognitive architectures. The idea is to make robots a part of this society and give them human like skills. The basic objective was to decrease the gap between machine and humans. In ou r project, robot can detect new obstacles and decide for another path to avoid them. Hence it can be a one step forward towards the development of the robots with human like abilities.

heading: Introduction
content: A mobile game is a video game played on feature d phone, smartphones etc. These have been developed , since 1994 , to run on a huge variety of technologies and platforms. Famous platforms which are widely supported are iOS by Apple, Android by Google and Windows by Microsoft. Virtual Reality system is a computer technology that generates realistic images, sounds and other sensations with the help of sensors that helps to simulate the user to feel himself in a new different virtual or imaginary world. It was first introduced i n 1960 and the device named as Telesphere Mask. The environment created by this technology engage his senses to feel himself as a game character. In technical terms, Virtual reality is the term used to describe a three-dimensional, computer generated environment which can be explored and interacted with by a person. That person becomes part of this virtual world or is immersed within this environment and whilst there, is able to manipulate objects or perform a series of actions. Virtual Reality system needs a virtual reality headset that displays virtual dimension to the user and controller to operate. Virtual Reality Headset consist of 2 lenses which are responsible for mapping the distance of eye with the lenses for wide field of display view. It is important to avoid readjusting focus to prevent eye strain. Lenses provided different angle of view. This project is based on Virtual Reality technology consisting of a main character and zombie models. These models are designed using blender in cycle render option. User using virtual reality headset has to kill all the zombies to clear wave and the stage as well. Points will be earned by the users each time it kills a zombie, to buy extra options of weapon and featured grenades. User will use different type of guns and grenade to achieve its goal.

heading: Introduction
content: The game is about a character’s journey to the top of a mystical route, to a place where he has dreamt of going his entire life. The player would be shown a title video in the beginning of the game, where our character, Andy, describes a magical place that is said to exist only in myths and legends. He describes the past efforts and all the struggles that people have  made to reach that place. However, no one has ever been successful in reaching the top. Andy also describes his life and all the hardships he has faced. He talks about how he has been bullied throughout his life and feels worthless. His grades are poor and even his parents are disappointed with h im. He decides to prove his worth to his parents and anyone who has ever bullied him, by climbing up to the top of this difficult route. This is when the player will take control of the character, and begin his ascent. The game will start at the bottom of  the route and the player would encounter new levels and environments as Andy progresses up the route. The objective of the game is to reach the top, while facing all the hurdles, obstacles and enemies on the way. The player will control the character by swiping left and right on the screen to move the player respectively and tapping on the screen to use his special power . There will be other controls apart from these basic few, depending on the situation the character is in. The different environments will include sewers, mountains, buildings, etc. Each environment will feature new textures and unique things to climb, such as pipes, rocks and ropes. The enemies will also change depending on the environment. For example, you’ll face bats in the sewers and eagles in the mountains. There would be collectibles along the way that would either make his journ ey simpler or more challenging. These would eithe r increase or decrease the player’s speed, thus making the game harder or easier, respectively. The game would also implement a stamina system. The player needs to use his special power i.e. the power of will to battle the enemies. Once the power is used, the stamina diminishes and is restored after a while. Thus the player needs to accurately time the use of his power, in order to fight off the enemies and continue the journey. The game will feature various cut scenes in order to create a strong storyline.  These can be in the form of animated sequences or a slideshow of pictures. During the journey, the player will also get to know Andy’s thoughts. His observations or thoughts will be displayed in the form of text at the bottom of the screen at various poin ts throughout the game. This will let the user know what’s going on in Andy’s mind at the time. He could be thinking about something from the past, or his current situation, or about what he plans to do once he reaches his destination. Showing this thought process will help strengthen the storyline.

heading: Conclusion
content: The team was faced with various challenges along the development process. Although we were familiar to the game engine, but the 3D modelling tool was relatively new to us. Designing the character, its various attires and the environmental models was proving to be very time consuming. Thus, we used the character available on MIXAMO  [6], as well as royalty -free 3D models from other websites including OpenGameArt [7], TurboSquid [8], etc. Creating the animations took up a lot of time as well. Unity does not have a very sharp learning curve. You don’t face major problems while using the game engine. However, writing the code scripts is a tricky part. C# language was used for coding, and creating the logic for various game mechanisms took a lot of effort. We learned that once you define the logic, the rest of the process is quite simple. Syntax of the engine -specific code can be found in the documentation or at other online resources. Once you figure out the logic, you can easily convert it into the desired code. Another thing we learned is that sometimes we overlook the little mistakes which cause big problems later on. While focusing on the big picture, we accidentally make some spelling-errors or place some lines of code in the incorrect order. These mistakes happen when we don’t pay attention to detail. Going back to the editor and debugging a code once it fails to compile, is also very time consuming. Thus, it is better to be careful while writing the code, so that we don’t make these little mistakes in the first place.

heading: Abstract
content: Toxic Comment Detection refers to the detection of the toxic comments during online text -based conversation. The background of the problem originates from the multitude of online platforms, where -in people/users belonging to various religious, region, culture and fields of life actively participate and make comments, social applications are the best example for this. There are many social applications where users mostly do text-based interactions. There is a possibility that the pattern or selection of words  during online text-based conversation may expresses the culture, religion and norms of the users. So, there is a chance  that the comments sometimes may be abusive, insulting or ever hate -based, it becomes the responsibility of the hosting organizations to ensure that the conversation are not of negative type. This problem raises the importance of toxic comments detection and to develop  a model that could make prediction to classify the co mments. S ome applications are also developed including Perspective API, Friendly Chat, Facebook Suicide Detection. The main aim of this project is to apply n-gram models. We explored two variants for n-gram model: word n-gram and character n -gram. The length of word n-gram varies from one to three  and the length of character n -gram goes from three to ten.  For feature extraction , we used TFIDF vec torizer and COUNT  vectorizer. We used supervised machine learning technique for binary classification. Regarding machine learning algorithms, we explored RandomForestClassifier, DecisionTreeClassifier, LinearSVC, AdaBoostClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, RidgeClassifier, MultinomialNB and BernoulliNB. For training these models, we used train_test_split technique. For validating all these Machine Learning algorithms, various evaluation measures are used including Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 and ROC_AUC. The best Accuracy and F1 score for binary classification are 0.66 and 0.48 respectively. In deep learning, we used bi -directional LSTM and got 61.09% Accuracy. The final product of our project will be a prototype system which  will predict the unseen/new toxic comments in English Language.
