heading: Abstract
content: Software requirements are considered as the main building blocks of a software system. But it is very difficult way to build a software system just from the requirements. Usually requirements are in natural language(s) and are considered as non-technical. Here we need a software architecture that provides ease to the technical persons to understand the model of a software system. Software models are the true reflection of requirements. A small amount of change in requirements can vary the behaviour of a model. The feasibility to implement the stated requirements can be verified by analysing the models. Nowadays Software industry is adapting Model Driven Software Development (MDSD) that involves less human interaction and more automation. The base of MDSD is a software model which depends upon requirements. Virtuous requirements produce a perfect model that leads to an efficient, flexible and reliable software product ultimately. Project is suggested as an application of Model Driven Engineering (MDE) and its aim is to provide a shared and collaborative platform with synchronized web and mobile (android) interfaces to remote team members in purpose to create/edit a syntactically and semantically verified software model on the base of structured requirements.

heading: Introduction
content: Suggested project is the core application of Software Engineering domain. Day by day the domain is going mature and demands maturity throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). After Requirements Engineering, designing itself is a challenging phase so the need of hour is to give more concentration on designing to gain better development results. Complexity of a software model grows as the complexity of requirements increase. To overcome this complexity, Software Designers needed a tool (A Software) that will work like a bridge. In fact, a syntactically and semantically verified model is the need indeed. Project is recommended as a designer assistant to the software designers. Its uniqueness is that it produces the software models on the basis of software requirements; like a traditional designer and it is not just like drag and drop or drawing tool. The Project is focused to provide synchronized web and android interfaces to the software designers to generate UML diagrams. Initially project is bounded to the Class diagrams with synchronization. Currently the scope to reuse the modelling artefacts is limited as compare to code reusability, so the designers redesign the similar models from scratch that demands the high investment of resources. With the availability of collaborative and shared space, verified models can be used to design analogous model or to gain an insight to a domain. As each software system has some inputs to operate on outputs, inputs and outputs for the proposed system are the structured software requirements and a software model respectively. Structured requirements mean that requirements are captured under some rules and regulations and is bounded to write the requirements in a pre-define format. Major and the most important component is to capture and analyse the requirements and provide a suggested model on an editable canvas that is derived from the provided requirements. On the canvas, explicitly end users can modify the model and as a result requirement will be changed implicitly and changes will be applied to the remote repositories. Both requirements and models will be controlled with a joint traceability mechanism. To join the system, each user will have credentials to login to the system and the user that will initiate the project will have the administrative privileges. Other team members will join the project. At the end, final outcome is a requirement based verified model that was collaboratively designed by team members.

heading: Objectives
content: Our goals and objectives that we want to achieve are listed as  Provide software engineers with an easy to use tool on their desktop and mobile devices (Android) which will be able to generate a model from the requirements provided by them.  The goal of the application is to provide time saving and on the go facility to software designers so that they can work while in conditions where they do not have access to a computer.  The user will be able to use the application while in transit or in situations where it is hard to get their hands on a computing device.  The application will be easy to use compared to the standard applications available on the computer as it would provide a web interface which requires no unique computer specifications and also a touch screen interface which will be more interactive than a standard mouse or pad.

heading: Problem Statement
content: The software requirements and designing process has gone through drastic changes over the years and people want to get their work done as swiftly and efficiently as possible. The software designers now require a means by which they can efficiently record the requirements of their client and understand the project by the help of a clear visual model.

content: Room to this application is limited to UML class diagrams. Requirements format is rigid to a structured format. It doesn’t provide a direct interface for freely drawing. And in mobile technologies, it will be available just on android operating system.

heading: Related Work
content: As Software Engineering (SE) field is near to automate every possible work and now it had been turned toward Model Driven Engineering (MDE) to automate software designing. To achieve this goal world had started work on it. There are both new research and old development work available in the market. In the start developers developed just drawing tools to draw software models. After the passage of time mature tools were also developed like MS Power Point, MS Visio, Visual paradigm, Concept Draw etc. All of them are desktop base applications and support manually drag and drop. Now the market demands have changed from manual desktop base drawing or drag and drop applications to the automated mobile and synchronized software designing tools. There are also android base applications like “Draw Express”, “UML Creator” and “Flowdia Diagrams Lite” etc. The coolest feature of “Draw Express” [1] is that it provides freely drawing facility over a canvas where you can draw roughly images and it will convert it automatically to the similar well-formed images. You can easily handle each activity by your fingers. “UML Creator” [2] is also an android base application that provides colourful icons for entities that is its beauty which makes it more attractive and it also provides extension to the network diagrams. Another android application “Flowdia Diagrams Lite” [3] provides an interface to create UML diagrams but it is specialized to business process and process flow diagrams. Again, the issue is that these applications are not generating requirement base verified models. Besides these desktop and android base tools, there is another touch-base application named as “Calico” [4]that provides sketch-base designing environment. [5] It provides a freely drawing canvas where users can draw roughly and approximated sketches of models which they have in their minds during discussion. And they can refine these sketches to a precise model in future. Calico uses slates, tablet PCs, electric white boards and iPads to operate it. [5] In the above examples developers are paying their best to work out in this field, researchers are also paying their part. Like code versioning, [6]Mr. Rocco and his peers described a concept of shared and collaborative repositories for model versioning. As the size and complexity of a project exceeds the number of team members also increase, and they required shared resources to work on the project. The idea of collaborative repositories provides ease to a community of users. The verified and validated models can be shared with beginners for learning purpose. In the publication, Mr. Rocco supports the idea of creating models at collaborative repositories with an example. Some nontechnical challenges are associated with the shared repositories, one of them is to control the quality of artefacts and manage their sharing. uploaded models should be analysed to satisfy the quality of required requirements before sharing them to other users. heading: Architecture
content: System architecture is an iterative process through which system functionalities are translated to construction of the system. This blueprint is the structured solution that meets all the functional and non-functional requirements of the system. During this process, series of decisions are taken on wide range of different factors that have considerable security, performance, portability, usability and overall success of the system. Simple structures can be built without any architecture but like any other complex structure, complex software applications must be built on any architecture or foun architectures have great impact during the development of software application. Fail to design simple modules, failing to consider your key components or fail to consider your key decisions can put your application at a risk. Most of the risks are exposed due to poor design or architecture of the system. That’s why architectures are most important for software applications. System architectures are designed at high level of abstraction that involves the high es in different parts of the system. There can be multiple architecture that can be used to build a complete system. These architectures are called “Software Architecture Styles” that had been already used in different systems.

heading: Abstract
content: Blockchain is an advance technology which is used as a mean to transfer digital currency from one node to another using a peer to peer network where secure transactions can be made. Bitcoin is a digital currency based on Blockchain technology that is extensively ado pted by different organizations and people . Many hackers are trying to steal the Bitcoins by accessing your system. For every transaction we need a combination of public and private keys to sign any transaction. Wallet is the main part where public and private keys are stored. So to avoid hacking and stealing of the coins a secure wallet is required. If we save our key properly then chances of hacking can be minimized. Storing the whole private key on the wallet increases the chances of threats of hacking. We seek to fill the gap between a transaction and a secure wallet. This report figures out issues of already existing wallets identified through literature review and proposes a new method for a secure wallet. Steganography along with hacker deceiving technique aims to protect the private key for the wallet. Therefore, this combination decreases the chance of stealing Bitcoins. Our wallet serves to achieve high availability, security and effectiveness as a product. It is feasible to use by customers withou t any professional knowledge.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Bitcoin is a modern mean to money transfer services. It does not disclose the identity of a person . If we look at traditional way to send money, there will be a third party which is bank. Bank will store all the data of sender and receiver. In Bitcoin system, no third party is included in  money transferring so that people are more attracted towards this technology. Blockchain is also very secure, decentralized technology and it creates trust among the people by verifying the transaction. The transactional information is stored on each node. Everyone contains the log on their transaction on their own so, no one can make fake transactions otherwise the chain will breakso the Bitcoins uses Blockchain technology to transfer money. To keep the coins, people need to have a wallet. The Bitcoin wallet consists of the Bitcoin address and each wallet contains a key pair the public and private keys. Public key is used to encrypt the message and private key is used to decrypt that message. As the name shows public key is publically available to everyone so anyone can send coins to your public address. The private key is just like a password hence, so it is kept private so that no one else can decrypt your script. These keys are used as the locking and unlocking script for the transaction  so, if someone knows your private key it would be very easy for him to decrypt your script. Whenever any wallet is installed, it generates a key pair for you to make the transactions. That key pair is neither encrypted nor store d on a  secure place. Sometimes, the keys are stored on local storage and sometimes in wallet. It is very easy to get the keys from wallet and from the local storage.  An attacker can attack to the wallet and can get the private key to steal coins without any hurdle. Though the Blockchain provides a secure medium for a digital currency but insecurities lie in the Bitcoin wallet. If a wallet is lost this means that the public and private keys information is lost and eventually the Bitcoin is lost. Moreover, the information provided to the wallet providers will also be lost and the attacker can use these leaked information leads to the marketing purpose. Spam messages are sent to the account so it is important to secure these wallets. There are different means to store keys like online storage and offline storage. Everything that is kept online is not safe. User has to face difficulties while using online means of storage. Although it is very convenient to get the key from cloud but it is a ccessible to everyone. Offline storage has its own disadvantages  like availability issues it is not available all the time and if you store the key in an offline hardware, it may get lost and it will never come back. The security of wallet is really needed  because if it is not secured then the owner will face difficulties in terms of money. His all the coins will be transferred to other account and due to anonymity of the technology he can never track the attacker. Sometimes an attacker will become the owner of your wallet when he gets the key; he can easily control your wallet.

heading: Abstract
content: Hand paralysis is a common consequence of stroke which significantly impacts patients’ daily activities. Hand rehabilitation is important to allow the patients to regain lost functions. The present project concerns the Smart Wearable Hand Rehabilitation system which combines both Mirror Therapy and Task-Oriented therapy. The system consists of two gloves: a sensory glove to be worn on the unaffected hand, which measures gripping force and finger joint movement with force and flex sensors, the other one is a motor glove for the affected hand with micro motors for performing rehabilitation exercise. Th is Project involves employing Machine learning algorithms (ML) like Support Vector Machine ( SVM), Random Forest Regression (RF, Gradient Boost Regression (GBR), and Decision Tree (DT) with accuracy of 96%, 60%, 50%, and 50% respectively that will complement the existing system to increase the recognizer to distinguish the small finger gesture required for mirror movement therapy for individual fingers along with the coordination. Besides mirror therapy, the proposed system contributes to task-oriented rehabilitation which provides different training tasks. The material used in gloves is Rexine which is tender and elastic compared to stiff and rigid appliances that are associated with conventional devices; therefore, the system is more appropriate for long-term use during the rehabilitation in homes. Further, it also consists of an application through which hand rehabilitation may be done by feeding different gestures to be performed and all the data contained on the application. A combination of advanced machine learning approaches, soft robotics and therapy makes the system a useful tool in to improve hand dexterity and functionality in the stroke patients. heading: Introduction
content: Stroke is a life-threatening condition caused by the death of brain cells, with around 55% to 75% of survivors experiencing impairments such as paralysis. The loss of ipsilateral motor function, or hemiplegia, is one of the most frequent consequences of a stroke [1]. This ailment frequently has a serious impact on one's quality of life and imposes a major strain on family and society. Rehabilitative treatments with assistive devices have been successful for paralysis caused by limb problems, particularly for big motions and extremities function. To solve this, this study presents a cutting-edge smart rehabilitation tool that helps patients regain finger mobility, especially those who have lost the ability to move their fingers voluntarily. These wearables, which make use of state -of-the-art mobile and Internet of Things  (IoT) technology, enable patients to perform repetitive hand exercises, such bending and stretching their fingers, without requiring continuous hands -on therapy. A properly calibrated servomotor enables these movements, and real -time motion data is transmitted to a mobile application or secure web platform [2]. Patients recuperating from neurological injuries like strokes, spinal cord injuries, or traumatic brain lesions require hand rehabilitation because these conditions have a significant negative influence on motor function and quality of life. Repetitive, strenuous exercises that need careful therapist supervision are a common feature of traditional rehabilitation therapies. But the development of sensor -based technologies has created new opportunities for more individualized and successful rehabilitation plans. One such innovation is the creation of wearable gloves with sensors that play an important part in rehabilitation by leveraging machine learning  (ML) and IoT. Wearable sensor technology and ML algorithms have revolutionized the area of medical rehabilitation. Wearable gloves as shown in figure 1-1 are cost-effective and allow patients to exercise at home, reducing their reliance on doctors and physicians [3].

heading: Scope
content: The Hand Rehabilitation Program aims to assist patients recovering from hand injuries or surgeries by improving their hand function, strength, and dexterity. The project is designed for individuals who have experienced hand trauma, surgeries (such as tendon repair), or neurological conditions like stroke. The goal is to provide a tailored rehabilitation program using wearable gloves for therapy using ML and IOT.

heading: Literature Review
content: This project discusses the most recent information found in the peer reviewed literature.

heading: Introduction
content: Integrating sensors into wearable gloves along with ML and IoT increases the efficiency of rehabilitation. Flex sensors measure the bend of a finger or joint and convert it into electrical resistance. These sensors are worn on the affected hand. Force sensors measure force applied by the patients during rehab ilitation exercises and give feedback as well. These sensors are worn on the non-affected hand. Data from the affected hand goes to the machine learning algorithms such as RF, SVM, GBR and DT. These algorithms analyze how much rehabilitation is required an d improve patient's efficiency of recovery process.  As this is a classification problem, these algorithms provide accuracy, precision, recall and f1 score as evaluation parameters. Additionally, IoT will display various exercises a patient requires and will show the rehabilitation percentage. Through the integration of IoT technologies and ML algorithms, these gloves facilitate data-driven insights, real-time monitoring, and individualized therapy [10].

heading: System Design
content: The high-level design incorporates the interdependence of hardware, software, and connectivity components, ensuring real-time processing and data accessibility.

heading: Implementation
content: The proposed system will be a complex integration of the cloud -based communication, wearable devices and machine learning to help in real-time tracking and replication of hand gestures. It has two hardware components, the Sensory Glove and Motor Glove. The flex and force sensors of the Sensory Glove are introduced to detect the pressure value and movements of the fingers in a secure way that enables the user to capture the movements of his hand. Wireless transmission of this information with the help of Firebase Realtime Database has guaranteed low-latency, constant communication. To permit the interactive gesture imitation, data analysis with the Motor Glove will be performed, and that will utilize actuators or motors to sketch the prompts on the receiving end accordingly. The Sensor input is then interpreted, binary types of gestures are modeled, and the precision and reactiveness of the system are enhanced with a bespoke Machine Learning (ML) algorithm.  Also, a mobile application created on the Unity platform serves as a user interface and enables the system performance visualization, control, and monitoring in real time.  Such applications as teleoperation, remote rehabilitation, or human -computer interaction may use the proposed intelligent, responsive solution based on the easy integration of hardware and software items.

heading: Conclusion
content: The project reveals how to use different smart technologies such as sensors, microcontrollers, wireless links and machine learning, to construct a smart rehabilitation system for hand patients. The project focused on providing a glove -based system that is affordable, real -time and easy to use for patients in rehabilitation after stroke, accident or surgery. The result was a flexible glove sensor system that measured both finger motion and the pressure generated by the user. A sensor’s data was collected and sent using an ESP32 microcontroller which acted as the data collection point and a connection to Wi -Fi. The movements of the patient’s active hand are recorded by the glove and used to guide the motors on the other glove. To relearn motor skills, as well as practice bilateral training, therapists often use this reflective strategy in physical therapy. A Machine Learning model was applied to review the sensor data, detect anything unusual and sort out several types of finger movements. As a result, the system can help with movement and also measure the improvement made during rehabilitation. Using IoT platforms, therapists or caregivers could see a patient’s activities in real time and review previous activity logs using the cloud dashboard. It’s particularly helpful for remote rehabilitation. Old-fashioned ways to build hand strength are usually the same, require close supervision all along and are boring for the individual doing them. Due to automatic steering, immediate response and flexible modifications, this technology handles these difficulties. The use of IoT and ML in the glove allows physiotherapists to closely supervise their patients’ exercises, record key outcomes and improve their patients’ rehabilitation overall. This glove system reproduces the newest concepts in helpful healthcar e and wearable devices, giving an adjustable, budget-friendly choice for use at home or in hospitals. It supports rehabilitation since it makes the needed movements simpler, leads patients to use their hands frequently and requires fewer visits to a therapist. For the most part, the prototype did as the specifications said, but there were a few issues. Repeated calibration of sensors improves the accuracy of the collected data. Their construction prevents servo motors from moving in the same flexible manner as a hand. The model currently works, but it does not have much variety because it was trained on a limited number of examples. When data is expanded, the model can be modified to cover more cases. Future improvements may involve: • Vibrations as feedback to encourage users. • Involve adaptive ML to observe and employ a user’s unique actions. • Developing a mobile application for easier interaction, controlling different actions and seeing the outcomes. This project proves that interdisciplinary engineering can greatly help solve problems in healthcare. By using both electronic, embedded and mechanical tools along with machine learning and IoT, the sensors in this rehabilitation glove help bridge the difference between common physiotherapy and recent technological advancements. Using the glove system provides a range of useful benefits. This glove can be afforded by most people worldwide, in contrast to commercial rehabilitation robots or exoskeletons that  are often costly. Users can benefit from therapy at any convenient place by taking the portable and wireless device home. Because of ML, the system may learn from a person’s progress, making rehabilitation programs more effective and appropriate over time. With IoT, the glove collects and exchanges real -time rehabilitation information which helps therapists follow patients’ progress, determine the best course of treatment and change strategies as necessary. Being an academic and engineering project, it allowed us to put our classroom lessons into practice. Students could apply sensor hardware, handle control system design, lea rn algorithms and experience network communication. It also focused on the difficulties of creating real-time systems, controlling noise in signals, using what’s available in hardware and keeping healthcare solutions focused on users. Besides, this effort may serve as an early effort for future, more involved rehabilitation systems. It forms a path for new roles of augmented reality ( AR) for virtual therapy sessions, AI to improve movement diagnosis and cloud -based access to collaboration and health record archives for therapists and clients.

heading: Abstract
content: Skin diseases are most common diseases all over the world and they spread more in populated countries. Skin diseases also affect the patient’s confidence. So, the early detection and prevention of skin diseases are very important. Skin diseases detection needs a high level of expertise. An android based system is proposed in this project for efficient skin detection. Derma diagnose is an android based application which takes an image from the user and detects  the image if it is one of the five diseases which are Psoriasis, Scabies, Fungal Infection, urticarial and Eczema. On the click of a button, the user can diagnose his skin disease using the system. An interface will be provided to the user by which he can capture the image of the infected skin and fill the provided questionnaire related to the skin diseases. The application will send the image to the server where all the pre -processing, segmentation, feature extraction and classification will be done and t he result will be sent to the user. The user can also get information about the diseases, get home remedies for the five diseases or search for a doctor (dermatologist). The system will only work for android based devices.

heading: Introduction
content: Human skin being the largest organ of the human body protects the body against many viruses, bacteria, allergies, fungal infections and controls human body temperature. In developing countries, skin disease is particularly common. [1] Skin Diseases change from nation to nation and even from area to locale inside a country because of different hereditary qualities, social customs, and environmental elements. [1] It is important to diagnose the skin disease in the early stage not only for medicate patients but also avoid spreading of transferable diseases. Around the world, skin diseases skin is among the most extensively known medical issue [2]. Due to its complexity, dermatology is the tough territory and hard to identify. For a large number of people, it is costly to consult a dermatologist in the growing countries [3]. In a developing country, the worldwide use of smartphones has opened up new opportunities  for affordable diagnosis of diseases. Nowadays we are familiar with the camera technology which is available almost in every smartphone and utilize the image processing abilities of the device for diagnosis of disease. [3] This expert system will be designed for awareness in population. Education of the people can help to lower the chances of skin problems in any community. In a specific area of knowledge, this expert system acts like a human expert. [ 4] Sometimes symptoms like swelling, redness itching and burning due to damage of skin can cause frustration [4] In a Department of Dermatology, King Edward Medical University Mayo Hospital Pakistan a total 95,983 patients suffered from skin disease. [1] On human, skin diseases also have a psychological effe ct. It has been stated that after a lot of observations that psoriasis increases depression, stress. On the other hand, severe acne can also cause depression, anxiety, lessen self-esteem and lessen self-image. [5] Skin diseases have both damages to the peo ple skin and also their social life, destroying their self-confidence resulting in depression. For diagnosing internal structures of the human body, medical imaging is now broadly used in medical science. This helps us to look inside in the body without r eally opening the body. Thus, for the evaluation and identification of the treatment of a disease medical imaging definitely has become an important tool. heading: Abstract
content: In Natural Language Processing  (NLP), the Semantic similarity is one of the core fields that are  used to measure the level of similarity between two linguistic items (words). Semantic similarity between words has important usage in natural language processing, Information retrieval and Artificial intelligence. There are two commonly used approaches in measuring similarity one is by using thesaurus i.e. WordNet and secondly is by using corpus-based approaches. The project purposes a corpus-based approach using knowledge- based techniques. For this purpose, a corpus is created and the knowledge represent ation technique is to be applied to find the similarity score on the scale of 0 -4. There are many systems for semantic similarity in the English language you just enter the two words and their similarity score is shown. Similarly, we have developed a system for an under resourced language i.e. Urdu. Our system uses various text similarity techniques to find the similarity between two given words. For test purpose we have used a dataset containing thousand words annotated by the linguistic experts.

heading: Problem Statement
content: There is a great amount of unstructured data flowing online whic h can’t be used without any processing  and the re searchers have predicted that will reach to 40 zettabytes in 2020,which results in a 50 fold growth since 2010 in the computer world.  A renowned magazine computer world’s stats shows that unstructured inform ation on internet is 70 - 80% of the total data available [1] .We can’t transform that data into something useful yet but we are in dire need of something that will transform that data into some more useful.

heading: Scope
content: We are building a running prototype of our project that tells us the similarity between two Urdu words. Our prototype will take two Urdu words and give us a similarity score (i.e. from 0-4) based on their semantics. We want our project design to be simple and eas y to use (e.g. we can run our prototype on DOS to get the similarity). We will use Java Language for our prototype development. We will be using many NLP (Natural Language P rocessing) techniques including Knowledge-based techniques and maybe ML (Machine Learning) techniques to teach our prototype on how to give similarity score when a user enters two Urdu words using our own Urdu Corpus (i.e. training data).

heading: Introduction
content: Stress is a feeling of pressure on the human mind. A type of psychological pain. Stress can be divided into two types. Good and bad stress. Good stress is beneficial for yo u, encouraging you push forward and get things done. However, bad stress caused by excessive amounts of stress is harmful for your body. It can cause headaches, anger, fatigue, lack of interest, and change in appetite. And can increases the risk of heart a ttacks, and mental illnesses such as depression and panic attacks. Stress is related to anxiety, and is the dripping of adrenalin into our body. Adrenalin is a chemical released by the brain into a person’s body when that person faces a fight or flight si tuation, Adrenalin is released into our body in order to survive. In the past this helped our ancestors protect themselves from predators. But today, this causes stress. Stress is something which everyone faces. And unfortunately, most people do not know how to manage it in a healthy way. Some common, but unhealthy ways people cope with stress are nail biting, pulling their own hair. Turning towards alcohol as a coping mechanism. Developing a habit to smoke cigarettes and or other drugs. “Eating the stress  away” meaning excessive eating, another habit people develop to cope with stress which can lead to being overweight and even diabetes. And excessive sleeping. Stress, anger and anxiety can be managed in a healthy way. A quick way to reduce stress is by first distancing yourself, this can mean moving to a different location such as going to another room. Distracting yourself, changing your thoughts to something else. Distorting the thoughts, so that the previous stressful thoughts do not come back, and if they do, they are not that stressful on your mind. And delaying, trying to delay the stressful thoughts. These techniques help people reduce their stress. Another great and popular way to reduce stress is by catharsis. Sharing your problem. This gives peopl e the ability to vent out their frustrations and anger. And possibly get great solutions to their problems. And lastly, the most effective way to avoid extensive and unhealthy stress is by being proactive. Having a ‘to do’ list. Completing different tasks on time.

heading: Introduction
content: With the growing population, traffic accidents are on e of the emerging problems our society is going through. Road crashes are the 9th leading cause of death globally. Nearly 1.3 million people across the globe die in road crashes each year with an average of 3,287 casualties per day. Unless an action is taken to encounter this problem, traffic accidents are predicted to be 5th leading cause of death by 2030. Recently on 25 June an oil tanker lost control and crashed on the highway near the city of Bahawalpur. A local mosque in a town nearby announced it on its speaker. When the locals heard about the oil tanker’s crash, they rushed to the site, not to help but to collect the oil for their personal vehicles. While the locals where busy collecting the oil, a disaster struck. The fumes of the oil from the tanker ignited by a spark, the source of the spark hasn’t been yet confirmed. The spark caused the tanker to explode and killed at least 200 people. Most people died as the responding teams didn’t had the facilities and weren’t prepared for so many victims. This  was a tremendous tragedy and the people suffered a great loss. We should do our best to prevent from this kind of event to take place again in the coming future and to provide best possible efficient emergency services in such situations. Conventional vehicular sensor systems for accident detection, such as OnStar, notify emergency responders immediately by utilizing in -vehicle sensors, such as accelerometers and airbag deployment monitors, to detect car accidents. Unlike OnStar our system will use onboard sensors of a smartphone such as accelerometer to detect car accidents. The sole purpose of this project was  to design and implement such an automated system that counters these emerging problems and reduce the casualties as much as possible. The detectio n system would help reducing fatalities stemming from car accidents by reducing the response time of emergency responders. The system would counter the other emerging problems by notifying the respected concerned authorities about the incident . For example letting the ambulance know the location of an accident that toke  place, and its exact location. This would let the respected authorized personal to take action accordingly, and reduce the damages and fatalities. The end product would be such an intelligent system that would utilize internal sensors of a smartphone to detect any automobile crash and then interact with the nearest rescue station to communicate the exact location of the incident. The system would guide the authorities with the shortest possible route to save both time and energy. The patient’s report will be sent to the doctor before he reaches the hospital.

heading: Objectives
content: Our projects goal is to decrease the level of casualties and losses which occur from traffic accidents by decreasing the response time of emergency responders. Smartphones and their onboard sensors are promising platforms for constructing such intelligent systems.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Nearly 1.3 million people die in road crashes each year, on average 3,287 deaths a day.  An additional 20-50 million are injured or disabled. Road traffic crashes rank as the 9th leading cause of death and account for 2.2% of all deaths globally.  Each year nearly 400,000 people under 25 die on the world's roads, on average over 1,000 a day. Over 90% of all road fatalities occur in low and middle-income countries, which includes Pakistan. Most people don’t die directly on the impact, but they die as they don’t get medical attention quick enough. The main reason of not getting the proper medical response i s that the responding authorities are not aware of the accident. Our system will automatically inform the authorities about the accident. Another reason of not getting medical treatment on time, is that the responding authorities don’t have the exact locat ion of the incident. Sometimes there is a confusion that on which side of the road the accident happened. This is due to the fact that responding authorities don’t use a proper loc ation tracing system. Our app  will provide a proper system to guide  the responder to the  exact location. Our project will decrease the response time of the Emergency response teams. This would increase the probability of saving lives.

content: This project has a scope to save many lives and could benefit our society in the upcoming future, as it saves time and energy of the responding authorities. It can be used in any hospitals and people all around the world hospital. This system minimizes the delay to inform the respected authorities of the situation in hand. And eliminates the option of that person is sending in lame and false message of the incident, just for a gag. To do something just for the betterment of the people in the world is a fulfilling feeling all by itself. And implementing this project gives us an opportunity to do it.

heading: Abstract
content: Our project is an android based accident detection system. It’s a mobile app that automatically detects accident. The user has to install app in the phone and activate the sensor that would automatically detect the accident. After detecting the accident the application sends the user ’s location to responding authorities. O ne app is for the responder that would receive the victim ’s location. The responder will respond accordingly. The responder will then immediately get to the victims location to provide q uick assistance. The responder will generate a report of the victim. The report will consists of victim’s credentials e.g. the victim’s name, address, blood group, age. This report will be send to the doctor, in this way the form of the patient will be aut omatically filled so that arrangements for his treatment can be made before the arrival of the patient.

heading: Methodology
content: The research methodology used in the proposed system is Qualitative. Qualitative research introduces non-qualitative sort of dissection. Qualitative examination is gathering, dissecting and deciphering information by watching what individuals do and say. Qualitative exploration is considerably more subjective and uses altogether different strategies for gathering information, mainly individual, in-depth meetings and focus groups. The first step in this project is to gather the requirements and reduce the deficiencies of the current methods, which are being used to analyze the crops. In agriculture sector  the crop monitoring currently is not being analyzed by an automated system in Pakistan. While the proposed system is based on sensors and is able to monitor crop more accurately. In recent years, the agricultural part of the country has been confronting genuine issues, for example,      decrease in harvest yield, increment in input costs, water issues, Soil issues and decreased acknowledgment of agricultural items in global markets. In phase of implementation, sensor values are captured through the sensors attached to the  Waspmote sense respective values i.e. temperature, soil moisture create frames for these values and send to Waspmote, upon receiving frames, Waspmote send all the frames to the Meshlium. Sensor parser run upon the receiving of the frames p arse them to structured data and save it to the local database. The synchronizer on Meshlium runs after every 5 seconds and synchronize the data on the connected cloud database. So that we have a synchronized data on all the devices connected to the cloud database. After computation, data-mining algorithm is applied on dataset and efficiently determines the crop water stress level. The provided instructions are based on the stress level of the crop which is determined by using Data Mining algorithm. The data-mining algorithm that has been implemented is J48 algorithm which generates the results efficiently, accurately and with less error rate. This algorithm uses the Supervised Machine Learning to predict the outcome. Supervised Learning is when you have input and output variables and you use Page 17 of 71 algorithm to determine the approximate mapping function. According to the mapping function it predicts the output for the new input data. This algorithm follows the Classification for Prediction Architecture. Figure 1 Classification for Prediction Architecture [4] The values stored in the database is the agriculture data. The agriculture data is further used as training set and test set for data -mining algorithm implementation. Pre -processing phase is implemented when there is need of removing unwanted or adding required information. According to our dataset the agriculture database is the pre-processing data. The pre-processed data is further converted to ARFF file for algorithm implementa tion using WEKA. The training data -set is used to determine the mapping function. The new input data is the test set in which the mapping function is applied and predicts the output. The input variables are crop name and crop water stress index. The output or class attribute is the stress level. First training phase is implemented and generates a knowledge base according to the Page 18 of 71 dataset. After the system does training, it implements the classification algorithm i.e J48 on the test dataset. It retrieves the predicted outcome on the basis of previous training. In testing all modules are tested individually involving data extraction, data Pre -processing and classification. All these modules are tested successfully. After integration of all these modules the wh ole integrated system is tested again.

heading: Abstract
content: We are living in the era which is getting fast and busy day by day, and due to which most of the people prefer online shopping instead of getting time in their busier routine and buy things for them. Especially when it comes to buying footwear of right size that what one expected is fairly a difficult task. This project aims towards the design and implement ation of Image Processing framework for the research and development of measurement of human foot. The project application process the input image from the user and then apply different techniques based on Image Processing. Our main objective is to find the size of the human foot through static image, after  analyzing the input image and then  applying Image processing techniques on the image . After successful estimation of the human foot size, the project application will analyze the results and provide sugg estion towards the products that are relatable to one ’s foot size . So one who is interested in buying footwear online could not face the difficulty regarding the size of the foot or the footwear. In this way one can shop for the footwear without having the fear of choosing the wrong size products.

heading: Introduction
content: In this era, people are so much busy in their routines that they don’t get enough time to shop for the things they love. For this purpose, E-Commerce is preferred, which let them get their things at home at ease. There are many applications which let the o ne to shop for online footwear’s. The user must have to know their exact foot size for the purpose of buying the footwear that they want from the application. In addition to that the user must also have the knowledge for different scale size of different f ootwear brands and companies. This project aims to develop a software framework, which can be utilized by users to help them measure the size of their foot. This framework will provide a set of interface for measuring the size of the foot. This project will be mainly used for online shopping purposes so that the user gets the right size of footwear that best suits the user. This framework is the implementation of image processing in MATLAB, and Android as an interface. This application requires the user to  take the picture of his foot or select a previously captured image with a reference object, which will be used for the purpose of measuring the depth of the image. The image from the Android interface shall then be forwarded to MATLAB in the result of the successful integration between Android and MATLAB. Image processing techniques are then applied on the image to analyze the image and measure the foot size after measuring the depth of the image with the help of the reference object, and applying the regression function on the image. The foot measured results are then sent back to the Android interface where the user shall be shown the size of his foot. According to the measured size of the user, the application shall then display the footwear products tha t are relatable to the user, and allow the user to shop for the footwear products that matches his foot size.

heading: Problem Statement
content: With the rapid development in the field of mobile application, user expects less effort and more output. And most of the users are focused on saving their time in performing their task. There are no applications that can allow the user to measure his foot size from the app and displays the relevant results to the user. When it comes to buying footwear of right size that one expected is fairly a difficult task. Different companies and different brands got their customized scale of sizes and one cannot adjust accordingly even if one knew ones exact foot size. There is no mechanism for the user to facilitate the problem of measuring the foot size and getting only relevant products in the results by saving the user’s time, no matter he is a novice or expert user.

heading: Scope
content: Everyone expects from an application to save time for performing the specific task. The user expects to save as much time as possible in buying footwear online. In the most cases the user got confused in the size of his foot and the size written on the product. The user might be unaware of his foot size or in the other case might not have the knowledge about the size scaling of that product company. This application save the user to measure the size of the foot and display the results that are relevant to the user. The application shall measure and analyze the results of the image and then provide the user with his required expected products. This shall be a pretty better source of shopping the footwear online according to user needs and expectations.

heading: Abstract
content: Measurement through Image Processing is based on the techniques of Digital Image Processing. We take an image as an input that contains our region of interest i.e. foot and reference object i.e. coin. The image is uploaded to the server. The server is connected with MATLAB and MATLAB reads the image by the path stored in the database. MATLAB extracts the foot with the help of Threshold color mask on the YIQ color space. The pixel of the foot is measured with the help of bounding technique in the image processing. The reference object is extracted from the image with the help of Threshold color mask on the same YIQ color space and then extracted with the help of combining the different image processing techniques. The extracted coin is then measured and passed on to the regression function as with the foot pixel value. The regression function then predicts the foot size with the help of provided data. The results are then passed on to the database. The size value is then displayed by the Android Studio in a dialogue box and then a list of related footwear products will be shown. The product category on the basis of gender and the Android will rescale the size results to show the different gender product results.

heading: Future Work
content: This application will be used in online footwear shopping to solve the issues in different sizes while buying a product. As different countries have different foot size scales. So, this issue of different foot size scales will be solved by the use of this application. In the future, companies will also be able to use this application for manufacturing customized footwear products. Moreover, Machine Learning will be applied in the future to automatically detect which gender does the foot belong to and which type of the reference object is used.

heading: Abstract
content: Human brain has a very complex structure and understanding this complexity demands high level of skills. Different imaging modalities are being used to identify irregularities in the b rain and MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) is one of them. Radiologists view the MR Images and generate the reports accordingly. But due to the large amount of generated MRI’s, it has been incommodious for radiologists to write the reports promptly. And eff ect of this delay can be catastrophic to the patient’s health. To avoid this, we proposed to develop a semi -automated tool that will take the MR i mages and segment out the tumor d part upon the identification of ROI (Region of Interest). The actual purpose of developing such a tool is to assist radiologists in the analysis of MRI’s and serve for humanity. During the field research we had visited dif ferent MRI centres in Lahore and inquired about their procedure. Private and public centres has their differenc es in giving dates and the rates. S ome of the MRI centres provide reports after 2 to 3 days or some even after a week. Analysing the MR Images were time taking and this is what we have focussed i.e. to provide with a helping tool that will ultimately speedup this process and patients can get their reports earlier. heading: Problem Statement
content: Cancer has been the leading cause of death and in 2015, 8.8 million people died worldwide which is nearly 1 in 6 of all global deaths [4]. The hour of the need is to simplify this process and help the patients in getting the required treatment with as little effort as possible. The development of this tool will surely help the radiologists but it will strong the bond between them and the patients. We will upload the demos on the platforms just to show them how quickly we can detect the tumor and the MRI report can be generated. They will not be required to wait for days and weeks to ge t their reports. If the radio logist is available at the cent re, they can get it within hours or a day.

content: While working on this project, we had a chance to visi t different radiology centres and see their working. No radiology centre generates the MRI report the same day because after taking the MRI, scans are sent to the radiologists who already have a lot to deal with and the scans just get pile up. Analysis of the scan is the most critical and time consuming part. The development of this tool will help the radiologist to speed -up that process. Multiple images can be fed to our tool and it will highlight the tumord part from all of the fed scans.

heading: Abstract
content: Our project marks extensions in research works of Software Define Networking. Software Define N etworking is a field of research and development where we work on separating the control plane from the data plane in a network and instill dynamic routing in the network. Through SDN we can achieve remote programmability of a network and achieve much more  robustness in our network. We tried to simulate SDN environment in a virtualized space in a SDN virtualization software called Mininet. We benchmarked different possibilities in the network and devised algorithms to achieve efficiency in network itself. W e are trying to calculate the most efficient ways to implement SDN in networks.

heading: Introduction
content: Our developments in this project would result in following objectives being achieved  We would be able to replicate complex dynamic networks with the aid of SDN architecture. That would help us cement the benefits of turning to SDN based networking ideology.  We would be able demonstrate the viability of a state -of-the-art remotely controlled network that would sufficiently fulfill the growing needs of achieving flexibility in the fast pace variable networking environment.  It would allow us to show traffic at different nodes and then show how to direct the flow of traffic to meet user needs.  It would suggest the shortest and the most eff icient path in the network to reach optimum performance in the network and meet consumer needs.  We would be able to extract statistics to make decisions upon.  We would be able to achieve a balanced network, which can adapt to   variable needs in the network.

heading: Objectives
content: Our objective is to demonstrate the possibilities of implementing SDN base networks in the mainstream market. We want to show that, how easily can we set up an SDN environment and reap its benefits. We want to show its virtualization capabilities in the simulated environment. With the increasing user expectations, the service providers are facing day by day increasing pressure to keep up with the steep demand of the consumers, with this in mind SDN pr ovide dynamic allocation of resources in the network to provide seamless experience for the users. Our project performs at large bandwidth environments to recreate the scenarios of real life situation, so by replicating those experiences we can correctly measure the scalability of traffic state in the network. We intend to use our project for load balancing and also for providing statistics for the administrator for efficient utilization of resources available in the network. Our project will involve near s elf-awareness of the current traffic situation in the network and we strive to achieve perfect load balancing capabilities in our project.

heading: Problem Statement
content: User demands have been increasing steeply in these days and service providers are striving to achieve competence in every department to meet their user expectations. Although, the current infrastructure of networks does the job, it lacks robustness and var iety. For example to achieve some dynamic possibilities, one must have to be there at the networking facility to program the situation to control network flows. But With the arrival of SDN architecture, network programmability is not an issue now, it abstr acts the complex infrastructure of the network and gives accessibility as well as business value at the same time. Just by achieving dynamic routing and packet forwarding by this architecture provide a significant amount of financial benefits as compared t o legacy networking infrastructures. Service providers can allocate bandwidths or change the routes of individual packets by using SDN architectures. This solves the ever present problem of complexity and cost posed by the legacy systems.

heading: Literature Review
content: The purpose of the project is to implement the shortest path algorithm in a Software -defined Network. It is achieved by setting up our system on virtual machines. Two separate virtual machines are used. One is used to install Mininet while other is used to install OpenDaylight.

heading: Functional Requirements
content: 1. The system shall be able to make forwarding decisions on the basis of simple forwarding. 2. The system shall be able to balance the traffic flow in the topology.

heading: Abstract
content: Advancements in the field of technology has sparked a great question for the service providers and data center owning companies to provide state -of-the-art customer support to their loyal customer-base. As every company is in the race of providing quality services to their consumers, the big question arises at their doorsteps about how to achieve these goal most efficiently. As the legacy infrastructure fails to abstract and simplify the process of networking, it cost companies serious resources to keep the  maintenance of their infrastructures up at all the time. SDN comes to the rescue of these service providers as it provides them with network programmability at lower costs by making the system more robust and remotely controlled. It basically separates th e data plane from the control plane to provide manual manipulation of the traffic at the individual packet level. It keeps the traffic balanced at the most busy times. Our Project demonstrates the viability of SDN on current network topologies and gives st atistics to decide upon the routes that are most efficient for the network flow of traffic. It tries to answer the question of implementing SDN network in the current state of affairs of networking business.

heading: Abstract
content: In public dealing places and departments, the people face a lot of hassles for their turn. Some of the people benefit from this situation and some face severe issues. The one who comes late, sometimes, doesn‟t require to wait and he gets his work done earl ier than those who was already there. This situation creates serious conflicts and it becomes difficult for the staff to handle the situation. We faced similar problems in COMSATS student service centre. To resolve this issue in COMSATS student service centre, we introduced an efficient a queue management system. A person entering in student service centre will get a token number by selecting his concern from the token machine placed at the entrance or reserve the token from his android device. He will not require to stand in queue or rush towards the operational windows. He can see the current serving number and wait for his turn. During waiting time, he can do any other task and utilize his time. The serving persons sitting on operational windows will call  the next person after serving the current client. Operators can transfer token from their counter to another if there are another query. The system will make the announcement for the next client by showing token number and window number on counters and LED screen.

heading: Introduction
content: The rapid increase in the use of technology from the past few years shows the interest of the people in technological development. Now-a-days everyone doesn‟t afford to waste his time and prefers to use technology where it is possible or available. The people shows their interest in automated systems. Most of the automated systems have been developed to map the daily life tasks on systems. These systems solve the routine problems of the people without any hassle and save their time. Many offices and departments are switching towards automation to resolve their issues. In COMSATS, many students visit student center daily fo r their issues related to registration, accounts, admissions and other operations. Due to rush of the students, it becomes impossible for the management of the student service center to maintain discipline. COMSATS student service center queue management s ystem will help the students to save their time by issuing them a token & help the staff of the student service center to serve a student according to his turn. The student will get token of his concerned window only and the staff for that particular task will serve the student. The token will tell about the waiting time to the students so that they can wait for their turn. When the member of staff, sitting at window, call the next student, the system will announce the token number and window number. They c an also transfer token to the other counters from their counters. In this way, the student will not need to ask anyone about his concerned window.

heading: Objectives
content: COMSATS student service centre queue management system will help the students to save their  time by reserving a token from their personal android devices or by issuing them a token with mentioned estimated waiting time on it , showing ongoing serving token number & help the staff of the student service centre to serve a student according to his turn. The student will get token of his concerned window only and the staff for that particular task will serve the student. The token will tell about the waiting time to the students so that they can wait for their turn. When the member of staff, sitting at  window, call the next student, the system will announce the token number and window number. In this way, the student will not need to ask anyone about his concerned window. Here are some COMSATS strategic goals and objectives: A guide for the new people a) The people who come for new admission, they will not need to ask anyone for guidance about operational windows. The token machine, available at door, will provide interface to the visitors. The app in Google Playstore will also provide interface to reserve  token from personal android devices. Using this interface, the visitor will select his purpose of coming and the token machine will give him a printed token that will guide the visitor to wait and visit the concerned section or window. In this way, this queue management system will guide the new people. b) The LED (TV) will guide the people about their turn by showing overall progress of the queues. LED TV will display the current serving token and the coming up next token with window number.

heading: Problem Statement
content: During the peak hours, due to the rush of the  students, it becomes impossible for the management of the student service center to maintain discipline. The students, who came first, sometimes keep waiting for their turn and those, who came later, get their work done earlier. When this happens, the stu dents start blaming the management and it results in wastage of time of staff as well as students. Those people, who comes to enquire about new admission, face difficulties and feel uncomfortable in such situations. To resolve this issue, we propose COMSATS student service center queue management system. It will help the students to get their issues resolved as soon as possible. It this way, they will visit only concerned window on their turn and they will have information about waiting time.

heading: Introduction
content: DPP (Doorway Printing & Press) is a platform that provides digital and offset printing services. It has several sellers under its wing offering their p rinting services. It provides a platform to sellers where they post the detailed templates of their des igns and choose relevant category and sub- category. The details of a template include title, price, quantity, and description, and template image. A specific price is not mentioned in a template because the cost of printing services mainly depends on the price of the paper and the price of the pape r changes after 24 hours in all over the country. Let’s say the price of the paper in Lahore on a specific day is PKR 10 per square foot and the price in Sialkot is PKR 11 per square foot. Right after 24 hours, the prices change and the price in Lahore become PKR 10.7 per square foot whereas the price i n Sialkot changes to PKR 10.2 per square foot. Therefore, standardizing the price is not an option. To overcome this issue and to ensure proper interaction between buyers and sellers, DPP offers a chatting module where the buyer and seller can exchange words related to requirements a nd negotiate a price for a specific order based on the paper rate. The buyer can browse through 1000’s of Sellers’s profiles and their templates to determine which suites their needs. Furthermore, the buyer can also place a custom order with a unique design which can be discussed in the chat. Once the seller and buyer are on agreed terms, it’s time for the buyer to place the order. The order will be placed using Escrow. The seller and buyer will agree on a deadline for the completion of the project. The sel ler will ship the order to the designation of customer on the deadline or even before. Both buyer and seller leave feedback for each other when the contract is closed but it’s hidden from each other so that they may not leave a biased feedback. With the help of rating system, the new buyers get to know about the seller and the quality of his/her services. Feedback system also help in determining the top-rated sellers. Furthermore, the News Feed on the buyer’s end shows him/her all the templ ates that are available on the platform. DPP provides escrow system to support the successful de als among the buyers and sellers. It also provides a Support & Resolution Centre to resolve disputed deals.

heading: Objectives
content: DPP facilitates its users by providing them a commo n platform for their marketing/advertisement purpose. The main objective is to gather all the be st press companies in one place and sell their products to the common people while making sure tha t both the seller and buyer have a great experience. The seller (Press Companies) can upload templates of their designs that they are selling, while the buyer (Customer) can select a template fr om 1000’s of templates or ask for a custom design according to his/her needs (Only in the chat). A contract is made between both parties. The seller ships the product to the address provided by  the buyer before deadline. The personal information of both client and buyer is kept confidential and the escrow system provides payment protection. The Help & Support Centre is there to s olve the queries of the users and may help to resolve a dispute over some contract.

heading: Problem Statement
content: During the peak days (elections days, new admissions in schools or colleges) it becomes quite hard to get the printing and press services as most of t he companies have their hands full of orders. We are proposing to launch such a platform that will help everyone to get their work done in a timely fashion with assurance of great quality at most aff ordable rates. This platform will help printing and press companies to expand their business on a considerable scale and the competition between several companies will motivate them to provide qua lity services within the best prices. heading: Abstract
content: The aim of this project was to propose a concurrent human-computer interaction system based on hand gestures using limited resources. The system  consists of three com ponents: hand detection on both dynamic and static  backgrounds, gesture recognition according to the contours of the hand and human computer interaction according to th e recognized gesture. The aim was  to improve the existing process by combining several algor ithms of scaling, normalization and image filtering to recognize hand gestures and make it possible to recognize relatively complex gestures using only cameras o f hand-held devices. We have used bitmap data as image pointers and a combination of algorithms  to achieve gesture processing as opposed to the traditional hardware based methods. Dur ing the HCI stage, we made sure to avoid  false recognition caused by background noises, improving the reliability of the sy stem. The developed system is  highly extendable for C# image processing projects and  applicable in computer -human interactive environment with more multifaceted formats rather than just handheld devices. heading: Introduction
content: Gesture is a representation of emotional expression or physical behaviour. During daily life, it is a natural communication method mostly used by people with disabilities. It includes both hand gesture and body gesture. It falls into two sub -categories: dynamic gesture and static gesture. For the former, the movement of the body or hand denotes a sign while for the latter, the gesture of the hand or the posture of the body conveys some message. G esture recognition can accomplish human-computer interaction and is greatly different from the conventional hardware based methods. Gesture recognition decides the user intent through the recognition of the movement or gesture of the body or body parts. Ha nd gesture recognition has immense value in the fields of augmented reality (virtual reality), robot control and sign language recognition for people who use different gesture languages. We realize that vision based technology of hand gesture recognition i s a vital part of human - computer interaction (HCI). In the former years mouse and keyboard has played a significant role in the human -computer interaction. However, due to the recent development of sophisticated software and hardware, there is a need for b etter technologies. Both technologies of speech recognition and gesture recognition receive immense attention in HCI. Nowadays, two methods are commonly used for gesture recognition. One is based on professional electro -magnetic devices like special gloves while the other utilizes computer vision. The former is expensive and is used in film industry, rendering useless in certain environments while the latter involves image processing. Even though the performance of gesture recognition based on image process ing is relatively limited, advanced sensors like Kinect has deliberately improved their value. However, such devices are not suitable for large -scale application of HCI since they are expensive and not reliable under certain conditions. The workflow of han d gesture recognition is described as follows. First, the hand region is identified from the original images from the input devices. Then, the features are extracted to describe hand gestures. Last, the recognition of hand gestures is accomplished by determining the match of the feature data. When the region of interest is identified, features are needed to be extracted from the ROI region. Brightness, colour and gradient values are extensively used features. Various features can be used for identifying han d region including t he Gabor filter response, BRIEF , ORB, SIFT, and HOG, etc. For the recognition of hand gestures, various classifiers, for example, HMM (hidden Markov model), CRF (conditional random field), SVM (support vector machine), are adapted, to d ifferentiate hand gestures. Although the recognition accuracy of these refined classifiers is good, the time cost is pretty high. In this project, we present a fast and efficient method for hand recognition because the previous systems developed uses techn ology which is either too expensive or the algorithms applied are outdated and does not bring results which are convenient in today’s time.  Our project makes sure that both of these issues are recognized and eliminated so further researc h can be built upo n our completed work. First, an image is taken from live feed using the camera of a hand -held portable device. The image points of the input image are recognized by the system and compared with the ones stored in the data set. The bitmap data was  used as i mage poi nters using the .NET technology.

content: Objectives of our proposed project are as below: ● To recognize useful gestures by taking images as live feed. ● To match the recognized gestures with the inbuilt data set. ● Achieve fast gesture processing using limited resources and full CPU usage. ● Development and application of  effective algorithms of scaling, image normalization and image filtering. ● To provide image processing researchers with faster and more reliable algorithms. ● To aid deaf people with a system that recognizes their hand gestures and performs functions according to the recognized gesture.

heading: Literature Review
content: There is very less work related to the above topic in recent years but there exist research papers and new methodologies that were developed in years 2010-2014 and overview of some of them is given below: [1] A Research paper on “ A real time hand gesture recognition system using motion history image” published in 2010 describes how most hand gesture recognition systems work under only restricted environments but they used and discussed new techniques such as the use of an adaptive skin colour model grounded on face detection to detect skin colour regions like hands. To distinguish the dynamic hand gestures, a simple and fast motion history image based method was developed. Four different types of groups of directional patterns were trained for the up, down, left, and right hand gestures classification, including the fist and waving hand gestures, there were total six hand gestures defined. Several experiments were done on this approach which gave results that show the accuracy is 94.2% in average and the pro cessing time is 3.71 ms per frame. The data set for this research paper consists of only 6 images which had defined hand - gestures that were recognized by the system. The project that we are making has a greater data set and it builds upon the technology used in this paper. [2]Research paper on “ Hand Gesture Recognition using Multi -Scale Colour Features, Hierarchical Models and Particle Filtering” was published which presented an algorithm and a prototype system for hand posture recognition. Hand postures are represented as hierarchies of multi-scale colour image features at different scales, with different postures having qualitative inter-relations in terms of scale, position and orientation. Detection and identification of multi - scale colour features is performed in each image. Hand states are then detected simultaneously and tracked using particle filtering. All these components were then integrated during the development into a real-time prototype system and the system was successfully tested. This paper uses an algorithm for the edge detection which is outdated and does not yield a clear result. W e can see from the images that the image extracted is not clear which makes the identification of the hand gesture hard and increases the probability of error s. The algorithm used by us is very efficient which makes gesture recognition more accurate. [3] Research paper distributed in 2012 with the subject "Motion Recognition for Natural Interaction with Applications" talked about incorporating Kinect sensor wit h a set -top box that has been produced in past undertakings by Fraunhofer, highlighting a basic UI that gives the client the capacity to cooperate with that interface by utilizing basic signals rather than the typical remote control. This system implemente d the gestures characterized by the old people, in driver Kinteract, utilizing diverse structures that have as of now tools to recognize developments like cursor keys. The developments to control the events "Left", "Ideal", "Up", "Down" and "alright" are a ll around characterized, on the grounds that they relate to the signals made by the older people in the tests. The application utilized the fundamental tools to implement the framework like Microsoft Kinect, RGB Camera, Engine, Microphones and 3D Depth Sen sors. The primary motivation behind this application was the recognition of hand gestures for natural interaction, Lee and Chun [19] introduced a strategy for controlling virtual items, in a 3D co -ordinate system.

heading: Abstract

The point is to enhance the current procedure by joining a few calculations of scaling, normalization and picture filters to detect signals and make it feasible to perceive moderately complex hand gestures utilizing just camera s of hand -held gadgets. The created framework is  extendable and w ill be appropriate in human - automated or other computer- human interactive environment with more complex layouts instead of simple handheld gadgets.
