heading: Introduction
content: A Fatwa is a legal opinion from a qualified person of an I slamic centre usually known as m ufti. Mufti gives his legal opinions on a problem according to Islamic laws. His decisions have significant importance in Islamic society. But it is not an easy task to get a fatwa from a mufti, as one has to personally visit the Islamic centre, write a letter, and call the Islamic centre or via email. To make the whole procedure more efficient there is a need for tracking mechanism which could increase credibility and the user satisfaction. When Muslims face any problem related to the traditional issues, they usually consult some mufti(s) appointed by religious institution of their sect. These dedicated people give their opinions on issues pertaining to the Islamic rules. These Muslims  Scholars are called as Muftis and they possess an extensive knowledge and expertise in the Is lamic world. They are auth orized to give their expert opinions on the subject according to the Islamic rules and scripture. The opinion of a Mufti regarding a pro blem is called a Fatwa. With problems mostly on different aspects of life for example; problems of inheritance, the problem of divorce, problems related to business etc. We have developed a Fatwa Management System in which user interacts with the system, instead of visiting personally, writing letters or calling the Islamic centre. The syste m assigns the user problem to a mufti. Mufti acknowledges it. The system keep reminding mufti frequently through notifications. This tracking feature keeps user satisfaction in the system. That was the main problem in previous systems as the user was kept in dark about his query, he had no idea  how much work was done and could be easily misplaced. Another issue was to access previously given fatwas. This system provides a fa st searching facility which  makes it easy to search previous fatwa making system efficient.

heading: Objectives
content:  Automate the manual system  Minimize the human errors  Make the process of getting a fatwa much easier  Motivate people to get the answers of their questions  Make the process of fatwa more efficient and quicker  Save the resources and time by effectively distributing the work load  Cost and time saving through reliable searching mechanism  Global access to everyone, so anyone can facilitate through this system  Availability of this facility to everyone

heading: Problem Statement
content: We have developed a Mana gement System in which user  interacts with the system , instead of visiting personally, writing letters or cal ling the Islamic centre. The main problem in previous system was the factor of uncertainty and the possibility of human error. Sometimes even the query of person was lost in the paperwork. The following are the problems that occurred in the past, with their brief explanations:  The most common way of asking the problem was to visit the respective institution or Islamic centre. The problem was orally and verbally consulted with the muftis. Because of the verbal conversation the problem and its solution were not recorded. This resulted in computing a new solution for the same problem.  Most of the people who could not come to the Islamic centre. So they usually consulted through telephones and the fatwa was communicated to the concerned person. The problem that arose was that those answers were neither preserved nor documented. This resulted in no history. Hence can’t be published.  The major drawback of previous system was that a lot of time and resources were wasted while preparing the f atwa on similar topics. There was  not a proper way of keeping the record of all issued Fatwas. Searching a Fatwa from b undles of Fatwa’s files was also a time consuming and very difficult task. Sometimes that fatwa was lost or misplaced in piles of paper.  And once the pe rson receives the fatwa there was  no record where that piece of work is gone. Hence if similar cases occur m ufti had to rework and come up with new f atwa that took a lot of energy and time. So, there should be a proper storing mechanism which will help to search and track the old fatwas. Moreover, it will later help to publish the book of the Fatawa.

heading: Scope
content: Fatawa Management System provides a platform for the questioners to get an advisory opinion on different issues from an Islamic Scholar (Mufti). This system supports both English and Urdu language. The user can submit his question in either document file, pdf file or in a plain text. The system also provides a questioner with the facility to ask any question online. The questioner can also search from previously stored fatwa for the most relevant answers. If a questioner request for a fatwa, the head mufti assign the questioner’s query to a mufti. Hence our system overcomes the flaws faced by the previous systems.

heading: Introduction
content: Upserve Dining is a web base platform whose basic feature is to connect the food lovers with the restaurants so they can enjoy the meals at their favorite restaurants at any point of time. The main purpose of this web application is to let the user know about the restaurants in the desired area and then allow them to reserve a table. Table can be reserved from 1 person to 20 persons, varies for different restaurants. After reservation, the user and restaurant is notified via text message or email. User can remotely update their reservation on the go. User earn and redeem points by dining out using our application, these points provide user with the discounts and different offers. This application also provide user with the feeds of the restaurants. These fee ds are the activities that are happening in the restaurants. Application has a tab named as “Feeds”, in which the user can see the activities of their favorite restaurants. Users have the option to star restaurants, these restaurants are considered as favo rite restaurants of the users. User can like or unlike those activities. User can also see reviews, popular dishes, menus, discounts, photos and all the other deals restaurants are offering. Application also have a tab name as “Jobs”, in this tab user can explore the jobs offered by the restaurants. If a restaurant wants a waiter or a cook, it’ll post the advertisement of the job in that job tab, user can review that job and select that job. This provide users with the job opportunities and help restaurants to hire employees easily. Restaurants can create their accounts on this application by simply signing up using their email addresses or phone number. This process creates the profile of the restaurant. These profiles contain the information about restaurants, such as their locations, menus, deals, discounts, number of seats and all the other facilities restaurants are offering. Restaurants can post activities, photos, videos and more on their profile which then can be seen and like/unlike by users. Restaurants can also post jobs on their profile, it help s restaurants to hire employees easily. This application also provides restaurants with tons of optional features such as payment, catering, group discounts etc. Restaurants can use any of this optional feature as they like.

And let them upload menu and deals. • To provide restaurants with various option features such as delivery, loyalty card offers, special seats, group discounts, catering and more. • To allow the user to rate and review the restaurants. • To allow a user to compare two deals and select the suitable one • User can see activities of the restaurant in feeds and can like and review them • To allow restaurant to upload a job vacancy, if any, both part time and full time.

heading: Abstract
content: Limited campus automation system tool (LCAST) is an automated system to fulfil the navigation in campus, communication and monitoring between the faculty, administration and students, for all these features we have planned to use beacons. this system will ease the campus notification serving as an electronic noticeboard, based on the location of student as determined by the beacons, notifications will be transmitted to student’s smartphone application. Moreover, it will automate the attendance system, every classroom will have a unique beacon which will automate the process of attendance via beacons according to date/time and course. it will provide the indoor navigation system for the campus, an indoor map will be generated for the campus, User location will be identified on the basis of his presence within the range of Beacon. Beacons are BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) sensors that behave as a lighthouse which repeatedly sends Bluetooth signals to be detected by devices such as smartphones.

heading: Introduction
content: LCAST is a system based upon the application of campus automation which covers the modules of notifications, attendance and content management. The backbone of the application is based upon the concept of IOT (Internet of Things). We have planned to use Beacons for the purpose of user identification, navigation, monitoring and notification. Beacon is a small low energy Bluetooth transmitter which repeatedly transmits single signal that other devices can see. When other devices detect this signal, some specific action is performed on them accordingly. There are two modules of our system: •  An android application which will serve as a user end platform •  A web-based beacon controlling application which will be used by teachers and administrators for handling the working and functionality of various beacons. The android application will be highly responsive and user friendly and will notify the student with some specific notification whenever the smartphone enters the zone of a beacon. The notification can be campus based generic notifications e.g. holiday, results, offers etc. and it will also serve as an information medium for teachers, officials and campus map. The other functionality of application would be the automated attendance marking whenever a student appears in the zone of a beacon in a specific class which will be programmed in such manner. The server-side web application will be used by authorized users to manage the content being communicated to users, manage the beacons and their range, zone and working. This automated system will allow efficiency and ease of access to every student on the campus, it will ease the student/teacher and administration/student communications. It will also improve the attendance system removing the effects of proxy system.

heading: Objectives
content: • To develop a user friendly and responsive android application to provide students with class and campus level notifications based on the working of beacons. • To develop a high-end web portal to handle all the administrative options such as creating notification and monitoring attendance. • To automate the attendance system without any human effort or concern. • To reduce the proxy rate and false attendance as well as any kind of mismanagement by the instructor by automating the system. • To serve as an E-noticeboard, in order to personally communicate any message by the teacher or administration • To serve as a content managing application which might be delivered by any instructor.

heading: Abstract
content: Technology is gaining control on our life to make our everyday task easy and save us time. We are living in an era where we use smartphones and smart TV’s most of the time in our daily routines either to earn our living or to surf the internet. But  the ways we use the apps mostly are time consuming. We either have to search for the required app from the apps we have downloaded or sometimes we have shortcut for it which is a very rare case in smartphones but in smart TV’s there is no such option. We have made an android application for both the smartphones and smart TV’s that help ’s user to access applications faster by recognizing user’s facial gesture. It allows a user to scroll through the app with the related motion of us er’s face. In smart TV’s i t is time saving as compared to scrolling through screens using a remote. It ease the use of applications inst alled on a smart TV. The camera identifies  the facial gestures of user’s to open applications and screen scrolling. If user tilts his face up ward or downward the screen scrolls according to his face. When the user performs  any facial gesture like win king or raising eyebrows it  opens the app associated with that gesture. Table of Contents

heading: Introduction
content: Android industry is working hard to provide best to their users. But still there is room for improvement in the products they provide. The way user’s open downloaded apps is not the easiest way to access the applications on smart phones or smart TV’s. Users have to find the downloaded application from the installed applications in his device. The more the installed applications, the harder it will be for user to find the application he wants to open which is very annoying sometimes for user. We have made an application that allows the user to control his device using facial gestures. This application is on basic leve l that  only provide s some limited functionalities to user. The functionality that user is able to perform includes open applications and screen scrolling. User is able to set applications corresponding to the gesture that he would perform and is able to do screen scrolling through i t. Our application  opens apps but without a mou se pointer. The application uses facial gestures detection with the help of camera for this purpose  [1]. Our application uses front camera to take pictur e as a background application and detect user face from the image and identify the expressions using TensorFlow, OpenCV, Dagger, and AWS SDK. Based on those expressions it launches the application associated with that expression. User can set the facial ge stures for mostly used applications of his device. User will set his facial gestures to open specific applications in his device. The application works in a way that while on home screen when us er makes the specific facial gesture corresponding to which he  had associated an application that specific installed application would open on his device. The facial gestures include winking, raising an eyebrow or opening mouth. For example, while on home screen if user opens his/her mouth  then Instagram application will open and if he/she raise s his/her eyebrows then Gallery or any other application associated with it will open. The other part of application includes screen scrolling through facial movement. User can set the speed of screen scrolling i n application settings. It works on all kinds of applications that allows vertical scrolling. Whenever an application is opened the camera detect s the facial movement. Vertical Facial movement is detected by the camera and the screen is scrolled with respect to the movement of user ’s face. If the user move s his/her face upward then the screen will be scrolled

content: • Our application detects user’s facial gestures and head movement. • Our application has many shortcut options for user to set. • User is able to set shortcuts to open apps. • User is able to open apps using facial expressions. • User is able to scroll his device screen within an app through facial movement. • User is able to select scrolling speed.

heading: Problem Statement
content: When the user has too many apps installed on his/her mobile phone, he/she is looking for a certain app. He/she gets confused by looking at so many apps. He/she can easily access that application using just a single expression. For amputee people, who don’t have hands or complete arm, would be able to use mobile phone applications. He/she would open an app lication using his expression and scroll through the application with movement of his/her head.

heading: Scope
content: Our application provides fast access to apps. Our application saves time. Our application provides screen scrolling by movement of user’s head. Our application provides shortcuts to multiple applications by detecting user’s facial gestures. Our application does not have shortcuts for all the apps. Shortcuts are for most important and most used apps. Too many shortcuts might confuse the user remembering the gestures he/she  had set. Our application won’t provide clicking function e.g. if he/she wants to click at som ething using his/her gestures.

heading: Abstract
content: An android based application that allows user to control his/her device using his/her facial gestures. User wou ld be able to perform some tasks using facial gestures like opening applications and screen scrolling. Our application creates shortcuts of other apps so that they can be opened by just a simple gesture. No need to go in menu of mobile and find the application you want to use. Our application also provides a screen scrolling option through which you can scr oll your mobile

content: At this time, there is no such application developed which uses facial landmarks and expressions to open or close  another android application with facial gestures but we have seen built -in apps for screen scrolling such as in some Samsung Phones. We will optimize the app more if necessary. In the future , we will do IOS and smart TV implementation. In smart TV’s we will add hand gestures to our application which will detect the movements of our hands and perform functions accordingly such as we can add victory sign, OK sign or rock sign etc. and the respective apps will open. We might also be able to combine hand gestures with facial expressions and create new shortcuts.

heading: Abstract
content: There has been an increasing trend of games incorporating themselves into our everyday life; playing an important role if we want to “blow off some steam” and relax. To that end, given that every other person possesses a mobile phone nowadays; hand -held devices have become the platform for people to indulge in a wide array of games in order to escape from the harsh realities of life; even if it is for just a moment. As a result, coming up with novel, unprecedented ideas in order to differentiate itself has become necessary, given the sheer amount of games already present. Our game, albeit of game modes that have been done previously, has a lore that revolves primarily around the concepts of chemistry. It’s a quest of an unknown atom in an unknown world to find its true identity over the course of the game. The protagonist is faced with several obstacles and choices throughout the game as he traverses the plot. Game progression is entirely based on the choices the player makes which; as a result incorporates “butterfly effect” concept in our game. Explanation of what is happening based on how chemistry as a science functions we will guid e user throughout the course of the game. All in all it will be an amalgamation of competition, entertainment and excitement. Initially, this game will be targeted for Android platform however we will try our best to introduce it on iOS platform as well.

heading: Introduction

Now a days usually preferred way to provide feedback to any industry or an organization is by its Facebook page or blogs but there is no platform devel oped for this specific cause. Some organizations have their private feedback systems which are for the monitoring of their performance but this platform will be for every person seeking information or the company management intending to monitor their perfo rmance. This platform will be the first in industry for this specific purpose. Bloggers can refer to this platform as a reference to his claim by embedding information like people embed tweets. content: In this project, we aim to propose a site that will receive customized orders of the bakery products of customers and they will also be able to fill their refreshment boxes. They will be able to choose the items for their order or refreshment box. They will select the product items, their flavor, product quantity and extra filling option according to their requirements. Bake my day site will enable users to purchase numerous bakery products online. A catalog of different bakery products would be displayed on the site. If the customer likes some product, he might add it to his shopping list. He will then login using some id password to process his order. The payment process shall be made through a credit card or cash on delivery. The customer will get a receipt of his shopping cart on his email address after the successful transaction.

heading: Introduction
content: In this modern era, time is very precious so we are making such system that will not only save time but also make moments memorable for the lifetime. Here we are introducing Bake my day site. Although there are online systems present and they are working by taking any product order from the customer but in our system, we are working for the placement of custom orders so that customers can order the individual bakery product item whatever they want accordi ng to their requirement. We offer a refreshment box including various items like biscuits, rolls, pastries, pizza etc. Also, their quantity, flavours, and topping can also be selected. In case of extra filling of the products in the refreshment box, extra charges will be applied. There are some previously existing systems in which customer needs to have a physically present copy of the menu, deficiency of a visible confirmation that the order is placed properly, the necessity for the bakery to have the staff answering the phone and take orders and poor services. So we are introducing bake my day site that allows the users to check for different bakery products available at the online store, place order online and receive the item timely. Customers will check  the list of customized bakery products that would be displayed in various categories. The customer will see a current menu with all available options, adjustable prices according to ingredients, flavours, fillings, and toppings. The customer will choose t he item, add quantity, add the item to his/her shopping list and confirm the order. After that he/she will log into the system, then the customer will pay through a credit card or cash on delivery. The customer will get confirmation by receiving shopping receipt on his/ her email id after his/ her successful transaction. The time limit for pre -order of refreshment boxes will be specified so that customers can order the desired products before the mentioned time limit. After that mentioned time limit, the system will not confirm orders from the customers. This system will lessen the load on bakery by the process of automated ordering. This system will help bakery staffs to rapidly check the orders as they are placed and produce the necessary items with minim um delay and confusion. Also, the reviews given by customers on the site will help other customers to easily choose the menu items.

heading: Abstract
content: Overcoming a gap between the doctor and patient in terms of communication and an ease of access has always been a challenge. With ever expanding technology, numerous innovations have been introduced in order to provide a better quality of life. Unfortunately, due to the lack of government support in Pakistan, an ordinary citizen has been deprived of having an access to any health care facility. To get a prescription from doctor, in va rious regions of Pakistan, a patient has to wait for days, weeks or even months. This project facilitates to provide basic health care facility by establishing a connection between patients and doctors in  their immediate vicinity. “Call a Doctor” is a smar t phone application that is especially designed to provide a health care facility, which mutually benefits the health care provider as well as general population. In the developed system, we have overcome  this highlighted gap. By using the developed applic ation, patients can view the profile of doctors, get doctor’s suggestion, book an appointment (i.e. based on doctor’s schedule) as well as call a doctor at their doorstep. 4 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r Table of Contents

heading: Introduction
content: Before the application of modern medicine, life was fugacious for humans. The environment was loaded with unpredictable dangers in the form of various diseases. Various methods were used to cure these diseases.  Gradually medical practice transformed into an organized profession and Doctors came to rescue human lives. A doctor is a person who dedicates his life and all his knowledge for the wellbeing and survival of mankind. Not only there  is an increased life expectancy, but also a massive improvement in the quality of life.   Doctors are of utmost importance to make accurate diagnosis and provide proper treatment, which can save a patient from harmful self-medication and make the things worse. In many situations, a doctor can define a narrow boundary between life and death. The country that we live in is vastly diverse as it consists of people ranging from all walks of life. It has to be taken into much consideration that our society range s from people with minimal wages who as a patient opt for public health centers, to the elites who prefer to go for private counseling. Therefore, despite of many health care systems, the approach to health care facilities and access to qualified doctors i s not possible for every individual in our society. In Pakistan, there is only 1 doctor per 1,000 patients according to University of Health Sciences (UHS). [1] If we talk about doctors, then due to rapid increase in private medical colleges, since 2007, Pakistan Medical industry is producing a large number of doctors each year, whereas government is not yet ready to accept this number and adjust them in public sectors, due to a lack of health care centers.  [2] General physicians are expected to specialize in some branch of medical sciences, in order to earn a name for themselves which takes several years before a doctor can earn a basic living. Another major issue in this field are  stressful, prolonged working hours. This is leading to a massive increase in rates of stress and depression amongst doctors. According to a study conducted in Karachi,  there was strong a relationship between depression and working hours. Doctors working m ore than 48 hours per week were highly suffering from this condition. Another study shows that doctors with working hours more than 46 per week were at higher risk to develop psychological disorders, which is an alarming situation.  According to a study conducted in 2015, in Lahore, the satisfaction rate of doctors with their jobs was too low. Only 13.3% were fully contented with their jobs with an outstanding satisfaction. 53.6% of the doctors had average to above average satisfaction, while only 10.3% of the lot had a below average satisfaction with their jobs. [3] Due to inadequate career prospects, research and study funding and overloaded work, many of the doctors are forced to move abroad. One study revealed that in year  2005, 1300 doctors moved abroad. Solely, Saudi Arabia hired 2,500 doctors in 2010 which might have a huge impact in the number of doctors serving in Pakistan in future. [4] 12 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r With the passage of time new diseases are found to  occur in humans and there are more chances of epidemics. According to Journal of  The Royal Society , in 2014 it was found that the epidemics have become much more common in recent decades. [5] Because of many factors in the modern era, there is an increased risk of disease spreading amongst people of all age groups, thus need of health care provision is rising with time. As for the other domains  of life, rapid advancement in Information technologies are breaking all barriers in the field of medicine as well.  Clinicians and patients have all the access to health - related information. This is one of the most common uses of the internet. The access t o evolving information about health helps in decision making by the patients and makes communication with the doctor much easier. But there are still certain barriers like lack of time for the doctors and inadequate knowledge of internet usage  in application of complicated systems and software in our country. Keeping in view all these issues, our project is taking an initiative to solve these problems as much as possible. This project aims at providing a  much better opportunity to doctor and patient by providing them a platform of direct interaction through android app lication on their handsets. In the developed system,  patients and t he doctors will create profiles . In time of need,  patients will login  and cho ose their health related issues . After  entering the problem, our system will suggest a doctor accordingly. Professional doctor s of all age groups and expertise  will be available. The Project will be provid ing a patient who will login  to see all the details updated by doctor on his profile, can see his qualification, work timings, response time, ratings. On the other hand doctor can also view patients profile and previous ratings by any other doctor and decide if he is feasible enough for him to see. Patient can fix an appointment with the docto r and also can call him at his home for checkups, primary care, diagnosis etc. Patient can view the current location of the doctor while he is on his way and doctor can view the location of his destination where he is expected to see his patient. Checkup d etails are recorded in application and checkup fee is also calculated. Patient and doctor can rate each other to build a trust/profile for other who visits next time. Ch eckup history and total earning  of doctor is maintained within this application. This will provide a great platform to the doctors who are struggling in the profession by providing them a me ans of earning from their homes . It saves their time and investments for setup as the system is very convenient with 24/7 availability with no w aiting r ooms, closed offices. Also for th e patients, it saves time, expensive doctor and transportation charges, frustration of long appointments and much more. The user can connect using his favorite devi ce to a user friendly interface. This provides peace of min d with 100 percent acceptance covering the whole family. So mainly, we aim at providing total care of body, mind and wallet. heading: Objectives
content: Main objective of this system is to facilitate patients by providing them opportunity to book clinic appointment or doctor’s visit to patient’s doorstep. Objectives of our system are mentioned below: • To provide nearest clinic s earch feature through which a patient can search nearest clinics. • To provide facility for a patient to view nearest clinic details and book a clinic appointment. • To provide a manual searching feature in which a patient can search doctor by selecting the distance in miles or by selecting the specific gender. • To provide appointment feature in which a patient can view doctor details and can assign a doctor for home visit. • To provide a real -time location tracking feature through which a patient can track the location of a doctor by viewing the distance in miles and duration. • To facilitate doctors by providing them opportunity to receive requests from nearest patients. • To provide opportunity through which doctors can develop their profiles by getting high ratings • To allow both users to rate each other with additional feature of review. • To provide checkup history feature through which a checkup history of a patient will be maintained. • To allow doctor to view his daily, weekly and monthly earning. • To provide user-friendly interface.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Health issues are very common now a days especially in under developed countries like Pakistan where smoke of industries, factories and vehicles cause environmental pollution and dust. Food in the restaurants and hotels are not of good quality because there is no check and balance. There are hardly 2 or 3 government hospitals in each major city of Pakistan and their condition is awful. The ideal Doctor to Patient Ratio is 1:50, therefore in Pakistan it is a herculean task to get an early doctor’s appointment with the ratio of 1:1000. [1] Due to less number of government hospitals, many of the MBBS and FCPS doctors who cannot afford their personal clinics are unemployed because of less  number of vacancies available. Doctors strikes over pay and poor working conditions are very common in Pakistan. Many doctors want to go abroad due to few job opportunities and lack of healthcare facilities. Patients do not want to wait for so long in the  unhealthy hospital environment for their turn. 14 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r So there is a need of a system that can deal with these issues and problems. Our system will resolve these issues by providing the opportunity to unemployed skillful doctors. Doctors can receive requests from the nearest patients and check patients by going to their home with the complete health box. Doctors will be paid according to their checkup fee. In addition to this, our system will also bring ease on patient’s lives by facilitating them in a way that d octors can check them at their doorstep. Using this application a patient has a comfort by calling a doctor at home instead of going to hospital, facing traffic, environmental and noise pollution in middle and then after reaching the hospital, waiting for his turn in an unhealthy environment of hospital. Moreover, patient can also book clinic appointment if needed.

heading: Abstract
content: ‘The Social Hub’ is a social media application that allows the user to use other social media applications on one platform and all these social applications can   be used and  manipulated from that platform. Users can connect social apps by signing -in from their account of respective social apps. Main interface of The Social Hub provide a swipe -able tab like structure for the ease of switching between different social applications that the user has connected with The Social Hub. The Social Hub  also enables  the user to search other people  that have Social Hub accounts. There are two main methods of searching in T he Social Hub. One is Location -based search and the other is Type-based search. There are different types of filters to apply on search as well, that dynamically filter the search result on the basis of user preference. The Social Hub  also maintains  its own chat feature independent of other social media applications. This chat is maintained by backend Social Hub Server.  User can talk to people that he/she has searched. There is also an inbox module that allows the user to keep track of their messages. The Social Hub also provides a highly dynamic and smooth interface that is simple and easy to use. Table of Contents

heading: Introduction
content: The Social Hub is a social media application for Android devices that will allow the user to use multiple social applications on a single light weight platform. It is basically creating a hub for other social applications [1 ], or, in other words, to use al l other social applications from a single application that provide a smooth and easy to use  multi-tasking feature [2]. Furthermore, it also features ‘location-based search’ provided with different filters that users can select from. There is also a facility for type-based search. In-order to fully understand The Social Hub, it’s aspects are divided into three parts as following.

heading: Objectives
content: The objectives of Social Hub are following. • A platform which allows the control and use of social applications without l aunching each app independe ntly and without harming any privacy policy of other social application. • Saving the precious time of people and reducing the amount of eff ort put to access social apps. • Less consumption of smartphone processing power and use of social application efficiently. • Providing an interface that as smooth as possible and easily understandable. • More battery life for smartphones. • Meeting new people and socializing. • Finding long lost friends. • Making new connection with people. • Being aware of friends or people who are or were nearby you.

heading: Problem Statement
content: These days, almost every individual has a smart phone. We can find people of any age clinging to their mobile phones throughou t the day and spending more and more time on social media. People nowadays are spending hours on different social media applications and all they do is switch between different social apps so that they can stay updated with what is going on in their social life and to stay in touch with their friends or to make new ones. Social apps are the widely used mobile apps in the world and each day new apps are created. It is becoming difficult for the user to manage all social apps individually because using too much apps all day with each app l aunching independently not onl y consumes a lot of battery life  but also wastes a lot of precious time of the user in the process of switching between these apps [3]. The other problem we are dealing with is the process of searching. Right now there is only  one way to search people using social apps, which is by typing their name in the search bar. No other viable method is convenient enough for us to use besides typing their name and if we don’t know the name of people we are searching, it’s nearly impossib le to reach them on social media if they are not already in our ‘friends list’ [4].

heading: Scope
content: There are many social apps available and their number will only increase in the future. So, the motivation behind this application is to help and facilitate people by providing them a platform through which they can control and use all their social applications  [1]. It not only saves the precious time of people but also reduces the amount interac tion with the smartphone’s OS [3 ]. Furthermore, it also helps people to search social accounts of distant friends who are nearby your location, or people whom they might know but don’t remember their names. Hence this app is developed for purpose of searching nearby people’s social accounts without entering their names.

heading: Conclusion
content: Until now, for the completion of this document, decisions  had to be made whether to pursue an original idea that is new and had the potential to bring a change in the social app genre, or to adapt to the regular projects that most of the students opt for, to clear their studies without any challenge. The former was the decision that we came up with after careful discussions. Complex researches and requirement analysis iterations were main challenge to bring this project into inception. At the moment of disc ussing the scope of this application, we decided to properly launch it in the market after completing it as a final year project.  As being a relatively new application in the market, the Social Hub also has the potential risk of being copied or stolen and  being re-released on larger scale. This  is a kind of risk that every entrepreneur has to take, while entering the marker. The original idea of The Social Hub  is on a much l arger scale with various ground -breaking and innovative features but we had to limi t them to only two major features due the time limit and lack of resources. The full potential of this application is currently out of our reach to be developed, thus we are only able include only those features that are necessary for the scope of a final year project. One of the major problem s that we faced was to decide which tools were to be used to develop this application. As there are many tools available for android applications but it’s a tricky thing to decide which tool will be best for the Social Hub. Hence, after consulting with a professional software engineer we came up with a solution to develop The Social Hub on React Native, a framework for Java Script. These were  some of  the problems that we came across , while making the documentation of t his projec t that resulted in continuous change in designs and diagrams of The Social Hub.  The main issue was the continuous API policy change of different social media applications. There were no clear indications that to what extent third party app access  was granted to developers. Furthermore many applications changed their policies within the development life cycle of this project hence creating issues for the project at many occasions.

content: Developing a proper application and to release it in the market is not an easy task to perform. Complete knowledge of requirement gathering, designing and testing is required to be able develop an Application that people can use in a daily life. Putting all your knowledge into creation and proper utilization of the available resources are the main thing that we have learned while doing computer science and that is  exactly what we are trying to do to develop The Social Hub. heading: Introduction
content: Natural Language Processing (NLP) toolkits are widely available, to analyse text of different natural languages such as English, Arabic and Chinese etc. For instance, Apache Open NLP [5] , Stanford Core NLP [1] , Machine Learning for Language Toolkit (MALLET) [2], General Architecture for Text Engineering (GATE) [3] , Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) [4] etc. These toolkits have been used in a range of NLP and Human Language Technology (HLT) applications as well as domains. For instance, Computer Sciences [8], Bio-informatics [6] [7], Corpus linguistics [9] etc. Text processing pipeli nes are built on three basic linguistic tools: (I) spell checker, (II) text identifier, and (III) Part -Of-Speech (POS) tagger. Spell Check is a syntax  checker that finds public spelling errors and structural mistakes in language text. This tool has been widely applied in spelling boost, text classification, and corpus linguistics domains. Text Classification is a NLP relevant task whose aim is to choose the correct class label for a given data. Some examples where classification tasks may be applied are, detect whether an email is spam or not, detect the topic of an article, word sense disambiguation, etc. Whereas, Part -Of-Speech (POS) tagger is a linguistics software that reads text in language and allocates its grammatical class to every word. POS tagger is worth for semantic field disambiguation, word sense disambiguation, text classification etc. Currently, the above-mentioned text pre-processing tools (spell checker, text classifier, and POS tagger) are primarily available for English and European langua ge, and there is a lack of such linguistics NLP tools for South Asian languages, particularly Urdu a topic of interest, which is widely spoken and used around the world. The Urdu language is an Indo -Aryan language. It is derived from Persian, Arabic, and Turkish scripts [10.]. Urdu script is written from right to left and follows the Nastalik calligraphy style. It is a free -word order language and sometime follows the Subject -Object-Verb structure [12]. Therefore, the developed tools for English and other sibling languages is not a promising basis of Urdu NLP [11]. Urdu NLP is important for several reasons. Therefore, this Final Year Project (FYP) will present the design, development and evaluation of an Extended Urdu Natural Language toolkit (hereafter called ExUNLT). Our novel research contribution in this project will be focus on Urdu text pre- processing as follows: (I) ExUNLT initially, contains three Urdu text pre-processing tools including a spell checker, text classifiers and a POS tagger. (II) In add ition, we will create supporting resources to develop and evaluate the ExUNLT text pre-processing tools, (III) proposed algorithms for all these three tools, and (IV) toolkit, supporting resources will be freely available. The need for the Urdu NLP toolkit (ExUNLT) is clear from above discussion, and for us, it presents the first step in a larger project. First, we intended to use ExUNLT to design and development of sentiment analysis system in Urdu. Second, it will serve as a benchmark and baseline to Urdu, Spell Checker, Text Classifiers, and POS tagging tasks. Thirdly, for intelligent processing of text in Urdu and to develop large-scale Urdu resources. Fourth, it has an extensible pipeline that provides core linguistics annotation for Urdu language text quickly and painlessly. Finally, to stimulate the NLP beyond our project there is a desperate need to develop a toolkit.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Currently, the text preprocessing tools (spell checker, text identifier, and POS tagger) are primarily available for English and European language, and there is a lack of such linguistics NLP tools for South Asian languages, particularly Urdu a topic of interest, which is widely used and spoken around the world. Urdu NLP is important for several rea sons. The need for the Urdu NLP toolkit (ExUNLT) is clear for us it presents the first step in a larger project. First, we intended to use ExUNLT to design and development of sentiment analysis system in Urdu. Second, it will serve as a benchmark and baseline to Urdu, Spell Checker, Text identifier, and POS tagging tasks. Third, it can be used for intelligent processing of text in Urdu and to develop large-scale resources in Urdu. Fourth, it is an extensible pipeline, which provides core linguistics annotat ion for Urdu language text quickly and painlessly. Moreover, we will do our literature review for our own learning. As our project is in python language so we will learn python language, and then learn the techniques of spell checker, Text Classifiers and parts of speech tagger. heading: Introduction
content: A spell checker determines the correctness of spelling in a given string based on the language set being used. Spell-checking is a major technology of sizable monolingual corpora. Some spell - checking application demands to find an error in a word and also to correct that erroneous word. In a spell checker application a d ictionary is required. The dictionary can be used as a database to store only valid words. As we know that a dictionary does not include proper nouns and mostly person names. So, we can say that it is essential to add a morphological analyser and a table o f proper nouns in our database. Else, we will not get the desired output. The key to this issue is to have a sizable monolingual. This process is categorized into three stages: Firstly, It detects erroneous or mistaken words. In this stage, lexical analyzer finds an error in the given string. In the second stage it suggest us words against the identified mistaken word.  In this stage, it generates likely candidates to replace the mistaken word. The third stage is automatic correction of errors. In this this stage, each candidate is assigned an error weight. Based on these weights the candidates are arranged from the most possible replacements to the least possible replacements.

heading: Introduction
content: The Part Of Speech (POS) Tagger is a tool in which an input text is entered in it allocates different parts of speech to every word in the given input. POS tagging is a major requirement for systems like Summarization. It is also a requirement in many advanced level natural language jobs. The major benefit is that we can get annotated corpora. Furtherly, these dataset can be useful for language study. To produce improved taggers, for several other language-processing tasks. There are many systems created for POS tagging.  Some knowledge-based taggers are implemented by using statistical approaches. There are also many developed  programs that merge several implementations with a voting process. This effort shows a learning to find a  suitable method to train a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) POS tagger. When dealing with languages with a small number of training dataset. We match many smoothing approaches and many orders of this model. After training the tagger we perform different tests to choose the best configuration. We then repeat these steps for the training corpus in Urdu language to cement our results. For every Hidden Markov model, we configure out tests in a different way. We use three types of Hidden Markov model, and two smoothing techniques. We use all of this to determine the parameters of our model.

heading: Introduction
content: Text classiﬁcation is a system which categorizes the documents into predeﬁned set of topic classes. In text classiﬁcation we are  only considering the multiclass classiﬁcation whereas in the binary classiﬁcation there are more than two possible classes. The goal is to assign a related topic to a document after reading it. The algorithm used in text classification is a part of a complex s ystem and is used for keeping large volumes of text data. Since it has been shown that not only the size of the training data is important, but also the right scope of the language models in training texts is needed. The  topic identiﬁcation algorithm is us ed for large scale language modelling  and data ﬁltering. The  discriminative techniques like support vector machines (SVMs), decision trees, gradient boosting and neural networks  are some of the main approaches to text classification. It describes a method based on general topic model normalization for ﬁnding a threshold which defines a boundary between the “correct” and the “incorrect” topi cs of a newspaper article in generative classiﬁcation techniques. The generative classiﬁer outputs a distribution of probabilities and a method for processing this d istribution into the sets of “correct” and  “incorrect” topics is needed. The proposed method is used to get the better results of decision trees and gradient boosting in the topic identiﬁcation module.

heading: Abstract
content: In this research, we have developed three novel computational linguistics analysis tools for Urdu language spell checker, hybrid POS tagger and text classifier. We have designed and developed these three tools completely. We have shown each and every phase  of the development process. These three tools were designed using rule-based, dictionary lookup, stochastic methods and hybrid methods. We have also developed benchmark corpus for these tools  and described the corpus generation process. As corpus generation was one of the main phase. We have also explained the methodology of these tools individually. The methodology include system diagram, user - interaction diagram, flowchart and the interface for our application. Then we have explained the techniques, appr oaches or models we are using. Finally, we have concluded our results. For improving our results, we have defined some rules. Our finalized results were very convincing. We have also concluded evaluation measures for our three text processing tools.

heading: Conclusion
content: In this paper, we have described a novel computational linguistics analysis tools of the Urdu language spell checker, hybrid POS tagger and text classifier. We have designed, develop ed, evaluated and tested tools. Text processing tools formulated around rule-based, dictionary lookup, and stochastic methods. Our results have shown state-of-the-art performance and thus can be used as a baseline for future improvements. In addition to developing the software tools, our second set of contributions are the design, collection, manual annotation and release of Urdu corpora to enable comparative evaluations to be performed in the future.

heading: Future Work
content: We would like to improve the performance of tools by employing state-of-the-art machine learning techniques. Increase the size of datasets. Develop other Urdu NLP tools. Create an automatic tool for the semantic analysis of Urdu text building on these important foundations.

heading: Abstract
content: As High spatial resolution (HSR) imagery becomes more and more easily available, the efforts to extract information out of these images more efficiently and autonomously becomes more important. In our project we aim to find an easier and more efficient method that focuses on extracting information from HSR images. In particular, we would like to p ropose a method that would get rid of the mathematically intensive numerical computations and come up with a more simpler method to identify regions of interest in urban areas. After coming up with a good approach to do so we hope to apply this knowledge to identify buildings and roads and separate them from other terrains. This will be done in order to provide a system that autonomously finds the best evacuation route in the case of an earthquake.

heading: Introduction
content: HSR images are very high-resolution aerial images of the earth taken from satellites. The branch of image processing that deals with the capturing, working and analysis of HSR images is known as remote sensing. In literal meaning Remote sensing is the process of gathering inf ormation about an object remotely i.e. without ever making physical contact with it. In Digital image processing remote sensing means to observe and analyse information of the earth via pictures taken using a satellite. Remote sensing is very useful mainly due to the fact that it helps us analyse the earth with a whole new perspective and from a point of view that is not attainable by regular photography. HSR images are used for a wide number of purposes in almost all fields of everyday life [1, 2]. One of the fields where aerial imaging is used is journalism. With the news media being one of the biggest industries in the world, they want to get better and innovative at how they are reporting their news. Aerial reporting is one thing that they are focusing on for this purpose. Also, in case of a dangerous situation where on field presence might put the journalist’s life in jeopardy, aerial photography can be of great help as coverage can be provided from the air. Another use for such imagery is in the field of precision agriculture  [3]. Precision agriculture means to better the production rate of crops using computerized methods. This methodology of farming utilizes satellite images to observe and analyse crops for better production, disease detection etc. Surveillance is also a field that has been eager to utilize aerial photography, but surveillance on low - resolution images wasn’t very reliable. HSR imagery can help get over this hurdle and make aerial imagery feasible for surveillance. Another use for HSR images is Cartography i.e. taking aerial images and using them to create digital maps. As digital maps are getting more and more accessible, efforts are being made to utilize them for more useful purposes. This includes gathering information about the landscapes of urban areas as well as construction planning on a small scale. Another use of such maps is the semantic labelling of images. This labelling can be used for a number of purposes s uch as disaster evaluation, deriving shore etc. Our FYP focuses on making this labelling more automated, easier and efficient. This project will be worked on the SpaceNet dataset [4] provided by AWS. It consists of 8 band tagg ed spatial imagery along with ground truths in geojson format.

heading: Abstract
content: CIIT-LAMS is a combination of e -leave and e -attendance management systems specifically designed for CIIT Lahore campus. Every organization has different kinds of leaves and each with a different leave policy so does CIIT Lahore, in order to handle the automatic processing of leaves applications we have provided an online workflow based system in which processes are designed using Business Process Modelling Notation (BPMN). CIIT-LAMS aims to provide HR department an easy, fast, and efficient way of carrying out activities related to employee attendance and leave management by completely eliminating paper work, as all the  applications and documents are created and processed online, m oreover digital signatures are used. Users are  provided with personal dashboards where they can apply for , and view status of their ap plications, similarly dashboards are provided to management, and higher authorities are also provided with management portals where they can manage and be aware of employee activities. Hence making it a lot easier for the HR department to process and manag e applications anywhere, at any time. An android application with basic e-leave features and touch id and  facial recognition featur e to record attendance is created to provide ease to employees. heading: Introduction
content: Leave Management is mostly done manually in organizations in Pakistan, but to regulate employees and to maintain balance in the organization, leaves and attendance need to be managed efficiently, which is not possible in the manual system, as it involves lot of paper work and policies and becomes hectic at some point. The proposed system i.e. CIIT -LAMS aims to overcome all the issues in the previous system, providing a better, faster, and more efficient system. CIIT-LAMS integrates the leave management system with the attendance system, saving all the time wasted retrieving data regarding an employee’s application. It provides the employees with personal dashboards where they can view their data as well as submit applications online within a few button clicks at anytime from anywhere, moreover the new system is a work flow based system, hence the employees can view/track the status of their applications on their dashboards. It provides the HR manager with a personal dashboard as well, where he/she can view the applications as well as approve/disapprove them instantaneously as all the information required for the decision making is readily available and is accessed instantaneously, furthermore as it’s an online system, the manager can access applications even when travelling for work purposes. The paper work is completely eliminated and digital signatures of employees and manager are used for authentication. Employees shall be notified instantaneously about the approval/disapproval of application through e -mail or a notification on the system. An android application with touch id or facial recognition feature that uses location and Wi -Fi or cellular network to record employee attendance will also be created. The Android applications main purpose is to allow the employees to mark attendance using their android phones, the logic behind this feature is such that, we will bound the campus area using geo- coordinates, and the employees shall be able to mark attendance when located in this geo-bounded area and their identity is verified using touch id, or facial recognition feature. Hence conforming both the presence and identity of employee, eliminating chances of proxies. It is a work flow based system hence the leave management task is completely automated and handled efficiently as now employee just has to submit the application and authorities have to take decision on it, and the processing between and after that is handled by the system itself based on the business process models of the organization, and leave balance and attendance is monitored and automatically updated based on different scenarios as well as applications can be tracked, moreover it has its own advantages like the workload on the HR manager can be determined and employees can’t make any false claims regarding applications. CIIT-LAMS provides an efficient solution to manage, monitor and evaluate resulting in an effective leave and attendance management system.

heading: Problem Statement
content: The HR department currently uses two ways to manage, employees leave applications manual for lower grade employees and an online system for higher grade employees which is not completely automated and a lot of work still needs to be done in excel files, and a separate autom ated attendance system with biometric verification is used to manage employee attendance. The leave management system has a lot of issues, as it is not integrated with the attendance and payroll system, so each time an application arrives, approval can’t be made instantly as it becomes a time consuming process to retrieve employee attendance and leave history in order to approve/disapprove the application and then deduct the pay if required by updating or altering the payroll system, as well as attendance and leave management system need to be updated separately. Employees need to write and submit leave applications to head of their department during fixed hours as there is no flexibility, moreover employees are unaware of the status of the application after submission. Employees are also unaware of their leave balance and sometimes might end up doing more leaves than availed. HR manager needs to be able to access the applications and data in order to approve them, which is not possible if he/she is travelling for work purposes. It gets difficult to keep track of employee leave balance as data is maintained in excel sheets and employee status needs to be monitored. A lot of paper is wasted and HR department employees are stuck in this mess when they could be doing other tasks. Overall system efficiency is poor, slo w processing of applications, difficult to keep track of things, resulting in an increased workload on the HR department and an ineffective system.

heading: Literature Review
content: HR technology is used to attract, hire, retain, and maintain human resources, support HR administration, and optimize human resource management (HRM). Various stakeholders like employees and managers can use this technology, furthermore it can be accessed in different ways and be used in multiple kinds of human resource information system (HRIS). Communication with employees is now much easier and faster with the advancement in technology, so is the deliverance, gathering and collation of information. Its major potential  is to reduce the burden on the HR department, in order to help it focus on more important and significant activities like having expert discussions with managers. Research has indicated that organizations that use technology to manage their HR operations will have numerous advantages over those that don’t. [1] The introduction of workflow management tools is an opportunity to improve both the underlying business process and the existing organizational structure.  Implementing workflow management system can result in many benefits for the organization, like making the necessary organizational changes, and less intervention required to manage business process. Notifications and document sharing provide better communications better understanding of the process resulting in increased collaboration among teams. Workflow management systems tend to unify people with diverse skills into a more cohesive unit. [2] Workflow systems force organizations to reengineer their business processes by analysing and defining their business processes, considering the flaws in them. To avoid inefficient workflows, it is important to analyse an underlying process before implementation. James Kobielus suggests that an organization optimize a process with any of three goals in mind: “m inimizing process time, maximizing value-added process content, or maximizing flexibility at the initial point of customer contact. [3] Hackett Group is a firm that advises related to business process, in a recent study they found that low-performing organizations spend 75% greater  than their peers on HR because they  don’t use technology effectively. The system will not be an open world platform while designing our desired application; we shall utilize the operative camera and image processing knowledge that could be effective in face detection and recognition. We shall also include such knowledge of MS Visual Studio, SQL server, OpenCV Libraries  and EmguCV Libraries with the programmin g language knowledge of C Sharp . We have executed an effective framework to perceive faces from pictures with some close on -going varieties. Our approach basically was to actualize and confirm the calculatio n Local Binary Pattern Histogram  (LBPH) for Recog nition, which takes care of the acknowledgment is sue for 2 -D picture of faces. Local Binary Patterns Page 10 of 117  19 December 2018 (LBP) is a procedure  whose objective is to proficiently summarize the local structures of images. The most central  property of LBPH is its tolerance about monotonic illumination changes and its computational easiness. LBPH has been used  for facial illustration in different tasks holding face detection, face recognition, facial expression analysis.

Its raw material is acrylic tow and after applying several processes on it, they manufacture yarn. The company manages its records on note books, in which they face many difficulties because their entries are very enormous in number. That’s why we will computerize their records of stock products and daily production reports, maintain their clients’ accounts, and track their sales of raw materials an d manufactured products. heading: Objectives
content: In our project, we will focus on computerizing the stock department, accounts report generation and tracking of product delivery till its sale. We will integrate the systems (soft-wares) of these departments so that manager can see the stock information, order details, account reports and customer statements. The software will be web based so its users will be able to access it online at any place where internet is available. Moreover, admin will have access to create user and grant permissions to them to use the software features except reports, because only admin will have access to see reports.

heading: Problem Statement
content: Kashif Spinning Mills has four departments which need to be computerized. First department handles the orders from customers. These orders are written on an order book. Their customers place orders on telephones, which can cause misunderstanding and someti mes results in a huge problem for both customer and manufacturer. Second department deals with the stock. They maintain stock records on stock book s. The company keeps the demand of its customers on priority. They manufacture the fresh yarn on order. They seldom keep manufactured yarn in stock, and to achieve this task they must keep the report of raw material stock updated, so that they would be aware of the available colour and quantity to issue it on time for manufacturing. Third department maintains the cash transactions made on daily basis. Fourth department maintains the records of delivering products to the customers against their orders. All the above departments maintain their records in handwritten form. They all face problem while matching previous records to prepare any report or while searching the records of previous dates. Another major issue is of security which we must cover on. The software will be web based, so we need to apply authentication o n admin and users. Admin will create user and restrict him/her to use specific portion of the software.

heading: Scope
content: Our software will facilitate the factory  management, owner and accountants. The software will maintain the record of all purchases, orders, accounts and clients’ information. The customers will be facilitated by evincing their reports on a well formatted design with all details of their purchases and payments between any dates. Manager can get the report of stock at any time which will help him to take his managing decisions faster than before. Currently, the management of Kashif Spinning Mills follows the manual procedure of filling books to maintain their stock records, orders details, daily production records and gate passes. It is very difficult to maintain this procedure on higher level when a lot of entries are recorded per day. We are doing this project to unravel their problems of dealing with immense number of entries. The Owner/Manager will have authority to see the reports anytime at any place on web. The application will show all transactions, pending orders, make a new order and deliver them within specific period. Factory have four people on specific posts which will use this software.

heading: Introduction
content: Recent trends in the development of social cognitive robots have led us to the realization of treating machines as co -workers (Moore n.d.) .These robots are the agents that are intelligent, socially interactive, communicate thro ugh dialog -based system, and learn models to recognize other agents, display particular identity and character; and may learn or create social abilities. Agents programmed with aforementioned features are referred as cognitive agents, for detail see (S. P. Franklin, A “Consciousness” -Based Architecture 2005),(Franklin and Ferkin 2006), (Gamez, The Development and Analysis of Conscious Machines 2008)  and (Qazi 2012) . The corresponding relationship between cognitive science and robotics defines the characteristics of cognitive robotics research, which focuses on giving robots with advanced cognitive abilities in order to observe, reason, and behave separately in a similar intelligent manner to humans. Social intelligence in robots has turned out to be progressively obvious that social and intelligent skills are vital prerequisites in many cognitive modelled AI -based application regions and context s where robots need to connect and work together with other agents (robots or humans) (Dautenhahn 2007 Feb 13) Such kinds of socio -cognitive robots and agents were discussed in BICA challenge (Samsonovich, On a roadmap for the BICA Challenge 2012), and the aforementioned idea of these kinds of co-worker robots can be rationalized on the premises of BICA challenge. The primary objective of BICA (DARPA Ends Brain Reverse Engineering Project, ref: (Samsonovich, Johannsdottir and Chella, Proceedings of the F. Amsterdam: IOS Press BV 2010)) and our development is to build a general-purpose artificially intelligent agent, that has (to some extent) computational skills equivalent to human brain, which will extend human society, and not replace us. According to BICA challenge and roadmap (Samsonovich, On a roadmap for the BICA Challenge 2012) , to achieve these goals the agent (robot) should fulfil following conditions. • Accept as partner • Believable behaviour • Co-presence • Domain expert • Episodic memory • Social and communicational capabilities

heading: Literature Review
content: This study aims to propose a social cognitive robot for a retail store to serve as an assistant. The design of this agent required the utilization of concepts, tools and techniques from various domains. Therefore, literature review is interdisciplinary. The main objective of the research in robotics and cognitive artificial intelligence is to make computat ionally equivalent human -like mind. Broadly speaking, cognitive computing is defined as the simulation of human manners of thinking in an automated model. The corresponding relationship between cognitive science and robotics defines the characteristics of cognitive robotics research, which focuses on giving robots with advanced cognitive abilities in order to observe, reason, and behave separately in a similar intelligent manner to humans A cognitive agent that chooses actions to be performed based on complex processing which simulates various mental functionalities at a certain level in order to general insight, cognition and reactions under regulation of cognitive cycle(s) (Franklin and Ferkin 2006). Cognitive architectures (Anderson 1983/2013) are used in the construction of cognitive artificial systems which can perform cognitive activities like knowledge organization, attention, learning, reasoning etc. The problem in cognitively inspired artificial systems is concept representation for this we have theoretical and computational cognitive sciences (Lieto 2014). As cognitive tasks involve different brain activities and neural impulses so it is important to describe the conceptual information representation. Moreover, for the concept representations the proxy type theory of concepts (Prinz 2004) can be combine with heterogeneity approach (Machery 2010) (Lieto 2014).

heading: Introduction
content: This system is a parking, vehicle security, student tracking -assist application which will work on the basis of RFID. RFID stands for radio frequency identification. It allows wireless data transmission. There are two vital components in the implementation which includes RFID tags and RFID readers. These RFID tags work on the basis of unique id’s which are given to them. No two RFID tags have the same id. When the RFID tag and the reader are matched with the help of electromagnetic fields, they are identified and can be tracked. RFID will enhance the working of parking automation system. This whole system works in a way that the code is embedded in the RFID tags and as stated earlier, unique id is given to each RFID tag. Then the same id is assigned to the vehicle. So, only if the RFID tag and the vehicle’s id match with each other upon leaving the premises of the university, they will be allowed to depart. The data from this transaction will be updated in the database. The records and ids of the students will be saved there. Similarly, in case of student trackin g i t can avoid proxy attendance and refine and further automate the system of student’s attendance. If a student’s RFID is matched with the scanner, the teacher will know he or she is in the university. Our app has two modules i.e.; web portal (front end) for the interaction of user, and a desktop app. Our final product will include a desktop application for users of the campus, a Web portal and Rfid Reader/Writer software for Administration or Securit y Personnel. The administration will use the software to read/write the Rfid cards and view the data mapping on the web portal. The portal will also be used to add new students, cars etc. The web portal will represent the parking status, time table, alerts etc. Moreover, our system shall be aligned with LCAST android app which uses a beacon- based technology to for student navigation and attendance. heading: Objectives
content: • Our goal is to provide effective and efficient tools for the management of parking within University premises. • To provide automated solutions for better management and security system for the vehicles within the University. • To provide verification solutions for student attendance issues. • Keeping the track of no. of students entering the campuses and leavi ng the campus. • To prevent stealing of any vehicles from campus. • To check if a student or a teacher is present in the university or not based on the rfid status of entering and leaving the university.

heading: Problem Statement
content: As we see at present that there is a manual system for the overseeing of the vehicles at the campus. A number of security guards have to be always there to keep a watch of the vehicles and also a manual token system is used.  Moreover, the manual system of security is prone to fail, cause s tealing of vehicles and compromise security of the campus. Our application will automate all of these factors and there will be no need for any security guards or tokens. So keeping this in mind, our motive is to build a system that should be intelligent, efficient, easy to use and swift enough to maintain and manage the security of the vehicles and the students entering the campus.

heading: Scope
content: The core basis of our project is on the technology of RFID. The scope of RFIDs is really vast and is set to expand with time. RFIDs are expected to take over the barcode technology soon because the amount of information that can be stored on barcod es is really less as compared to the RFIDs. RFIDs can store as far as 1000 bytes of data and are specified to each item whereas barcodes are not. Other than that RFID is entering the fields of pharmaceuticals, healthcare, retail, banking and defence etc. RFID was not considered to be feasible because of the high cost factor involved for its implementation but now the companies are moving towards building of low cost RFIDs. Slowly the picture of RFID is the coming to view of all companies wanting to implemen t it. Looking at the different benefits it will provide for the businesses, the cost reduction, this will lead them to huge profit margins which is a necessity in today’s competitive and fast market world.

heading: Literature Review
content: Our motive is to build a system that should be intelligent, efficient, easy to use and swift enough to maintain and manage the security of the vehicles and the students entering the campus. These apps are specified below: [1] DPM-Dynamic Parking Management permits to control and manage the parking of vehicles in real-time. This app is a lot like ours and provided meaningful inputs for future work. [2] Smart Parking Beta is a wireless parking system based on Zigbee technology for smart parking. Although this is a real time parking app but is inefficient, lacklustre in performance. This app is difficult for use for novice users and even perpetual intermediates. [3] Get My Parking is an IOT platform parking app. The problem with this app is that it is only limited to Delhi. Moreover, complains were found about the layout, promotional techniques etc. and as a result gaining minimum user satisfaction. [4] Park Indigo is a globally used parking app which can be used across 4000 locations in 7 countries. It is a different from us because of its scale but studying it provided useful information about our app. Although, this app lacks user friendliness and had bad reviews due to basic performance bugs. Our app will be based on the technology of Rfid, which at initial stages, will be designed for inter university parking and security thus focusing on maximum user friendliness and smooth performance.
