heading: Abstract
content: Many people want different services for their business purposes but the application they want cost a lot and not all of them can afford it or the application they have does not serve efficiently. We will provide a software as service (SAAS) web a pp that is based multi - tenant architecture. Multi tenancy refers to software architecture in which the software serves multiple tenants. Tenant means users who use the services. We propose a web application based on multi-tenant architecture which will provide several services. It’s on the user that for how long he will use our services so that when he don’t need the services the user can stop using it will also save the cost of the user .

heading: Introduction
content: We will develop a software as service (SAAS) web application based on multi -tenant architecture. In multi-tenancy the application is installed on a single server and the user can use that services. The users will have the same view. The customization of the services will be changed as per their needs. The data of the user is also stored in the database of the web application. Each user can only see his data and not the data of other users. The web application will provide services that will help the user to do their daily tasks and to earn profit from their business. Our main focus is on the multi tenancy of the website as the multi -tenant architecture has many benefits. The followings are the benefits of multi-tenancy. • Cost: due to multi -tenancy a lot of cost can be saved as  there is only one instance of software running on one server and having a single database saves a lot of money. The software also uses less resources as only one instance of software is used by all the customers. • Data aggregation\data mining: data is stor ed in a single database instead of multiple databases with different schemas saves a lot cost as query cost and datamining and finding patterns is much simpler. • Easy updates: in multi tenancy as the software is stored in a single server any upgradation in a software will be easy as all the customers can access the upgraded services. • Easy customization: in multi tenancy each customer can customize the service as per the customer's need without effecting the other's customer customization. The web application will provide services that user can use for free. web application will have a gui interface which will be user friendly so that the user can easily customize the services as per the needs of the users. The services will be generic and flexible so that th e customization can be made of any type. The user don’t need any technical knowledge for the customization, only he will customize according to his needs. The database schema will be generated according to the customizations of the users. The web application will provide facilities just like others software so that it’s for every user and not restricted for the technical users only.

heading: Abstract
content: The offered project, which will be called Report Formatter, presents an AI- and machine learning-based program that will be used to automate the process of report formatting based on the templates specified by the user or institutions. The system will include: Admin Panel: It allows administrators to post and control format regulations like font styles, margins, table formats and heading structures. A custom template can be done by each university. AI-Powered Content Classification: Detecting attributes (heading, subheading, tables, images, captions, references) and formats them accordingly Ethical Image Detection: The system incorporates an AI model, which is capable of differentiating between ethical and unethical images. In case of an inappropriate or unethical image posted, the system will make sure that it is not included in the report, thus making sure that one does not go against academic and professional standards. Voice-Enabled Formatting Requirements: The users and administrators will be able to set formatting requirements by speech recognition using a microphone. This natural language processing capability renders the system more usable and easy to use especially when the user finds it more comfortable or needs to use voice interactivity as opposed to using handwriting. Student Application: This will enable students to post raw data (Word, PDF or plain text) and get a well formatted report according to the template of their campus. Specialized: Grammar checking, plagiarism checking, table of contents auto-generated, audio and table numbering, section recognition, version control, collaboration, and multilingual. Security Measures: It has data security and privacy measures which have been incorporated in order to secure sensitive academic work with the use of encryption and local storage. There is also live preview, with students being able to see changes in formatting on the fly, just like on platforms like LaTeX like Overleaf. Combining all these features, the solution is expected to offer a complete platform that is not confined to mere formatting and can improve the academic writing overall.

heading: Proposed Solution
content: Final Year Project (FYP) reports are frequently a very tedious and professional writing where students have to adhere to specific guidelines of the institutions. Formatting by hand takes up precious time, and distracts the actual research, and often the issue of inconsistencies ensues. The current project suggests creating an AI-driven Report Formatter that will automate the process of formatting the reports, making sure they are formatted in accordance with the institution-specific template and protecting the academic integrity. The system uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning to identify the elements of a document (headings, paragraphs, tables, figures and references) and uses these elements to apply formatting rules. An exclusive administration panel will enable the institutions to post and maintain their own templates to guarantee a high level of flexibility in the various universities. The innovations are AI-based with ethical vs. unethical image detection, which filters indecent or otherwise unacademic images, and a voice-activated formatting interface, which lets the user set formatting instructions by simply speaking to the computer and improving accessibility. Other functions provided are plagiarism and grammar check, absent section suggestions, and live preview. Word, PDF and LaTeX export options will be used to provide a high number of compatibility. The proposed solution alleviates the administrative workload of formatting, enhances academic integrity and increases accessibility in students by incorporating smart content classification and ethical protection as well as multi-modal interaction with users. In the end, the Report Formatter hopes to be a smart academic assistant that fills the gap between the creation of content and the presentation of the professional work, thus contributing to the high level of productivity and the quality of academic work in general.
